products.name: Bamboo Harmony by Kilian
products.title_raw: Bamboo Harmony by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2012, this original version of Bamboo Harmony by Killian features a serene ambiance paired with refinement and a small hint of spice. This signature fragrance opens with top notes of bergamot and neroli, a bitter floral that resembles a cross between orange and honey blossoms. White tea is clearly the star in this blend, allowed to bloom in its delicate beauty while accentuated with a tiny bit of spice.

products.name: Liaisons Dangereuses by Kilian

The velvety and floral Damascus rose blends with indulgent fruits for a smooth and languid scent. The inspiration invokes casual lovers enjoying ripened fruit in a hidden alcove.

products.name: Voulez-vous coucher avec Moi by Kilian
products.title_raw: Voulez-vous coucher avec Moi by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women

products.title_raw: Summer Breeze by Ocean Pacific Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women

The fragrance opens with a fresh and fruity mix of citruses and raspberries that make up the invigorating top notes. The heart notes for the perfume lie in the soft, white floral bouquet of magnolia and honey suckle accords.

products.name: Armaf Shades by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Shades by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Shades is a blend of citrus and aromatic accords. It is polished, striking and dynamic, excellent for making an unforgettable impression. It opens with a fruity mix of lime, pineapple and plum, topped with spicy cardamom and fresh violet leaves.

products.name: Armaf Craze by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Craze by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Craze is a blend of gourmand and floral accords. It is spicy and sweet, making this an invigorating and intense fragrance. It opens with light floral notes of heliotrope and bergamot, layered with spicy cumin.

products.name: Armaf Hunter by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Hunter by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Hunter by Armaf is an invigorating and primal cologne designed for men. Belonging to the woody floral musk group of fragrances, the cologne brings out the best of the outdoors into one manly fragrance. The top notes for this blend consist of an herbal blend with rosemary and cardamom with refreshing grapefruit and rich cedar.

products.name: Armaf Tres Nuit by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Tres Nuit by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Combining the sultry warmth of a summer night with mysterious hints of dark florals and spice, Armaf Tres Nuit is a complex and alluring fragrance for men. Lemon verbena, iris, and citrusy lemon dazzle the senses in the top notes like a light breeze. In the base notes, this Armaf cologne takes a spicy, masculine turn with accords of sandalwood and ambergris.

products.name: Armaf Tres Jour by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Tres Jour by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Delicately exotic, Armaf Tres Jour is an elegant and intriguing perfume for women. Its light, fresh top notes of lemon, neroli and gentle green tea combine to create an opening impression that is subdued and calm. Classic floral notes of tuberose and jasmine elevate the sense of sophistication and femininity of this fragrance from Armaf.

products.name: Armaf Blue Homme by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Blue Homme by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Blue Homme is a blend of citrus and spicy accords. It is striking and spirited, yet also refreshing and clean. The fragrance opens with bright citrus notes of lemon, mandarin orange, lime, bergamot and neroli.

products.name: Ambergris Showers by Rasasi
products.title_raw: Ambergris Showers by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Rasasi Ambergris Showers was launched in 2016 as a classic yet modern Arabic cologne for men comfortable with their sexuality and confident in themselves. Leaving an intoxicating fragrance trail, the notes blend into an intricate and mysterious dance that’s at once deeply earthy yet sophisticated and versatile – much like natural ambergris. Bracing, bitter galbanum and citrusy tangerine join with metallic green violet leaves for an elegant, refined top.

products.name: Bodycology Cherry Blossom Cedarwood and Pear by Bodycology
products.title_raw: Bodycology Cherry Blossom Cedarwood and Pear by Bodycology Fragrance Mist Spray 8 oz for Women
products.description_en: Like spring in a bottle, Bodycology Cherry Blossom by Bodycology delights and entices the senses with a burst of sweet floral bouquets. The soft, delicate and feminine fragrance of cherry blossom mingles gracefully with the strong, seductive aroma of jasmine for an exotic, flowery aura. A touch of aloe vera adds a clean and fresh twist for a fun, blissful and lively finish.

products.name: Armaf High Street Midnight by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf High Street Midnight by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The seductive cousin of the High Street by Armaf, Armaf High Street Midnight is a delectable floral and fruity perfume for women. Ideal for a night on the town, this perfume is sure to turn heads. Juicy blood orange mixes with other citrus to make up the refreshingly light and invigorating top notes.

products.name: Armaf Shades Wood by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Shades Wood by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Shades Wood is a blend of woody and floral accords, a modern take on a classic rose-oud fragrance. It is elegant, luxurious and exotic. It opens with bright and tart citrus, romantic rose, and rose-like geranium.

products.name: Armaf Oros Holiday by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Oros Holiday by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 2.9 oz for Women
products.description_en: In 2015, Armaf released its holiday fragrance, Armaf Oros Holiday Perfume. An Oriental floral fragrance, the elegant scent begins with top notes that include grapefruit, raspberry, black currant, peach and bergamot before blending into spicy florals like jasmine, cedar wood, cinnamon, rose and violet. Natural base notes remind of holiday baking with hints of musk, amber and vanilla.

products.name: Armaf Voyage Brown by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Voyage Brown by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: When you're ready to set out on adventure, be sure to bring along Armaf Voyage Brown, an exotic cologne for men from Armaf. The overall impression of the fragrance is warm and spicy due to its profile of resinous cardamom, sweet and sensuous cinnamon, and mildly peppery sage. The tartness of grapefruit lends a citrusy tang to green aromatic notes of lavender and violet leaves.

products.name: Armaf Voyage Bleu by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Voyage Bleu by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Set off on a journey with Armaf Voyage Bleu. The fresh, tart, citrus notes of grapefruit, bergamot, and lemon are given a camphorous edge with sprightly mint. Piquant spicy notes include sharp ginger, sweet nutmeg, and a rose-like nuance of pink pepper.

products.name: Armaf Aura by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Aura by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Aura is a fruity-spicy men’s scent from Armaf. A moderate longevity and sillage combine in a fragrance that gets attention without overpowering your audience. The top notes feature the crisp, clean appeal of apple, lemon and black cardamom.

products.name: Armaf Signature True by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Signature True by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Armaf Signature True is a blend of gourmand and fruity accords. It is sweet, feminine and coquettish, and it would work well for an evening date. It opens with fruity notes of mandarin orange, bergamot and pear.

products.name: Armaf Signature Night by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Signature Night by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Signature Night is a blend of woody and leathery accords. It is powerful, enticing and masculine. As its name implies, it is excellent for evening use, but works well in the daytime.

products.name: Armaf Le Parfait by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Le Parfait by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 6.8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Armaf Le Parfait is an exciting Asian-inspired fragrance designed for men by Armaf. “Le Parfait,” which means ‘The Perfect” in French, certainly lives up to its name by combining fruity top notes of pineapple, bergamot, black currant and lemon with a warm middle of spice, rose and jasmine. The classic base notes of musk, vanilla, patchouli and ambergris fill out the bottom for a robust, unique and masculine cologne appropriate for work or for play.

Sweet and earthy top notes of iris, orange blossom and jasmine intoxicate the senses before settling into the heart of black currant and pear. Base notes of tonka bean, praline, patchouli and vanilla round out the perfume for an enticing, citrusy blend sure to impress wearers and those around them at any time of day or for any occasion.

products.name: Armaf Ventana by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Ventana by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released in approximately 2016 or 2017, Armaf Ventana is a fragrance for men with an overall woodsy-floral profile. Opening with citrus notes of lemon, grapefruit, and mandarin orange, the heart contains floral notes of herbaceous geranium and aromatic lavender that freshen the more earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. Base notes give an overall balsamic effect as notes of precious wood blend with warm and powdery amber, as well as somber and austere cedar.

products.name: Armaf Derby Club House by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf Derby Club House by Armaf Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men

The top notes of bergamot and lavender slowly fade into the more sullen middle notes of cedarwood, blackwood and patchouli. The bottom notes round out the fragrance with scents of vanilla, amber and Tonka bean, producing an intense and smoky aroma that is as unique and innovative as it is manly.

products.name: Armaf The Warrior by Armaf

products.description_en: Built upon hearty middle notes of cedar, Armaf The Warrior combines the traditional with the unexpected to create a fragrance for men that is unmatched in strength and distinction. Bright citrus and vetiver mix with a pop of zesty pink pepper in the top notes, creating a playful opening gives way to a potent, woodsy center defined by labdanum, grapefruit and classic cedar. At its base, this Armaf cologne blends exotic frankincense with ginger and sandalwood to leave a warm and lasting impression.

products.name: Armaf Edition One by Armaf

The heart notes include sage, which brings a woodsy element to the cologne, and lavender, which adds a slightly sweet earthiness to the blend.

Musk amplifies the woody notes and adds depth to the blend while the note of amber gives the fragrance a slight sweetness to balance out the scent.

products.name: Armaf El Cielo by Armaf
products.title_raw: Armaf El Cielo by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in September of the year 2016, El Cielo is a hot, energizing cologne for men by Armaf. The top features a citrusy blend of lemon and bergamot, a tart note of green apple coming in strong, softened by the cool, sweet aroma of fresh melon. The cologne then takes an herbal, aromatic turn, lavender and violet coming together in a relaxing blend, accented by the robust scent of cypress.

products.title_raw: Ajmal Evoke Silver Edition by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 2.5 oz for Women

Its base of sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla balances the buoyancy of citrusy bitter orange in the top notes.

products.name: Ajmal Wisal by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Wisal by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women

Launched in 2010 by United Arab Emirates label Ajmal, it opens with fresh floral top notes before revealing a heart of sandalwood, a popular wood note prized in incense creation and lending its rich, green and slightly milky aroma to this blend. Finally, the perfume closes with a combination of heady rose and sensual musk in its bottom notes.

The cologne features energizing top notes of crisp yuzu, lemon and green pepper. Cool heart notes of lotus, green, water and water mint impart refreshment, while base notes of white musk and cedar give a woody finish reminiscent of many traditional aftershaves.

Top notes of Italian tangerine open with a refreshingly fruity and alluring aroma that won’t be overpowering to those near you. Vanilla, white musk, and patchouli enter the scene, giving this fragrance a delectably sweet and creamy twist.

products.name: Tobacco Blaze by Rasasi

The heart of the cologne features several myriad notes, most notably the soft sweetness of apricot.

The heart note of cinnamon gives the scent a warmth and the base notes consist of sandalwood and cedar to ensure depth and longevity.

products.name: Carven L'eau De Toilette by Carven
products.title_raw: Carven L'eau De Toilette by Carven Shower Gel 6.7 oz for Women

Ideal for daily wear, invoking spring weather, the fragrance opens with a softly sweet and sour combination of lemon, sweet pea, and peony top notes. Middle notes consist of an alluring wisteria, freesia, and white hyacinth bouquet.

products.title_raw: 212 VIP Black by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men

products.description_en: Montale has manufactured numerous perfumes over the years, including Montale Aoud Greedy in 2013. It was released with the Aoud Collection, and it functions as a unisex fragrance. Men and women alike can enjoy the sweet aroma of black licorice.

products.name: Montale Red Vetiver by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Red Vetiver by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Montale Red Vetiver is a classic blend of woody and spicy accords that invigorates the wearer and those around him. The fragrance features the dry, smoky scent of vetiver with highlights of tart, juicy grapefruit and sharp black pepper. The underlying woody scent comes from notes of cedar and balsam, with a hint of herbal green from patchouli.

products.name: Montale Red Vetiver by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Red Vetiver by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Montale Red Vetiver is a classic blend of woody and spicy accords that invigorates the wearer and those around him. The fragrance features the dry, smoky scent of vetiver with highlights of tart, juicy grapefruit and sharp black pepper. The underlying woody scent comes from notes of cedar and balsam, with a hint of herbal green from patchouli.

products.name: Montale Aoud Lagoon by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Aoud Lagoon by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Aoud Lagoon is a unisex cologne released by the perfume brand Montale in 2016. Sicilian orange and osmanthus blossom combine for a sweet and bright opening. The heart is comprised of light florals, with delicate tiare and lotus petals.

products.name: Montale Aoud Leather by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Aoud Leather by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Aoud Leather is a fragrance for men and women released in 2009 by Montale as part of its Aoud Collection. It combines the alluring aroma of spices with animalic scents for a rich, sensual fragrance that brings Eastern flavors to the forefront. Indian pepper, Guatemalan saffron, cardamom and Calabrian bergamot create an aromatic, spiced scent with a citrus tinge.

products.name: Montale Intense Amber by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Intense Amber by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale So Amber is a lovely woody floral musk with a modern oriental profile. The opening is a luxuriant yet refined floral effusion of lush Moroccan rose fused with soft suede nuances of saffron. As the scent settles, a warm and intimate accord of ambergris and creamy Indian sandalwood emerges, harmonized with delicate floral and fruit facets of tart-sweet raspberry.

products.name: Bod Man Uppercut by Parfums De Coeur
products.title_raw: Bod Man Uppercut by Parfums De Coeur Body Spray 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Bod Man Uppercut Cologne is a strong, masculine cologne released by Parfums de Coeur in 2000. This daily-wear body spray opens with floral and citrus notes of mandarin, bergamot orange and geranium along with a hint of sea spray. The heart includes sweet, clean notes of cyclamen and heliotrope.

products.name: Mancera Sicily by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Sicily by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2016 by Mancera and created by perfumer Pierre Montale, Mancera Sicily is a unisex fragrance with a bright, citrusy scent. Light and fruity top notes of mandarin orange, bergamot, peach, apple, grapefruit and pineapple create a refreshing opening to the fragrance. A bouquet of violet, ylang ylang, rose and jasmine add a touch of floral sweetness.

products.name: Mancera Holidays by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Holidays by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: First released in 2016, Mancera Holidays is a lovely paradise fragrance that layers tropical floral and marine tones over a serene, inviting vanilla musk base. The opening is a lush effusion of coconut laced with elegant, fruity-aromatic bergamot. Banana-toned ylang-ylang and sensuous tiare flower emerge as the scent warms on the skin, accompanied by ethereal aquatic undertones.

products.name: Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2016, Mancera Aoud Lemon Mint is a unisex fragrance that works well for both men and women. It was created by Pierre Montale for Mancera. Top notes of coriander, pepper, mandarin, lemon and almond provide a fresh opening layer that is complemented by earthy and floral notes of patchouli, Egyptian jasmine and agar wood.

products.name: Mancera Choco Violette by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Choco Violette by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Created by perfumer Pierre Montale, Mancera Choco Violette is a unique and intriguing oriental fragrance released by Mancera in 2016. Top notes of hazelnut, orange and bergamot open the fragrance with a bright freshness that is joined by an elegant combination of dark chocolate and violet heart notes. White musk and Madagascan vanilla base notes provide a sweet finishing touch.

products.name: Mancera Velvet Vanilla by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Velvet Vanilla by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2016 by French perfume house Mancera, Velvet Vanilla is a perfume as soft and delicate as its name. Accords of florals, musk, vanilla and fruits marry to forge a scent that is regal and elegant. Spritz on your wrist to experience a mix of fruits and spices including black pepper, nutmeg, mandarin, pear, clove and black currant.

products.name: Mancera Coco Vanille by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Coco Vanille by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Mancera Coco Vanille is a unisex fragrance released by Mancera in 2016. It was created by perfumer Pierre Montale. Sweet and tropical top notes of white peach and coconut transport you to an island paradise while heart notes of ylang ylang, tiare flower and Egyptian jasmine bring to mind a lush, blooming garden.

products.name: Mancera Aoud Orchid by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Aoud Orchid by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Mancera Aoud Orchid is a unisex fragrance released in 2017. It was created for Mancera by perfumer Pierre Montale. The perfume opens with fresh and sweet top notes of coconut, mandarin orange and peach.

products.name: Kenzo Homme by Kenzo
products.title_raw: Kenzo Homme by Kenzo Eau De Parfum Spray 3.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Kenzo Homme Cologne is a masculine fragrance made with a tantalizing blend of woody and spicy accords. The sophisticated cologne builds upon base notes of vetiver, sandalwood, oak moss, cedar, labdanum, amber, vanilla and fir balsam to create a masculine woodsy overtone. The heart of the fragrance consists of sage, nutmeg, lily of the valley, caraway, jasmine, iris, juniper berry, pine and rose.

products.name: Montale Powder Flowers by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Powder Flowers by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Powder Flowers is a magnificent blend of aromatic and floral accords in an impressively varied array of powdery scents. The showcase note of this fragrance is tonka bean, with its rich, warm, vanilla-like smell. Heady, romantic rose and delicate osmanthus offer a lovely counterpoint to the intense white floral scent of jasmine.

products.name: Mancera Wild Candy by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Wild Candy by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Mancera Wild Candy is a 2015 perfume created as part of Mancera’s Wild Collection line by Pierre Montale. This classic Oriental woodsy scent features citrus top notes of lemon and bergamot orange along with cocoa bean, peach and coconut. In the heart of the fragrance, floral notes of tiare flower, ylang ylang, Turkish rose and Bulgarian rose add sweetness.

products.name: La Petite Robe Noire Black Perfecto by Guerlain
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Florale Spray 1.6 oz
products.title_raw: La Petite Robe Noire Black Perfecto by Guerlain Eau De Parfum Florale Spray 1.6 oz for Women
products.description_en: Run by four generations of family members until 1994, Guerlain is a French perfume house founded in 1828. The business released La Petite Robe Noire Black Perfecto in 2017 as a women’s Oriental floral perfume. The main accords incorporate almond with sweet, fruity scents.

products.name: Bentley Momentum by Bentley
products.title_raw: Bentley Momentum by Bentley Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Introduced in 2017 by Bentley, Momentum is a musky, aromatic cologne. Aquatic notes and violet leaf ground the blend at its open while notes of bergamot and nutmeg add liveliness to the cologne. At the heart of the cologne, the floral note of jasmine is accompanied with soft notes of cashmere wood and ambergris.

products.name: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne
products.title_raw: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2017, Pure Xs is a sexy, erotic men’s fragranc with sweet, vanilla and balsamic accords. The top notes are bergamot, grapefruit, ginger, thyme and a green accord. Sweet vanilla and crisp green apple combine with leather, cinnamon and liquor in the heart.

products.name: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne
products.title_raw: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2017, Pure Xs is a sexy, erotic men’s fragranc with sweet, vanilla and balsamic accords. The top notes are bergamot, grapefruit, ginger, thyme and a green accord. Sweet vanilla and crisp green apple combine with leather, cinnamon and liquor in the heart.

products.name: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne
products.title_raw: Pure XS by Paco Rabanne Eau De Parfum Spray 2.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: A unique, sultry fragrance, Pure Xs was first introduced by Paco Rabanne in 2018. As the perfume opens, the sweet note of vanilla and the floral note of ylang-ylang are complemented by the salty, buttery note of popcorn and the rich note of ambrette. The juicy note of peach combines with the note of orange blossom at the heart of the perfume.

products.name: Derek Lam 10 Crosby Hifi by Derek Lam 10 Crosby
products.title_raw: Derek Lam 10 Crosby Hifi by Derek Lam 10 Crosby Eau De Parfum Spray 5.9 oz for Women
products.description_en: Derek Lam 10 Crosby Hifi Perfume by Derek Lam 10 Crosby

products.name: Al haramain Dazzle by Al Haramain
products.title_raw: Al haramain Dazzle by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Deliciously fresh yet subtly sensual, Al Haramain Dazzle is a mesmerizing, sophisticated floral and fruity fragrance that’s perfect for elegant cool-weather wear. The scent opens with tangy, fruity-aromatic tones of bergamot and tart-sweet black currant. Lemon-fresh red rose emerges at the heart, fused with delicately perfumed litchi fruit and crisply herbal, intoxicating tones of davana.

products.name: Al Haramain Dazzle Intense by Al Haramain
products.title_raw: Al Haramain Dazzle Intense by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Sweet citrus and flowers give way to mesmerizing Eastern tones of spice and musk in Al Haramain Dazzle Intense, a vibrant and seductive scent that layers fruity and aromatic notes over an intoxicating heart of fresh florals and lush gourmand accords. Sparkling tangerine and creamy orange blossom open the scent, rounded out by richly resinous elemi. Heady jasmine blossom and dark plum emerge at the heart, softened by violet-tinged orris root.

products.name: Demeter Sagittarius by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sagittarius by Demeter Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Women with adventurous spirits need to adorn their outfits with the crisp scent of Demeter Sagittarius from Demeter. When released in 2015, it was described as having a mysterious side that encapsulated free spirits. Its composition has a mystical nature to it with notes of saffron, Mojave ghost flowers, green laurel leaves, amber and oud.

products.name: Demeter Leo by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Leo by Demeter Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Leo is an addition to the Zodiac line released in 2015 by Demeter. This line takes inspiration from every Zodiac sign, utilizing personality and character traits to create a sign specific fragrance. Each is as specific and individual as the sign.

products.name: Demeter Aquarius by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Aquarius by Demeter Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Aquarius is part of the brand’s Zodiac collection, a line of 12 fragrances inspired by the astrological signs. Released in 2015, this scent is designed to create the feeling of vast, open space. Some of the most prominent notes include oud, cedar, long spurred violets and neroli.

products.name: Demeter Pisces by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pisces by Demeter Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter released its first fragrance in 1996. Always innovative, creative, and intentional, the company founders even took great care in naming the business after the Greek goddess of the harvest. Demeter Pisces perfume is a new scent that was released in 2015.

products.name: Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier by Lalique
products.title_raw: Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier by Lalique Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2014, Lalique Fleur Universelle Noir Premier is a bewitching scent for the woman who likes bold spices and soft liqueur. At first spritz, you are greeted with a warm head accord of cardamom, pink pepper and decadent rum. These notes are followed with a heart accord of myrrh, cinnamon and alluring immortelle.

products.name: Le Parfum Elie Saab Intense by Elie Saab
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Intense Spray (Unboxed) 3 oz
products.title_raw: Le Parfum Elie Saab Intense by Elie Saab Eau De Parfum Intense Spray (Unboxed) 3 oz for Women

products.name: Delina by Parfums De Marly
products.title_raw: Delina by Parfums De Marly Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Delina is the ideal scent for women looking for a fragrance with feminine appeal, with sweet, floral notes that easily transcend day to night. Fruity top notes include rhubarb, lychee and bergamot paired with the warm spice of nutmeg. Beneath, you’ll notice a floral heart of petalia, lily of the valley, peony and Turkish rose.

products.name: Vespero by Jeroboam
products.title_raw: Vespero by Jeroboam Pure Perfume Extrait 1 oz for Men
products.description_en: A man who enters a room wearing Vespero, a cologne from Jeroboam first released in 2017, instantly makes a strong impression. The overall profile of this fragrance is earthy, due to cedar and other woody notes, and animalic, due to notes of amber, leather, and musk. Patchouli at the base also adds an oriental flair.

products.name: Stercus by Orto Parisi
products.title_raw: Stercus by Orto Parisi Pure Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: With a deep and sexy scent, Stercus is a perfume which can be a fitting scent for both men and women, day and night. This unisex fragrance is created by Orto Parisi with a variety of warm and spicy scents. Seductive and alluring, this perfume includes the smell of sensuous leather and spicy tobacco.

products.name: In Full Bloom by Kate Spade
products.title_raw: In Full Bloom by Kate Spade Vial (sample) .03 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2018, In Full Bloom is a women’s green and floral fragrance by Kate Spade. Green notes, lemon and green tea open the perfume with a crisp green scent. The heart blossoms with floral notes of lotus, rose petals, may rose and peony.

products.name: Bombshell Seduction by Victoria's Secret
products.title_raw: Bombshell Seduction by Victoria's Secret Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A romantic perfume that combines a small number of luxurious fragrances, Bombshell Seduction was introduced by Victoria’s Secret in 2018. The floral note of tuberose gives the blend its fresh quality. The note of sage adds and earthiness to the fragrance and also complements the floral note in the perfume.

products.name: Abigail by Aerie
products.title_raw: Abigail by Aerie Solid Perfume .08 oz for Women
products.description_en: For women seeking a light, airy freshness to float through their day, the right scent makes the difference. Abigail Perfume by Aerie, released in 2009, is an uplifting scent uniquely crafted to subtly provide a fresh aroma that endures. The perfume opens with crisp pear notes, providing a flirty, fun opening for an enticing burst of delicate peony.

products.name: Dora and Boots by Marmol & Son
products.title_raw: Dora and Boots by Marmol & Son Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Dora and Boots is a fruity fragrance that was launched by Marmol & Son. This fun fragrance opens with fruity top notes of green apple, pink grapefruit, tangerine, and melon. Its sweet and flowery middle notes consist of freesia, magnolia, candy apple, and sugar.

You will love this perfume from the first spray thanks to the opening ozonic notes in addition to tangy black currant and tart grapefruit.

products.name: Bentley Absolute by Bentley
products.title_raw: Bentley Absolute by Bentley Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men

products.title_raw: Roja Reckless by Roja Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women

Floral and fruity top notes of bergamot, tangerine and lavender are complemented by spicy middle notes of cloves and cinnamon, a warm and inviting combination. The complex base note layer features a combination of woody and sweet scents, bringing together guaiac wood, sandalwood, cedar, musk, amber, tonka bean and vanilla to create a unique blend of scents that adds an earthy but soft element to the perfume.

products.name: Nejma 2 by Nejma
products.title_raw: Nejma 2 by Nejma Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Seductive rose and warm spice are layered over a rich oud base in Nejma 2, a mystical, inviting floral oriental fragrance. Shimmering, lemony-fresh white rose and banana-toned ylang-ylang open the scent, accompanied by soft saffron and spicy clove. May rose and Turkish rose flourish at the heart, quickly followed by a beautifully harmonizing finish of smoky oud and velvety-smooth sandalwood.

products.name: Nejma 3 by Nejma
products.title_raw: Nejma 3 by Nejma Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women

The opening combines exotic tones of bright, banana-toned ylang-ylang with nuances of sweetly aromatic cardamom and hints of bitter orange. Plush roses bloom at the heart, accompanied by lovely hibiscus.

Bright bergamot and jasmine finish the sensory experience with notes as fresh and lively as waves crashing against the shore.

products.name: Tom Ford Ombre Leather by Tom Ford
products.title_raw: Tom Ford Ombre Leather by Tom Ford Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Tom Ford Ombre Leather combines an intense, deliciously sensuous leather accord with nuances of fruit, florals and spice to produce an irresistible, darkly glamorous fragrance. Sweetly resinous, fruity-aromatic cardamom opens the scent, followed by a bold effusion of fresh leather refined with subtly narcotic undertones of jasmine sambac. The finish is an earthy patchouli blend enhanced by deep amber and oak moss for a warm, balanced finish.

products.title_raw: Noir Epices by Frederic Malle Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

products.name: Black Onyx by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Black Onyx by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A mysterious feminine fragrance released by Ajmal, Black Onyx is an oriental-inspired perfume that combines sweet and spicy scents. Warm and comforting cinnamon and cardamom are joined by lemon in the top notes before they are softened by rose, oud and myrrh middle notes. The fragrance is finished with an earthy base note layer of white musk, amber and patchouli that brings a sensual element to the perfume.

products.name: Carlisle by Parfums De Marly
products.title_raw: Carlisle by Parfums De Marly Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4.2 oz for Women
products.description_en: Like a favorite sweater, Carlisle by Parfums De Marly, released in 2015, has a warm, cozy aura that is made to last. Suitable for day or night wear, this spicy and sweet scent opens with a fresh burst of mandarin orange and bergamot. This energetic balance soon welcomes the delightful heart notes of jasmine and violet.

products.name: Al Haramain Junoon Noir by Al Haramain
products.title_raw: Al Haramain Junoon Noir by Al Haramain Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: First launched in 2016, Al Haramain Junoon Noir layers mesmerizing fresh and exotic florals over seductive accords of wood and musk. Intoxicating jasmine, banana-toned ylang-ylang and powdery, clean red rose open the fragrance. Heady jasmine and rose notes persist and deepen at the heart, joined by earthy, elegant orris root, iris and the sweet tobacco nuances of tonka bean.

products.name: Bois 1920 Oro Nero by Bois 1920
products.title_raw: Bois 1920 Oro Nero by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Elegantly aromatic and deliciously distinctive, Bois 1920 Oro Nero is a dark woody oriental fragrance that mingles warm spice and bright hints of citrus. The opening is an enticing blend of fresh orange and bergamot softened with saffron and spiced with clove. Earthy-sweet patchouli and lovely cedar emerge at the heart, made creamy and inviting with sandalwood and ylang-ylang.

products.name: Bois 1920 Nagud by Bois 1920
products.title_raw: Bois 1920 Nagud by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Lovely rose flourishes in dark and light tones in Bois 1920 Nagud, a spicy floral scent illuminated by citrus and supported by a smoky wood base. Bright lemon and bergamot notes lead, softened by lightl leather nuances of saffron. The heart is dominated by a fresh Turkish rose absolute accord, accompanied by sweetly narcotic ylang-ylang, warm myrrh and geranium.

products.name: Bois 1920 Itruk by Bois 1920
products.title_raw: Bois 1920 Itruk by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Ideal for evening wear, the seductive scent of Bois 1920 Itruk perfume by the fragrance company Bois 1920 is a unisex fragrance that is warm and spicy. Launched in 2015, this fragrance builds upon base notes of vanilla, oud, incense, tonka bean, and amber with middle notes of patchouli, nutmeg and orris root to create a sensual spicy accord. Top notes of caraway, black and pink pepper, and cardamom open the fragrance with a sweet floral accord with a hint of spiciness.

products.name: Bois 1920 Virtu Youth by Bois 1920
products.title_raw: Bois 1920 Virtu Youth by Bois 1920 Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2016, Bois 1920 Virtu Youth is a beautifully balanced aromatic citrus fragrance that harmonizes fresh and light fruit and floral tones with warm wood and spice. The opening is a bright effusion of lemon, grapefruit and bergamot tempered with sweetly resinous cardamom and bracing hints of black pepper. Amber-tinged florals bloom at the heart, fusing rose absolute, geranium and heliotrope with incense, patchouli and earthy cypriol nuances.

products.name: Ajmal Neutron by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Neutron by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2011.  A floral musky woodsy scent for men.  It is a fresh floral fragrance that is certainly masculine to wear.

The top notes include lush jasmine and a hint of aqua. The middle notes fill up the fragrance with the rich scents of vanilla and orange blossom.

products.name: Ajmal Viola by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Viola by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Spice up your classic floral fragrances with the warm woody spice in Ajmal Viola. This 2016 fragrance opens with brisk spices and a rich fruity scent of black currant and bergamot. The heart glides onto the scene with the sensual smells of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley.

products.name: Ajmal Signify by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Signify by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Ajmal Signify includes both sweetness and spice, making it the perfect fragrance for a young night’s adventure or a cozy day indoors. It opens with the surprising notes of pineapple and pink pepper for a lingering sweetness. It then deepens to a soft floral scent with heart notes of rose and jasmine.

products.name: Ajmal Shadow by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Shadow by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Fresh and invigorating, Ajmal Shadow by Ajmal delivers an aura that is irresistible and memorable. This bold cologne opens with clean and energizing orange sprinkled with salty aquatic notes. As the aroma conjures visions of seaside adventures, sweet and calming violet and vanilla begin to take hold.

products.name: Ajmal Ravish II by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Ravish II by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Naturally sweet with just a little bit of spice, Ajmal Ravish Ii is feminine and sexy without becoming overwhelming. Packaged in a feminine pink bottle, this fragrance features natural undertones of sandalwood, musk and amber that mingle perfectly with the florals of gardenia and peony. Spices of ginger, pepper and cardamom top off this flirtatious fragrance, making it an excellent choice for week days meeting clients in the office or weekend nights out with friends.

products.name: Ajmal Kuro by Ajmal
products.title_raw: Ajmal Kuro by Ajmal Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2018, Ajmal's Ajmal Kuro cologne contains a blend of spices and florals that are perfect for both day and evening wear. Spicy and woody notes of ambergris, pepper, patchouli and vetiver add a natural, masculine scent to this fragrance, and the blend of geranium, lavender and bergamot keeps it sweet and fresh enough not to be overwhelming. Spritz this fragrance on before heading to the office in the morning and know the long-lasting scent will continue well into the night.

products.name: Bois 1920 Ancora Amore Youth by Bois 1920
products.title_raw: Bois 1920 Ancora Amore Youth by Bois 1920 Eau De Toilette Spray (Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Women

The top notes are bright with rum and pink pepper and blossom to middle notes of gardenia and yummy coconut.

products.name: Charlie Black by Revlon

The base notes of coumarin, heliotrope, vanilla, musk and amber add a sweet and earthy finish.

products.name: Black Pepper & Sandalwood by Acca Kappa

Sweet top notes of peach, red berries and plum begin the scent profile before drying down to a floral heart accord featuring tuberose, hibiscus, coconut and violet.

products.name: Sometimes in the evening by Hubert De Montandon

The middle note features nutmeg and the unexpected raspberry to create a unique experience for the wearer. The top note of mandarin blends with the other fragrance notes to round out this perfume that is both spicy and sweet, dark and light.

products.name: Dior Joy by Christian Dior

products.name: Mercedes Benz Select by Mercedes Benz
products.title_raw: Mercedes Benz Select by Mercedes Benz Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men

Created by legendary perfumer Olivier Cresp, this fragrance is fresh, green and fruity with a hint of spice. The scent journey begins with top notes of black currant and bergamot before shifting to a heart accord of apple and mint.

products.name: Mercedes Benz Private by Mercedes Benz
products.title_raw: Mercedes Benz Private by Mercedes Benz Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Mercedes Benz Private is a unisex cologne that spotlights the sensuality of nature with refreshing simplicity. Released in 2018, this scent is completely contemporary with a refined, classic character.

products.name: Larmes Du Desert by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Larmes Du Desert by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the vibrant Middle Eastern desert, Larmes Du Desert is a sensual feast with accords of woods, spices and smoke. Apply to your pressure points and you will begin the scent profile with top notes of cypress and incense before melting to a woody heart accord of guaiac wood, patchouli and cedar. Benzoin, amber and citrus round out this alluring fragrance.

products.name: Iris Fauve by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Iris Fauve by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2017, Iris Fauve is the creation of Marie Salamagne for Atelier Cologne. The unisex fragrance opens with top notes of floral iris, crisp bergamot and enticing cinnamon. The heart consists of nagarmotha or cypriol oil, patchouli and Haitian vetiver.

products.name: Cuir Sacre by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Cuir Sacre by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Atelier Cologne released the unisex fragrance Cuir Sacre in 2015. The name of this fragrance translates to “sacred leather,” and leather is a key ingredient in the composition. Its down-to-earth nature begins with opening notes of juniper berries, cardamom and cypress.

products.name: Montale Vanilla Cake by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Vanilla Cake by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Vanilla Cake is a silky, serene yet versatile fragrance designed for both men and women and suitable for all types of wear—day to night. Top notes of this scent include soothing Madagascar vanilla, sweetened caramel and fluffy meringue. Later, wisps of warm milk and woody almond emerge for a calm and comforting finish that lasts for hours.

products.name: Montale Chypre Fruite by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Chypre Fruite by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Chypre Fruite is an elegant, subtly seductive fragrance that layers bright fruits and shimmering florals over a woody musk base. The opening notes are a fresh and vibrant blend of tropical fruits enhanced by delicately aromatic nuances of bergamot. Floral tones of rose and jasmine merge with earthy sweet patchouli in the heart notes, followed by a harmonizing finish of oak moss and musk.

products.name: Montale Intense Cherry by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Intense Cherry by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Intense Cherry is a 2017 release from the brand Montale. It is a women’s perfume with a sweet, light aroma suited for warm weather and time spent outdoors. Sour black cherry comes out in the opening notes, along with bitter, aromatic bergamot.

products.name: Mancera Black Vanilla by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Black Vanilla by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Mancera Black Vanilla is a unisex fragrance that was released by Mancera in 2017. This warm and rich fragrance combines sweet, floral and earthy notes to create an intriguing and sensual perfume. It opens with top notes of coconut, white peach, bergamot and black currant that are complemented by jasmine, rose and violet heart notes.

products.name: Mancera Purple Flowers by Mancera
products.title_raw: Mancera Purple Flowers by Mancera Eau De Parfum Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Mancera Purple Flowers was released by luxury brand Mancera in 2017. Harmoniously balanced between florals, citrus, powder and vanilla accords, this perfume invites you to keep sniffing your wrist. Spray some of this delicate purple elixir and you are greeted with top notes of fresh ginger, spicy nutmeg, sweet mandarin, fig and a splash of black pepper.

products.name: Montale Day Dreams by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Day Dreams by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Day dreams is a beautiful floral and fruity gourmand fragrance first released by Montale Paris in 2017. Inspired by warm Mediterranean evenings, the scent opens with an effusive, intoxicating blend of fresh orange blossom and honeyed neroli brightened with sparkling nuances of mandarin. Heady white florals bloom at the heart, mingling an intensive, hypnotic tiare flower accord with night-blooming jasmine.

products.name: Montale Fantastic Oud by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Fantastic Oud by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Experience oud as you never have before. First released in 2018, Montale Fantastic Oud is a rich oriental woody fragrance that’s perfect for illuminating cold-weather days. The scent opens with an intensive blend of oud and fresh red rose.

products.name: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Aoud Legend is a women’s fragrance released by the perfumery Montale in 2016. It has a richly woody scent that is sensual and feminine. The top notes are distinctive, resinous agarwood and sandalwood, tempered by the delicate fragrance of saffron.

products.name: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Aoud Legend by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Aoud Legend is a women’s fragrance released by the perfumery Montale in 2016. It has a richly woody scent that is sensual and feminine. The top notes are distinctive, resinous agarwood and sandalwood, tempered by the delicate fragrance of saffron.

products.name: Montale Golden Sand by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Golden Sand by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Golden Sand is a women’s fragrance launched by the perfume brand Montale in 2015. It is a feminine, floral scent that gets an edge from the addition of spices. The top notes are fresh and citrusy, with bergamot, orange and cool mint.

products.name: Montale Arabians by Montale
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.4 oz
products.title_raw: Montale Arabians by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: First released in 2017, Montale Arabians is an intense oriental fragrance that fuses a bold leather and oud accord with hints of florals and honeyed spice. The top notes combine fresh aromatic nuances of lavender with sweetly spicy cardamom and red thyme. Lovely rose blooms at the heart, accompanied by patchouli and subtle tobacco nuances of vetiver.

products.name: Montale Arabians by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Arabians by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: First released in 2017, Montale Arabians is an intense oriental fragrance that fuses a bold leather and oud accord with hints of florals and honeyed spice. The top notes combine fresh aromatic nuances of lavender with sweetly spicy cardamom and red thyme. Lovely rose blooms at the heart, accompanied by patchouli and subtle tobacco nuances of vetiver.

products.name: Montale Intense So Iris by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Intense So Iris by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Montale Intense So Iris is a mesmerizing blend of floral and woody accords that wafts around the wearer in a subtle, gentle haze. This fragrance consists of the earthy, floral smell of iris, accented by creamy sandalwood and soft musk. The result is an alluring, powdery scent that beguiles the wearer and those close to her.

products.name: My 5th Avenue by Elizabeth Arden
products.title_raw: My 5th Avenue by Elizabeth Arden Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2018, My 5th Avenue is a light and floral feminine fragrance created by Elizabeth Arden. Bright top notes of lemon, violet leaf and mandarin orange open the fragrance and are soon joined by heart notes of lotus and jasmine. Amberwood, orris root, cedar and musk base notes close the fragrance and give it a warm and earthy element.

products.name: Flowerbomb Nectar by Viktor & Rolf
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 3.04 oz
products.title_raw: Flowerbomb Nectar by Viktor & Rolf Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 3.04 oz for Women
products.description_en: Flowerbomb Nectar is the stunning 2018 sequel to its similarly-named counterpart from the Viktor & Rolf brand. What makes this fragrance so special are its unique gunpowder notes that provide a smokiness that is not for the faint of heart. However, notes of jasmine and orange blossom soften this loud scent.

products.name: Aube Rubis Des Ors by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Aube Rubis Des Ors by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Aube Rubis Des Ors is a sophisticated and sensual fragrance for men and women. Top notes of grapefruit, bergamot and blackcurrant offer a bright beginning, supported by heart notes of violet, sage and spring iris for a sweet earthiness. Base notes of praline and patchouli weave together for a complex blend of fruit, flowers and herbs.

products.name: Aeropostale Maximum by Aeropostale
products.title_raw: Aeropostale Maximum by Aeropostale Body Spray 4.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Aeropostale Maximum is a men’s fragrance, into which the well-known American fashion label imparts a blend of woody, aquatic and fresh accords. A single top note of seawater offers a crisp, fresh opening while a heart of herbal notes and bright, lemony geranium add both softness and depth. The cologne closes with vetiver, a mossy and woody note with a characteristically smoky undertone, combined with the lingering warmth of amber and sensual animal vitality of musk.

products.name: English Laundry London by English Laundry
products.title_raw: English Laundry London by English Laundry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Thanks to English Laundry London Cologne, you can travel to England without ever leaving your hometown. This scent from fashion company English Laundry is inspired by the U.K.

products.name: Coach Platinum by Coach
products.title_raw: Coach Platinum by Coach Eau De Parfum Spray 6.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Introduced in 2018 by Coach, Coach Platinum is a spicy, woodsy cologne. At the opening of the blend, the juicy note of pineapple is complemented notes of earthy juniper berries and black pepper. Heart notes of geranium, sage and cashmeran add a sweet, green quality to the cologne.

products.name: Le Participe Passe by Serge Lutens
products.title_raw: Le Participe Passe by Serge Lutens Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2018, Le Participe Passe is a fresh spicy, balsamic oriental unisex fragrance created by Serge Lutens. Notes of fresh, crisp bergamot and artemisia open the fragrance. The heart features fruity notes with spicy pepper.

products.name: Calvin Klein Woman by Calvin Klein
products.title_raw: Calvin Klein Woman by Calvin Klein Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Calvin Klein Woman is a perfume released by Calvin Klein in 2018. It has a unique, complex blend of fruity and woody scent notes. The fragrance opens with aromatic eucalyptus and black pepper.

products.name: The One Grey by Dolce & Gabbana
products.title_raw: The One Grey by Dolce & Gabbana Vial (sample) .05 oz for Men
products.description_en: The One Grey is a highly aromatic cologne for men. The fragrance opens with spicy notes of coriander, cardamom and peppery basil paired with uplifting grapefruit. Middle notes are herbaceous and floral with geranium, lavender and clary sage.

products.name: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut by Jo Malone
products.title_raw: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut by Jo Malone Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Beautifully smooth and balanced, Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut fuses creamy nut tones with a richly woody base. Silken hazelnut notes open the scent, followed by a clean, aromatic blend of cedar, oak moss and frankincense nuances of resinous elemi. Robust, roasted oak and tobacco hints of smoky sweet vetiver provide a distinctive, sophisticated finish with moderate sillage and longevity.

products.name: Nautica Voyage Heritage by Nautica
products.title_raw: Nautica Voyage Heritage by Nautica Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Crisp and energetic, Nautica Voyage Heritage Cologne is a fresh aquatic fragrance that layers bright citrus and herbal accords over a smoky wood base. The scent opens with an invigorating accord of fruity-aromatic bergamot and fresh ginger, followed by cooling green herbal notes of peppermint, lavender and woody nuances of rosemary oil. Base notes of earthy, subtly bitter vetiver harmonize with smooth sandalwood for a clean finish that’s casual yet sophisticated.

products.name: Bentley Black Edition by Bentley
products.title_raw: Bentley Black Edition by Bentley Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Bentley Black Edition is a woody-spicy fragrance that was designed for men. It was launched by the house of Bentley in 2018. This composition opens with top notes of pink pepper, tangerine, nutmeg, and violet.

products.name: Halloween Magic by Jesus Del Pozo
products.title_raw: Halloween Magic by Jesus Del Pozo Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2018 by Halloween, a Spanish design label, Halloween Magic Perfume by Jesus Del Pozo provided an opportunity for women to surround themselves with the mystery and enchantment of this scent. The scent opens with a fresh, tart, and creamy honeyed mandaring orange, red raspberry, and sweet pear sorbet. Middle notes include green fressia and lush pink peony.

products.title_raw: Fucking Fabulous by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The Fucking Fabulous fragrance which was released by Tom Ford in 2017 earns its name with the help of its incredible ingredients. products.title_raw: Armaf Magnificent by Armaf Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women

products.title_raw: Kaloo Les Amis by Kaloo Eau De Senteur Spray / Room Fragrance Spray 3.4 oz for Men

products.description_en: Charlie Pink is a sweet fruity fragrance for women released in 2009 by Revlon. The cosmetic industry powerhouse has 69 fragrances with the first released in 1935. Fruity notes of red berries combine with zesty tangerine for a fun, flirty sweetness.

products.name: Katy Perry's Indi by Katy Perry
products.title_raw: Katy Perry's Indi by Katy Perry Mini EDP Spray (Unboxed) .33 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Katy Perry in 2017, Katy Perry’s Indi is a unique woody and floral feminine fragrance. Light and fruity top notes of plum, bergamot and white tea drift subtly into heart notes of lily of the valley, cyclamen and white cedar. The base note layer offers a complex blend of various musk notes that include white musk, black musk, Egyptian musk and island musk that come together with warm amber and tonka bean to complete the fragrance.

products.name: Disney Frozen Elsa by Disney
products.title_raw: Disney Frozen Elsa by Disney Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the fun and magical movie, Disney Frozen Elsa is a charming feminine fragrance. This Disney perfume was released in 2017 and features soft, simple notes that make it a perfect choice for both girls and women. It begins with lily of the valley and white floral notes that are enhanced by heart notes of rose and lavender.

products.name: Original Penguin Iconic Blend by Original Penguin
products.title_raw: Original Penguin Iconic Blend by Original Penguin Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Introduced by Original Penguin in 2017, Iconic Blend is a mesmerizing woody, spicy cologne. Earthy violet leaf combines with the citrusy note of bergamot at the opening of the cologne. The note of nutmeg at the heart of the blend adds spiciness to the cologne while clary sage, geranium and angelica temper the aromatic note of nutmeg by adding earthy sweetness to the cologne.

products.name: Azzaro Wanted By Night by Azzaro
products.title_raw: Azzaro Wanted By Night by Azzaro Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Azzaro Wanted By Night is a sensual oriental fragrance that was launched by Azzaro in 2018. This elegant cologne opens with bright mandarin, lemon and lavender top notes that are warmed by hints of cinnamon. Cumin, incense and red cedar heart notes bring an earthy element to the fragrance which is enhanced by cedar, cypress, vanilla, tobacco, leather, and patchouli base notes.

products.name: Grand Soir by Maison Francis Kurkdjian
products.title_raw: Grand Soir by Maison Francis Kurkdjian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Grand Soir Perfume by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is an impressive fragrance for women, fashioned by only a few simple scent notes. At first spray comes the aroma of earthy, nutty labdanum of Mediterranean origin. The smell of tonka beans and warm vanilla soon follow, giving the perfume slightly more depth without over complicating the blend.

A blend of leather and Virginia cedar make up the rich and woodsy middle notes.

products.name: Baldessarini Ambre Oud by Hugo Boss
products.title_raw: Baldessarini Ambre Oud by Hugo Boss Eau De Toilette Spray 1.0 oz for Men

The noses behind this scent are Jean-Marc Chaillan and Pierre Wargnye. The opening notes include mint, bitter orange and tangerine for a crispy, fresh introduction.

products.name: Nuda Veritas by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Nuda Veritas by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

It is part of the White Collection offered by Atelier Des Ors, a newcomer in the world of perfumes and colognes. The scent opens with top notes of bergamot and delicate orange blossom.

products.name: Choeur Des Anges by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Choeur Des Anges by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Atelier des Ors in 2018, Choeur de Anges is a luminous, honeyed fragrance that fuses lush fruit and floral accords with unexpected earthy undertones. The opening is bright, tart-sweet and succulent with blood orange, black currant and crisp pear. Ambrosial apricot nuances of osmanthus and alluring orange blossom bloom next, harmonized with woody-earthy hints of carrot seed.

products.name: Patchouli Oud by Affinessence
products.title_raw: Patchouli Oud by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced in 2015, the luxurious Patchouli Oud is a women's perfume created by fragrance house Affinessence. This heady scent features woody, earthy and balsamic accords and uses base notes alone. True to its name, it features patchouli essence and Indonesian oud.

products.name: Sandor 70's by Carner Barcelona
products.title_raw: Sandor 70's by Carner Barcelona Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by an iconic bar in 1970’s Barcelona, a spritz of Sandor 70’s and you’ll feel like a disco queen. This leathery perfume will harken you back to nights spent socializing at the swankiest bars with friends. Spray on your pressure points and indulge in top notes of Bulgarian rose, Chinese osmanthus, bergamot, jasmine and suede.

products.name: Chaugan Delicate by Chaugan
products.title_raw: Chaugan Delicate by Chaugan Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Lush florals and warm spice are beautifully interwoven in Chaugan Delicate, an oriental fragrance launched by French fragrance house Chaugan in 2014. The opening is a lovely yellow floral effusion of ylang-ylang spiced with cardamom, black pepper and rosy nuances of pink pepper. Lush, alluring tuberose and a rich cream accord merge with incense and warm clove in the heart.

products.name: Dangerous Complicity by Etat Libre D'Orange
products.title_raw: Dangerous Complicity by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Sensual and magnetic, Dangerous Complicity is a woody floral fragrance enhanced by subtle spice. The top notes are a fruity-sweet blend of apricot-nuanced osmanthus spiced with crisp ginger, bay leaf and calamus. Luminous white florals of jasmine and ylang-ylang fuse in the heart notes with intoxicating undertones of rum and creamy coconut.

products.name: Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre by Etat Libre D'Orange
products.title_raw: Hermann A Mes Cotes Me Paraissait Une Ombre by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Top notes of ambroxan, geosmin and pepperwood provide an enticingly warm and rustic ambiance that instantly captures your attention.

products.name: Franck Boclet Chypre by Franck Boclet

Finally, the base notes of amber, caramel, musk and vetiver combine for a rich and smooth finish that entices all who smell it.

products.name: Giardino Benessere Tuberose by Giardino Benessere

products.name: Gritti Antalya by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Antalya by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

The heart of the fragrance is intense with the flavors of cedar, tobacco, and other woody notes.

products.name: Gritti Saraj by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Saraj by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Beneath, the heart of the fragrance consists of wood and herbal notes including labdanum, cloves, Egyptian jasmine, vetiver and Virginia cedar.

products.name: Gritti Preludio by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Preludio by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Notes of watermelon, lemon and lavender combine with sensual musk and pine to create a strong, long-lasting fragrance that will get you noticed. You may also detect notes of tobacco, amber, sandalwood and borage.

products.name: Gritti Noctem Arabs by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Noctem Arabs by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Introduced in 2014, Gritti Noctem Arabs opens with earthy and rich scents from the notes of cedar, patchouli, and tobacco. The heart of the fragrance features oud, one of the most distinctive and luxurious ingredients in Middle Eastern perfumes.

products.name: Gritti Ephesus Prive by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Ephesus Prive by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

The opening to this fragrance is sweet and spicy with notes of orange and cloves.

products.name: Gritti Arete Prive by Gritti
products.title_raw: Gritti Arete Prive by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Belying its subtle beginning, the heart of the perfume grabs ahold of the senses with a sensual combination of leather, tobacco, and whiskey.

products.name: Hayari Goldy by Hayari
products.title_raw: Hayari Goldy by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2012, Hayari Goldy is a sensual luxurious fragrance for women. Hayari has created over a dozen luxurious fragrances since 2011. White jasmine, musk and sandalwood carry the fragrance with a delicate, creamy essence.

products.name: Hayari Rose Chic by Hayari
products.title_raw: Hayari Rose Chic by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: An enticing scent for women, Hayari Rose Chic was created by Hayari in 2015. Top notes of freesia, buchu and mandarin orange offer an intriguing blend of floral and citrus that introduces an invigorating freshness. Magnolia, rose and lily of the valley middle notes offer an alluring hint of delicate sweetness that integrates beautifully with the other elements.

products.name: Hayari Amour Elegant by Hayari
products.title_raw: Hayari Amour Elegant by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Hayari Amour Elegant is a 2015 fragrance designed for both women and men, combining intoxicating florals with earthy, spicy scents. The top notes include herbal notes of chamomile and pink pepper along with sweet, zesty bergamot orange. Beneath, the heart is comprised of cloves, grasse rose and Indian jasmine.

products.name: Hayari Le Paradis De L'homme by Hayari
products.title_raw: Hayari Le Paradis De L'homme by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2014, Hayari Le Paradis De L’Homme is a men’s fragrance capturing the essence of the modern man. Starting in haute couture fashion, Hayari moved into the world of perfumery in 2011. Brazilian redwood starts the fragrance off on a woody note.

products.name: Hayari New Oud by Hayari
products.title_raw: Hayari New Oud by Hayari Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2016, Hayari New Oud is warm spicy oud fragrance for women and men. Hayari combines oriental and French styles in the dozen perfumes the company has created since 2011. Petitgrain, bitter orange and orange blossom combine woody notes with delicate floral notes in the opening.

products.name: Ombre Indigo by Olfactive Studio
products.title_raw: Ombre Indigo by Olfactive Studio Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Celebrate sensuality and mystery with Ombre Indigo. This women's fragrance was created by Olfactive Studio and was launched in 2014. The base consists of ambergris, musk, and benzoin to give users a relaxing depth.

products.name: Olfactive Studio Panorama by Olfactive Studio
products.title_raw: Olfactive Studio Panorama by Olfactive Studio Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Olfactive Studio Panorama by Olfactive Studio is a women's scent that wraps users up in the fresh, green scents of luscious forests. Released in 2015, the fragrance features top notes of bergamot and lemon. It follows with a heart of spicy wasabi and notes of fig, violet, galbanum and grass.

products.name: Aqua Incanta by Gritti
products.title_raw: Aqua Incanta by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Delicately floral Aqua Incanta is a women’s fragrance launched in 2012 by Gritti. Since 2010, the company has created exotically inspired fragrances for men and women. The opening is floral with notes of rose and iris.

products.name: Musc Immortel by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Musc Immortel by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2017, Musc Immortel is a women’s fragrance that is intended to create a lasting impression. This fresh, complex scent takes its inspiration from natural aromas for a balance of richness and lightness best suited for daytime wear. The top notes open with clary sage, iris, and tart grapefruit, while the middle notes are earthier with patchouli and vetiver.

products.name: Yes I Do by Etat Libre D'Orange
products.title_raw: Yes I Do by Etat Libre D'Orange Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Yes I Do by Etat Libre D’Orange is a feminine and flowery scent. The brand launched in 2016 and appeals to every woman. It contains beautiful notes of jasmine, lily, aldehydes, cacao pod, marshmallow, and orange blossom.

products.name: Arancia Ambrata by Gritti
products.title_raw: Arancia Ambrata by Gritti Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2017, Arancia Ambrata is a fragrance for women and men. Founded in 2010 by Luca Gritti, Gritti has created 32 fragrances. Blood orange and bergamot start the fragrance on a burst of citrus zest.

products.name: You or Someone Like You by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: You or Someone Like You by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.6 oz for Women
products.description_en: You or Someone Like You by Etat Libre D’orange is a summery, fresh fragrance. This brand was designed in 2017 and includes a perfect blend of ingredients. The flowery notes of hedione, cassis and rose will drift your mind into its favorite flower garden.

products.name: Jasmin Et Cigarette by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: Jasmin Et Cigarette by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: An exhilarating perfume, Jasmin Et Cigarette was created by Etat Libre D’Orange in 2006. Apricot, hay and jasmine absolute top notes provide an intriguing blend of fruity, earthy and floral aromas that stimulate the senses. A captivating tobacco essence enhances the exotic ambiance, adding a seductive element that’s hard to resist.

products.name: Fat Electrician by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: Fat Electrician by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray 3.38 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2009, Fat Electrician is a fun, woody scent for men. Etat Libre D’Orange combines cutting-edge fragrances with a playful nature. Showcase the essence of the modern man with this vetiver fragrance.

products.name: Fat Electrician by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: Fat Electrician by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray 1.6 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2009, Fat Electrician is a fun, woody scent for men. Etat Libre D’Orange combines cutting-edge fragrances with a playful nature. Showcase the essence of the modern man with this vetiver fragrance.

products.name: Fir Balsam by Franck Boclet
products.title_raw: Fir Balsam by Franck Boclet Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2015, Fir Balsam is a spicy men’s fragrance. Franck Boclet studied under Kenzo and Francesco Smalto before opening up his own French fashion house in 2010. Artemsia, cardamom and red berries lend a spiciness and sweetness to the beginning.

products.name: Musc Ambre Gris by Affinessence
products.title_raw: Musc Ambre Gris by Affinessence Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Affinessence introduced the world to its seductively exotic women’s perfume, Musc Ambre Gris, in 2017. An alluring combination of black musk and grey amber create a mysterious ambiance that captures your attention. Earthy notes of truffle, Haitian vetiver and mate infuse an invigorating and refreshing woodsy element that lends an element of warmth and comfort to this enticing fragrance.

products.name: Kensie Loving Life by Kensie
products.title_raw: Kensie Loving Life by Kensie Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Kensie Loving Life is a perfume for women created by Kensie that allows you to bring a bit of an edge to your femininity. It starts off sweet with a fruity top note layer of apple, citrus, peach, berries, cassis and dewy greens. Soft florals come to life in the heart note layer, filling your senses with a beautiful bouquet of narcissus, muguet, jasmine, rose and gardenia.

products.name: Kensie Loving Life by Kensie
products.title_raw: Kensie Loving Life by Kensie Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women

products.name: Grey Quartz by Pascal Morabito
products.title_raw: Grey Quartz by Pascal Morabito Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Introduced in 2012, Grey Quartz is a men’s fragrance that defies stereotypes. From French perfumier Pascal Morabito, this spicy masculine scent has a playful floral side that makes for a unique cologne. The fragrance opens with fruity notes of bergamot and mandarin before revealing heart notes of carnation, violet leaf, and earthy nutmeg.

products.name: Tiziana Terenzi Porpora by Tiziana Terenzi
products.title_raw: Tiziana Terenzi Porpora by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Majestic rose flourishes in mesmerizing profusion in Tiziana Terenzi Porpora, a hypnotic floral oriental fragrance released in 2017. The fragrance opens with an intense accord of rose absolute, harmonized with lovely woody-spicy nuances of wild raspberry, cinnamon and clove. Bulgarian rose and hazy, earthy-floral poppy emerge at the heart alongside incense and patchouli.

products.name: Tiziana Terenzi Eclix by Tiziana Terenzi
products.title_raw: Tiziana Terenzi Eclix by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the beauty of an eclipse, Eclix was introduced in 2017 by Tiziana Terenzi. The opening of the perfume is sweet and soft thanks to notes including almond, iris, and vanilla, while notes of lemon and tangerine add brightness to the blend. Floral notes of white lily and violet at the heart of the blend give the fragrance a powdery quality while the note of petitgrain amplifies the citrusy top notes.

products.name: Tous Your Moments by Tous
products.title_raw: Tous Your Moments by Tous Eau De Toilette Spray 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Tous Your Moments is a bright fragrance which utilizes a unique blend of florals and fruits to create a delightful fragrance. Tangerine, apricots and blackberries open the perfume along with cardamom. Middle notes are flower powered, with peony, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley.

products.name: Bentley Momentum Unlimited by Bentley
products.title_raw: Bentley Momentum Unlimited by Bentley Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: This fragrance was created by the house of Bentley with perfumer Michel Almairac and released in 2018.  This magnificent is a warm and refreshing blend of notes to add excitement to your day.  Fantastic for casual wear, this cologne will bring hours of enjoyment.

products.name: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature by Salvatore Ferragamo
products.title_raw: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature by Salvatore Ferragamo Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Salvatore Ferragamo Uomo Signature is a leathery cologne for men, ideally suited for a cold winter’s night. It opens with a fresh blast of fruit notes, including lemon and Italian mandarin orange mixed with pink pepper. The fragrance takes on spicier notes with cinnamon, cardamom and cypress in the heart.

products.name: Yohji Yamamoto Homme by Yohji Yamamoto
products.title_raw: Yohji Yamamoto Homme by Yohji Yamamoto Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Introduced in 2013 by Yohji Yamamoto, Yohji Yamamoto Homme is a citrusy, aromatic cologne. Earthy orris root is contrasted by the citrusy notes of lemon and bergamot at the top of the fragrance. At the heart of the blend, sage and violet leaf amplify the woody notes in the blend while warmth is added to the cologne due to the rich note of leather.

products.name: Burberry Her by Burberry
products.title_raw: Burberry Her by Burberry Parfum Spray 1.6 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2018 by Burberry, Burberry for Her is an elegant perfume that beautifully combines fruity and floral notes. The bright, lively opening includes the sweet fruity note of strawberry and the tart, juicy notes of sour cherry, raspberry, black currant and blackberry. The sultry note of jasmine and the powdery note of violet follow the fruity opening.

products.title_raw: Juicy Couture Oui by Juicy Couture Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
