products.description_en: 4711 Remix is a limited edition cologne released to celebrate the 225th anniversary of the original 4711 formulation in 2017. This fragrance retains the aromatherapy-inspired essential oil infusion of its predecessor, including citrus notes of lemon, orange and bergamot along with aromatic herbal notes of rosemary, lavender and petitgrain. This light, soothing, invigorating cologne is ideal for everyday wear, especially during the warm spring and summer months.

products.name: Comptoir Sud Pacifique Vanille Blackberry by Comptoir Sud Pacifique
products.title_raw: Comptoir Sud Pacifique Vanille Blackberry by Comptoir Sud Pacifique Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Comptoir Sud Pacifique Vanille Blackberry is a delicious women’s fragrance released in 2017 that blends fruit and floral notes for a sweet, feminine effect. You’ll immediately notice zesty, energizing citrus top notes of The heart notes of this scent include juicy blackberries and pink berries along with alluring, romantic jasmine and rose. In the base, earthy notes of cashmere wood and white musk mingle with sweet vanilla to add a hint of the gourmand to this scent.

products.name: Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier by Lolita Lempicka
products.title_raw: Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 1997, Lolita Lempicka Mon Premier is a sweet and floral fragrance for women created by Lolita Lempicka. An intriguing combination of ivy, cherry and star anise opens the perfume and moves into heart notes of violet, licorice, orris root and amaryllis. A blend of sweet and earthy base notes brings the fragrance to completion with musk, tonka bean, vanilla, vetiver and praline forming the gentle foundation of the perfume.

products.name: Tom Ford Oud Minerale by Tom Ford
products.title_raw: Tom Ford Oud Minerale by Tom Ford Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Tom Ford Oud Minerale is an aquatic woody perfume for women. Fresh and exhilarating, the fragrance opens with bracing pink pepper, savory sea salt and sea notes. The unmistakable smoked essence of oud is found in the bold heart along with styrax and seaweed.

products.name: Lolita Lempicka Mon Eau by Lolita Lempicka
products.title_raw: Lolita Lempicka Mon Eau by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Awaken the spirit with a bottle of Lolita Lempicka Mon Eau by Lolita Lempicka. Released in 2018, this lively perfume features delicately balanced scents that create a compelling and mysterious allure. A sweet yet sour opening of raspberry leaf, blackberry and aniseed invigorates the senses and prepares them for a sweet and rich floral bouquet of Roman chamomile, iris, jasmine sambac that is soothing and sensual.

products.name: Korloff Royal Oud by Korloff
products.title_raw: Korloff Royal Oud by Korloff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3 oz for Women

Launched in 2015, this captivating fragrance is a balanced blend of bold Oriental spices with sensual, delicate notes. It opens with a fragrant burst of rose, frankincense and nutmeg.

products.title_raw: Moroccan Leather by Memo Eau De Parfum Spray (Unboxed) 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Moroccan Leather perfume lives up to its name, as it opens on the nose with strong notes of leather. Although the leather tones persist throughout the wear, subtler notes emerge as the heart and base notes begin to unfurl. The leather is joined by noticeable vetiver and iris, with more subtle touches of tonka bean, amber and cypress.

products.title_raw: Lolita Lempicka Homme by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men

Its vibrant opening of lily, jasmine and magnolia blossoms into a delicate and dreamy bouquet of ylang ylang, magnolia, amber and lily of the valley.

The perfume starts off bright with a blend of fruity top notes. Nashi pear, bergamot and pink pepper make way for heart notes of Bulgarian rose, freesia and peony, the star of the show.

products.name: Clean Reserve Citron Fig by Clean
products.title_raw: Clean Reserve Citron Fig by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released by Clean in 2016, Clean Reserve Citron Fig is a light and refreshing fragrance that is suitable for both men and women. The perfume opens with bright notes of lemon, fig and ginger before moving into complementing heart notes of mandarin, copaiba balsam, mint and cardamom. Cedarwood, sandalwood and musk base notes complete the perfume.

products.name: Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana by Jo Malone
products.title_raw: Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana by Jo Malone Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Lazy springtime days and butterflies feasting on newly-bloomed honeysuckle come to mind with one breath of this fresh, floral scent. Jo Malone Honeysuckle & Davana combines many natural elements to make one unforgettable fragrance. Davana, a spicy green plant that has a wine-like alcoholic aroma, is the main note.

products.name: Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold by Jo Malone
products.title_raw: Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold by Jo Malone Cologne Intense Spray (Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Wake up to the precious floral aromas of the Jo Malone Jasmine Sambac & Marigold perfume. Inspired by the queen of all jasmines, jasmine sambac, this perfume is the epitome of delicate, floral perfection. This note is accompanied by marigold and benzoin to build an oriental feel.

products.name: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes
products.title_raw: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
products.description_en: This fragrance was released in 2018.  An aromatic warm woodsy scent for men.  It opens with a nice crisp clean take with the fruit notes.

products.name: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes
products.title_raw: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Women
products.description_en: Celebrating individuality and all things unique, Police To Be Tattoo Art is a sweet fragrance for women that delivers a desirable blend of nature and sugar. Immediately recognizable top notes for the inner gourmand include gooey marshmallow and maple syrup with a hint of freesia as nature’s sweetener. Middle notes step in as a mixed flower bouquet of heliotrope and apple blossom combined with rose and violet.

products.name: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes
products.title_raw: Police To Be Tattoo Art by Police Colognes Eau De Parfum Spray 4.2 oz for Women

products.title_raw: Royall Bay Rhum 57 by Royall Fragrances Eau De Toilette 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Royall Bay Rhum 57 is a men’s scent that captures the essence of a warm summer breeze. From Royall Fragrances, a perfume house based in Bermuda, this masculine scent has spicy, woody notes for a classic, timeless feel. The blend of rum, clove, balsam, cedarwood, and amber come together to create the perfect balance of an island paradise.

products.name: Royall Bay Rhum 57 by Royall Fragrances
products.title_raw: Royall Bay Rhum 57 by Royall Fragrances Eau De Toilette Spray 4 oz for Men

products.name: Montale Sweet Peony by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Sweet Peony by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Sensual and boldly feminine, Montale Sweet Peony is an intense floral fragrance enhanced by dark spice. Lush pink peony opens the fragrance with fresh effusion. Narcotic notes of jasmine and deep red rose bloom next, harmonized with luscious tones of ripest peach and creamy coconut.

products.name: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka
products.title_raw: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Lolita Lempicka in 2018, Lolitaland is a powdery-sweet and fresh fruity floral fragrance for women. The opening notes are effervescent with bright tones of mandarin orange, grapefruit, lemon and lime pricked with warm hints of Sichuan pepper. Intoxicating flowers and succulent fruit notes emerge at the heart, mingling jasmine, magnolia and deep red rose with black currant, white peach and plum.

products.name: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka
products.title_raw: Lolitaland by Lolita Lempicka Eau De Parfum Spray 2.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Lolita Lempicka in 2018, Lolitaland is a powdery-sweet and fresh fruity floral fragrance for women. products.name: Cross of Asia by Orlov Paris
products.title_raw: Cross of Asia by Orlov Paris Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Travel to the other side of the world with the Asian influences of the Cross of Asia perfume. Top notes of geranium let you take in the beauty that China has to offer. Next, heart notes of ylang-ylang flower showoff its Indian roots.

products.name: Demeter Almond by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Almond by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A unique perfume for women that is both flirty and fun, Demeter Almond was created by the fragrance house of Demeter in 2000. The simple scent of toasted almonds is sweet and refreshing, as well as evocative of the smell of desserts baking in the oven. This fragrance is long-lasting, with the irresistibly inviting aroma beckoning others to come closer.

products.name: Demeter Angel Food by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Angel Food by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Enjoy the sweet and succulent aroma of sponge cake with Demeter Angel Food. This perfume, which was released by Demeter in 1997, smells just as delectable as the famous light and fluffy dessert it is named after. A scented blend of coconut, sugar, warming vanilla and egg whites completes this fragrance for a scent that is comforting and charming and lingers throughout the day.

products.name: Demeter Bamboo by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Bamboo by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: If you're seeking a perfume for women that evokes the fresh, exotic vibe of a bamboo forest, try Demeter Bamboo. Tender green shoots of bamboo are flanked by notes of guava, lemon juice, mango, orange liquor and passion fruit. These natural ingredients lift your spirits and mood whenever you splash on this intoxicating fragrance from Demeter.

products.name: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: An ode to the rich, caramelized flavors of an adored dessert, Demeter Banana Flambee will have your friends and admirers thronging to you. From the distinctive note of banana to the accompanying sugar and cognac notes, this intoxicating fragrance for women makes a splash at daytime activities or evening assignations. Wherever you go, you'll exude a sweetness and complexity that's all your own.

products.name: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Banana Flambee by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women

products.name: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by a 1920s cocktail recipe, Demeter Between The Sheets is a whimsical blend of guava, lemon, mango, orange, passionfruit and rum. When you spritz a little of this fresh tropical fragrance on your pulse points, you can expect to become the center of attraction. Aromatic and fruity, it's the kind of perfume that is especially appropriate for wear in the summertime months.

products.name: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Between The Sheets by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women

products.name: Demeter Birthday Cake by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Birthday Cake by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: You can have your cake and smell it, too! Thanks to Demeter Birthday Cake perfume, every day is a special celebration when you inhale the delicious notes of chocolate cake, buttercream icing and pink icing flowers. Revel in the rich cocoa and sugary confection and transport yourself to birthdays of yesteryear and the future.

products.name: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the cocktail of the same name, Demeter Black Russian marries the traditional ingredients of the beverage in one sophisticated swoop. Coffee, vodka and sugar are the three central notes, each one supporting the others to produce a powerful effect. If you love the taste of the cocktail, you'll love the aroma of the perfume.

products.name: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Black Russian by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the cocktail of the same name, Demeter Black Russian marries the traditional ingredients of the beverage in one sophisticated swoop. products.name: Demeter Bonfire by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Bonfire by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Wrap yourself in the intoxicating aura of a cool autumn day with Demeter Bonfire. Released by fragrance house Demeter in 2009, this smoky perfume conjures images of colorful orange, red and yellow maple tree leaves filling the tree-lined sky and gently falling on the path ahead. Hints of sweet apple cider comfort the senses as the powerful aroma of a burning bonfire creates a sensual and alluring warmness that makes one yearn to get closer.

products.name: Demeter Bubble Gum by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Bubble Gum by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Embrace the sweet carefree innocence of youth with a bottle of Demeter Bubble Gum. Designed by perfumer Demeter, known for its more than 300 unique single-scented fragrances, this perfume bursts with the lively and fun aroma of bubble gum. The first spritz takes one back to childhood, bringing alive memories of blowing the biggest bubble and laughing with friends.

products.name: Demeter Bulgarian Rose by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Bulgarian Rose by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A timeless aphrodisiac and calming oil cultivated from Rosa damascena blossoms, Bulgarian rose has long been a much sought-after ingredient for the finest perfumes. Demeter Bulgarian Rose, crafted by the fragrance house of Demeter, bottles the intoxicating allure of a valley filled with the delicate and precious flowers. Soft, gentle and intoxicating, this floral scent emits a sense of romance.

products.name: Demeter Champagne Brut by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Champagne Brut by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Pop open a bottle of Don Perignon champagne with the Demeter Champagne Brut perfume. This fragrance has the same elegance of the Don Perignon drink with a hint of added sweetness. Its singular champagne note lets you take in the slightly fruity nature of the drink.

products.name: Blue Grass by Elizabeth Arden
products.title_raw: Blue Grass by Elizabeth Arden Cream Deodorant Stick 1.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Arden in 1934, Blue Grass is classified as a luxurious, flowery fragrance. This feminine scent possesses a blend of fresh cut flowers, wood and spices. It is recommended for romantic wear.

products.name: Blue Grass by Elizabeth Arden
products.title_raw: Blue Grass by Elizabeth Arden Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Arden in 1934, Blue Grass is classified as a luxurious, flowery fragrance. This feminine scent possesses a blend of fresh cut flowers, wood and spices. It is recommended for romantic wear.

products.name: Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Why not enjoy the sweetness of chocolate-covered cherries all day? The Demeter Chocolate Covered Cherries perfume can help you do just that with its delectable cherry, chocolate and cognac notes. This combination creates the same happiness you feel when dipping into a box of this tasty treat.

products.name: Demeter Cinnamon Bun by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cinnamon Bun by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The warm, sweet aroma of Demeter Cinnamon Bun by Demeter is sure to delight fans of the pastry. This fragrance holds several delicious notes, the most prominent of which is spicy cinnamon. Hints of sugar, milk and vanilla are reminiscent of icing dribbled over the golden brown spirals of pastry, while the light note of wheat brings to mind buns fresh from the oven.

products.name: Demeter Cinnamon Toast by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cinnamon Toast by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter seems to have successfully bottled nostalgia with its tasty Demeter Cinnamon Toast fragrance. This perfume is a tantalizing mix of notes, including nutty wheat, warm cinnamon and a dash of sugar. Sweet and rich, this scent has moderate sillage and is long-lasting.

products.name: Demeter Coriander Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Coriander Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The Demeter Coriander Tea fragrance by Demeter is an exercise in simplicity. This perfume holds only two notes to create the perfect balance between warm and refreshing. The coriander possesses a unique mix of spicy wood and juicy orange.

products.name: Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter offers a twist on a classic with the Demeter Cosmopolitan Cocktail fragrance. The simple collection of notes perfectly matches the ingredients contained within the chic drink for which this perfume is named: the balance of sweet and sour citrus with orange and lime, a burst of tart cranberry and the bitter bite of vodka. Long-lasting, this scent has heavy sillage, so handle with care.

products.title_raw: Demeter Cranberry by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Just because it’s simple doesn’t mean it can’t make a lasting impression. The Demeter Cranberry perfume by Demeter contains only a few notes, yet perfectly recreates the scent of cranberries at peak ripeness. Top notes include the tart richness of the star fruit itself, followed by heart notes of fresh spice and base notes of coumarin and almond for a balanced blend.

products.name: Demeter Snow by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Snow by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Created by the fragrance house of Demeter, Demeter Snow is a fresh and refreshing scent that is reminiscent of the crisp, cool air right before the first snowfall. Leaves behind a lingering earthy, slightly floral scent with spicy undertones that leaves passersby wanting more of the cool and intoxicating impressions that come to mind. Suitable for men but ideal for women who want some chill to beat the heat or a little snow effect, regardless of the season to boost their confidence for the activities to come.

products.name: Demeter Dandelion by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Dandelion by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 1998, Demeter Dandelion is a breath of fresh spring air with its green and floral fragrance. Grassy and refreshing, it is reminiscent of sunny childhood days. Its light and innocent aroma is a flowery classic and is perfect for daily wear all year round.

products.description_en: Demeter Asian Pear Cologne, established by Demeter in 2015, is a seductive and delicate perfume for women. This fresh fragrance uses the delicious Asian pear for a slight sweetness, with a hint of spices such as cinnamon and nutmeg for an elevated scent that is natural and light, yet aromatic and durable. The result is a perfume that is both refined and elegant.

products.name: Demeter Aloe Vera by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Aloe Vera by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Aloe Vera, launched by Demeter in 2014, is a soothing perfume that relaxes the senses. It is derived from the aloe vera plant, which is often used in cosmetics and lotions and has a refreshing, clean aroma. This perfume is light and delicate, making it the perfect choice to wear any time of year and is suitable for all occasions.

products.name: Demeter Baby Powder by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Baby Powder by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Baby Powder, created by the fragrance house of Demeter, is a fresh, clean perfume for women that is light and gentle. The calming and familiar scent of baby powder transitions into powdery and slightly floral notes for an all-natural, serene aroma that is innocent and delicate. This fragrance is mild with a soft sillage and it is simple and modest.

products.name: Demeter Baihao Yinzhen Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Baihao Yinzhen Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Baihao Yinzhen Tea is a distinctive perfume that is reminiscent of the wonderful and rich aromas of luxurious white teas. Rich, green notes are balanced with light citrusy tones to lift and brighten, while intense woody notes are added to give a layer of depth and complexity. The result is a flawless fresh tea scent that is strong and refreshing.

products.name: Demeter Cherry Blossom by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cherry Blossom by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Head east and experience Japanese culture at its finest with the Demeter Cherry Blossom perfume. The fragrance embraces the gentle and delicate nature of the cherry blossom and lets you experience these blooms for yourself. Cherry notes join this fresh scent to add a hint of sweetness.

products.name: Demeter Cannabis Flower by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cannabis Flower by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Bob Marley famously said that cannabis can be the healing of a nation. Demeter Cannabis Flower fully embodies this wonderful belief in a fragrance that perfectly captures the smell of hydroponically-grown, Humboldt-county marijuana; no seeds or stems in this bottle! There’s a delightful floral note with undertones of smoke, green leaves and sweet herbs for an unforgettable aroma that tells the world you are approachable and laid-back.

products.name: Demeter Chipotle Pepper by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chipotle Pepper by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The Demeter Chipotle Pepper perfume is a spicy and fun fragrance! This fragrance takes the fresh and invigorating flavor of the red chili pepper and packages it into a classic glass bottle. Don’t expect to experience the overwhelming heat of chipotle.

products.name: Demeter Chipotle Pepper by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chipotle Pepper by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women

products.title_raw: Demeter Sunshine by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
