products.name: Demeter Clean Skin by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Clean Skin by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter’s 2012 fragrance, Demeter Clean Skin, recreates the scent of having just stepped out of a refreshing shower. The bright top notes contain tart bursts of lemon and bergamot balanced by the sweet citrus of orange. Middle notes include the fleshy scent of peach paired with the distinctly feminine aroma of rose.

products.name: Demeter Chamomile Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chamomile Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Looking for an exotic fragrance that is still wearable? Then the Demeter Chamomile Tea is the one for you. This perfume only includes two ingredients: chamomile and tea.

products.name: Demeter Christmas Tree by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Christmas Tree by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Nothing evokes the cheer of the holidays quite like a Christmas tree. Demeter Christmas Tree by Demeter is a fragrance that seeks to encompass all the best memories of gifts beneath the pine boughs with a fresh, citrusy scent. This perfume holds notes of ripe orange for a traditional Christmas treat, woodsy fir for the perfect classic tree, refreshing mint cool as winter nights and a dash of spicy ginger for those warm evenings spent decorating cookies.

products.name: Demeter Calypso Orchid by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Calypso Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Calypso, launched by perfumer Demeter in 2015, captures the rare and exquisite beauty of the delicate Calypso orchid. This vanilla-scented flower has long been associated with the fantastical and whimsical for its slipper-shaped petals. Sweet, seductive and sultry, breathing in this fragrant perfume whisks one away to an exotic flower garden, intoxicating the senses and clearing the mind.

products.name: Demeter Daisy by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Daisy by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A bright, floral fragrance, Demeter Daisy was released in 2012 and adds an innocent and feminine touch to your days. It is light and airy, evoking memories of sunshine and spring meadows. With its classic flowery aroma, this perfume is herbal, green and slightly sweet.

products.name: Demeter Dulce De Leche by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Dulce De Leche by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Dulce de leche, Spanish for sweet milk, is a South American confection made by slow-cooking sweet milk until it’s highly concentrated, while the gentle heat creates new flavor compounds using the same gourmet process that browns meats and vegetables. Demeter Dulce De Leche perfume is delightfully faithful to the real flavor; much like caramel but less sweet, with fascinating undertones and perhaps a bit powdery. Creamy milk is very noticeable, and hints of coconut, wheat and spice complete the subtleties of this delicious scent.

products.name: Demeter Espresso by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Espresso by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Life can be quite hectic these days; time like that, you need your favorite comfort foods. Demeter Espresso perfume is dedicated to recreating the precise expresso scent, exactly like a freshly-brewed cup of coffee. Demeter only creates unique, single-note perfumes, so that they can get each fragrance to match real items from your life.

products.name: Demeter Fuzzy Navel by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fuzzy Navel by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The simple yet refreshing sweetness of a classic 1980s cocktail is brought to life in Demeter Fuzzy Navel. Launched in 2000, this aromatic fruity women’s fragrance from Demeter combines citrusy, alcohol, fruity and powdery accords. Like this favorite throwback drink, it combines peach schnapps and orange juice.

products.name: Demeter Honeysuckle by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Honeysuckle by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Demeter in 1998, Demeter Honeysuckle is a subtle floral fragrance for women. Perhaps the scent of this flower brings back memories of childhood days spent outdoors in the warm spring and summer months, or it is a reminder of someone special. Maybe it is simply a scent that you like.

products.name: Demeter Hawaiian Vanilla by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Hawaiian Vanilla by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Though simple in design, there’s nothing plain about Demeter Hawaiian Vanilla, a women’s cologne from Demeter Fragrance Library. Hawaii provides the perfect conditions for cultivating vanilla blossoms—rich volcanic soil nourished by plenty of rain, sun and sea breezes. The result is high-quality vanilla beans, warm and pleasantly aromatic, that are the source of this remarkable fragrance.

products.name: Demeter Apple Blossom by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Apple Blossom by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Embrace the warm days of spring and summer with Demeter Apple Blossom. Launched in 2007 by Demeter, this bright and fruity perfume has the light and delicate scent of the blossoming apple tree that adds a subtle floral note. The addition of fresh apple gives a sweet and airy aroma that is clean and refreshing.

products.name: Demeter Marshmallow by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Marshmallow by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Marshmallow was released as part of this company’s Sweet Delights collection. Although it is indeed sugary and sweet, this fragrance is light, airy and never overbearing. Vanilla lovers will enjoy finding something slightly different in this creamy aroma.

products.name: Demeter Caramel by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Caramel by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For women who want their sweet side to noticeably shine, Demeter Caramel is a delightfully sugary and syrupy scent that makes one yearn for decadent desserts. Released in 2007 by perfume house Demeter, this perfume doesn’t hold back on its tantalizing aroma. Rich and buttery, one spritz emits the delectable taste of buttery caramel.

products.name: Demeter Cinnamon Bark by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cinnamon Bark by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Cinnamon Bark by Demeter is a light scent that allows its core note to truly shine. The spicy fragrance of cinnamon steals the show, with just the faintest touch of bark for depth. Don’t expect sweet here – this aroma is raw and organic, meant to embody the cinnamon spice as an element in its own right.

products.name: Demeter Ginger Cookie by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Ginger Cookie by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Sugar, spice and everything nice come together for the delightful fragrance of Demeter Ginger Cookie. Designed by Demeter with the aim to create scents which are exactly what they’re labeled, this perfume for women has all the components of a delicious ginger cookie, giving you the scent of both the sugary sweetness of vanilla and the crisp and fresh spice of ginger, clove and cinnamon. The smells remain and do not get covered up by any others, delighting the nose with only the fresh scent of ginger cookies.

products.name: Demeter New Leaf by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter New Leaf by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: An aromatic green fragrance for women, Demeter New Leaf brings you the tender freshness of a new plant. Delicate and determined, it might be said that the perfume captures you perfectly. It's the type of scent that conjures feelings of newness and hope.

products.name: Demeter Mojito by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mojito by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Part of the Happy Hour collection, Demeter Mojito is a refreshing and bright fragrance created by Demeter for men and women. Inspired by the popular drink, this perfume features strong notes of rum mixed with lime and mint. The sweetness of sugar completes the composition.

products.name: Demeter Mojito by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mojito by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Part of the Happy Hour collection, Demeter Mojito is a refreshing and bright fragrance created by Demeter for men and women. Inspired by the popular drink, this perfume features strong notes of rum mixed with lime and mint. The sweetness of sugar completes the composition.

products.name: Demeter Mojito by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mojito by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Part of the Happy Hour collection, Demeter Mojito is a refreshing and bright fragrance created by Demeter for men and women. Inspired by the popular drink, this perfume features strong notes of rum mixed with lime and mint. The sweetness of sugar completes the composition.

products.name: Demeter Patchouli by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Patchouli by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Perfume lovers know that patchouli has an undeserved reputation for smelling synthetic or cheap. Demeter Patchouli from Demeter is the opposite of the patchouli you grew up with. The earthy, herbal scent has a hint of sweetness and brings to mind images of walking in a shaded forest.

products.name: Demeter Peach by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Peach by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: On lazy, warm summer days, nothing is sweeter or more satisfying than the scent of peaches, fresh from the orchard. Demeter Peach by Demeter captures the smell of ripe peaches, mellow and juicy with just a hint of a floral accent. This fragrance is ideal for spring and summer use.

products.name: Demeter Pink Grapefruit by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pink Grapefruit by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Pink Grapefruit is a refreshing scent inspired by the tart, juicy fragrance of your favorite healthy breakfast. This sweet but just slightly bitter scent captures the essence of this popular fruit, with a unique finish that qualifies it as your signature scent. Demeter’s single-note fragrances are designed to wear alone or layer with one another, formulated with the mission of evoking specific memories of time and place.

products.name: Demeter Pumpkin Pie by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pumpkin Pie by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The U.S.-based fragrance house of Demeter had perfect timing when launching the perfume Demeter Pumpkin Pie in 2011.

products.name: Demeter Provence Meadow by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Provence Meadow by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Wrap yourself in the refreshing scent of Demeter Provence Meadow cologne. Released in 2014, this perfume features aromatic green and spicy accords that embody the most fragrant herbs of Provence. Notes of lavender, fennel, thyme, rosemary, and basil blend into a soothing herbal fragrance that gives you the boost you need to start your day.

products.name: Demeter Rain by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Rain by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Rain, a unisex fragrance, welcomed spring showers when it was launched by the fragrance house of Demeter in April of 2009. Even just a quick smell of the perfume transports you to the outdoors after a heavy downpour, where you take in the aromas of fresh rain and wet earth. The scent has a refreshingly simple composition and features only rejuvenating and renewing rain notes.

products.name: Demeter Russian Leather by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Russian Leather by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Russian Leather is women’s fragrance that contains the single fragrance note of leather. Its main accords are animalic, smoky, and woody. Best for fall and winter day wear, the perfume has light longevity and soft sillage.

products.name: Demeter Strawberry Ice Cream by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Strawberry Ice Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: With notes of strawberry, custard, and whipped cream, Demeter Strawberry Ice Cream is a nice gourmand fragrance for sunny summer days. The soft sillage and light longevity make it perfect for the work day or big gatherings in crowded rooms. Launched in the 2000's, this sweet scent has been popular for years.

products.name: Demeter Sticky Toffe Pudding by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sticky Toffe Pudding by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For a true gourmand fragrance experience, try Demeter Sticky Toffee Pudding. This delicious recreation of a cherished dessert has the note of toffee for a sweet, sensual scent. With its heavy sillage and good longevity, this fragrance is guaranteed to bring back memories of special occasions and holiday desserts.

products.name: Demeter Sandalwood by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sandalwood by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Sandalwood, a woody fragrance for men and women, has balsamic, powdery, and warm spicy main accords. Best for fall and winter day wear, this scent has the sole fragrance note of sandalwood. Though the sillage is moderate, the longevity is brief.

products.name: Demeter Tomato by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tomato by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced to the market by Demeter in 1996, Demeter Tomato is a fragrance for women. The strong yet, mesmerizing tomato note present a strong, yet pleasant green scent that leaves one wanting more. With moderate silage and a nice, long-lasting impression, the embodies every aspect of the tomato plant, from the stem to the blossoms and leaves.

products.name: Demeter Watermelon Lollipop by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Watermelon Lollipop by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Remember the feeling of entering a soda stand or candy shop with this floral fruity gourmand scent from Demeter. Demeter Watermelon Lollipop is full of sweet, aquatic and ozonic accords that all stem from the dominant watermelon note that pervades this fragrance. Remember the feeling of delicious candy lollipops as you apply this perfume and be reminded of simpler times as it dries.

products.name: Demeter Pina Colada by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pina Colada by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Fruity, boozy and sweet, Demeter Pina Colada is just as delicious as its namesake. With hints of coconut cream, light rum and fresh pineapple, this fragrance will remind you of sunny, summer days. It is a lush and deep scent, with a hint of tropical citrus to balance out the richness.

products.name: Demeter Salt Air by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Salt Air by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Salt Air is a men’s and women’s aromatic aquatic fragrance with marine and salty main accords. Demeter, an American nice perfume house, is known for its single note fragrances that use as few ingredients as possible. However, this elixir has two fragrance notes, which are sea water and salt.

products.name: Demeter Sugar Cane by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sugar Cane by Demeter Cologne Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Surround yourself with the divine sweetness of Demeter Sugar Cane. Crafted and released by the fragrance house of Demeter, this non-fussy unisex fragrance is a delightful treasure with its innocent simplicity. The scent harbors just one fragrance note, which is sweetly-spun sugar cane.

products.name: Demeter Sugar Cane by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sugar Cane by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Surround yourself with the divine sweetness of Demeter Sugar Cane. Crafted and released by the fragrance house of Demeter, this non-fussy unisex fragrance is a delightful treasure with its innocent simplicity. The scent harbors just one fragrance note, which is sweetly-spun sugar cane.

products.name: Demeter Sex On The Beach by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sex On The Beach by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Sex On The Beach is a women’s aromatic fruity perfume with sweet, vodka, fresh, and tropical main accords. Because it is influenced by the cocktail of the same name, this scent has multiple fragrance notes, such as pineapple, vodka, melon, raspberry, and cranberry. It’s great for summer day wear, with short longevity and sillage ranging from moderate to heavy.

products.name: Demeter Devil's Food by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Devil's Food by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Devil’s Food perfume smells just like the real thing: a dark chocolate cake with chocolate icing freshly spread on top of it. Be careful: you may want to drink the bottle! You can almost taste the buttery icing, savory, warm vanilla and the hint of wheat flour underneath.

products.name: Demeter Wet Garden by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Wet Garden by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The essence of early spring captured in fragrance form, Demeter Wet garden is a simple, nostalgic scent that mingles elements of rainwater and sheer florals with delicate hints of rich earth. The opening is clean and fresh, fusing green aquatic accords with a blossomy blend of hyacinth, rose and violet. The scent becomes more earthy and powdery as it settles, leaving a light and clean floral trail.

products.name: Demeter Freesia by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Freesia by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Freesia is a floral fragrance for women with a characteristic refreshing scent. Like other releases from Demeter, this perfume’s aromatic profile consists of a single note. Freesia’s distinctive green and peppery aroma has made it a prized inclusion in many fragrances, but it also gives this blend an enchanting and delicate beauty.

products.name: Demeter Freesia by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Freesia by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Freesia is a floral fragrance for women with a characteristic refreshing scent. Like other releases from Demeter, this perfume’s aromatic profile consists of a single note. Freesia’s distinctive green and peppery aroma has made it a prized inclusion in many fragrances, but it also gives this blend an enchanting and delicate beauty.

products.name: Demeter Fresh Ginger by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fresh Ginger by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Fresh Ginger is the perfect unisex fragrance to spice up your day. Prized for centuries for its scent, flavor and health benefits, ginger plays the starring role in this fresh spicy perfume. Similar to other creations from Demeter, it features a single note meant to captivate and reveal all of its nuances.

products.name: Demeter First Love by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter First Love by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: You’ll never forget your first love; the novelty can’t be described to those who haven’t experienced it. touchingly shy yet excited; nervous and expectant; you know no one has ever loved before as you do now! Demeter First Love captures this amazing experience in a perfume; very soft and feminine, it’s a spritz of Valentine’s day in a bottle.

products.name: Demeter Frozen Margarita by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Frozen Margarita by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Although it’s composed of only two notes, Demeter Frozen Margarita is a pleasantly refreshing and sophisticated scent. This unisex fragrance is composed of fresh lime and tequila, resulting in an aromatic profile that smells citrusy and aromatic with bits of green and bitter undertones. As a crisp and cool perfume, it’s an ideal pick-me-up for daytime wear.

products.name: Demeter Fuzzy Sweater by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fuzzy Sweater by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Just like its name suggests, Demeter Fuzzy Sweater envelopes you in a deliciously cozy scent that lingers pleasantly throughout the day. This aromatic fragrance for women contains only two notes, fabric and wool. The combination results in a warm, soft and mildly earthy aroma that’s also light, understated and fun to wear.

products.name: Demeter Fruit Salad by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fruit Salad by Demeter Cologne Spray (Formerly Jelly Belly ) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Cool, crisp and fruity aromas come together in this fragrance for women from Demeter. As one of the brand’s few multi-note compositions, Demeter Fruit Salad combines fresh, sweet peach and honey-like tangerine in its heart. Playing key supporting roles are ripe pear and raspberry, lending delicately juicy and tart essences to the scent.

products.name: Demeter Grass by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Grass by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Grass was launched in 1996 as one of this company’s three original fragrances. Refreshing and green, it perfectly captures the smell of a newly mowed lawn. This perfume is invigorating and slightly sweet and will evoke a wistfulness for the great outdoors.

products.name: Demeter Gingerale by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Gingerale by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For the dry scent of your favorite soda, take a whiff of Demeter Gingerale. The subtle sweetness blends well with the spices and citrusy tones to this distinctive smell, practically giving you that bubbly sensation in your nose. This singular scent was created by Demeter, designed to remain only one smell that is not overrun or overpowered by any others.

products.name: Demeter Ginseng Root by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Ginseng Root by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The fragrance of Demeter Ginseng Root takes on the scent of one of China’s most ancient and trusted medicinal herbs. Designed by the brand Demeter, named after the goddess of harvest, this natural scent is exactly what it says on the label, smelling of ginseng root. This perfume for women has a very natural and herbal scent, which is fresh and unique and will not be overpowered by any other smells.

products.name: Demeter Giant Sequoia by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Giant Sequoia by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The giant sequoia tree is a grand and majestic sight as one of the largest living things in the world, so embrace the boldness and confidence with Demeter Giant Sequoia. The brand Demeter is named after the goddess of the harvest, creating perfumes which are a single natural scent untouched by others. This fragrance for women is a fresh and woody scent, giving a spicy and lasting overtone that won’t be diluted by any other fragrances.

products.name: Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the deliciousness of the frozen treat, Demeter Hot Fudge Sundae is a sweet fragrance for women that features both rich and fruity scent notes. Smelling strongly of chocolate fudge, this perfume from Demeter is a great choice for casual occasions, perhaps a fun night out with the girls. Notes of vanilla, whipped cream and cherry, necessary ingredients for every sundae, complete the fragrance.

products.name: Demeter Holy Water by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Holy Water by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Strange but familiar, difficult to describe with notes but unmistakable when experienced—this is Demeter Holy Water, a 2009 unisex scent created by the Us fragrance company Demeter. The fragrance is designed to recreate not just the holy water used in ceremonies but the whole experience surrounding it. It leads the imagination towards an old chapel filled with polished oak pews, a porcelain font warmed by the sun and hints of incense in the air.

products.name: Demeter Honey by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Honey by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: True to its name, Demeter Honey fragrance has one note, honey. This honey scent has nice warm undertones that linger beautifully throughout the day. It does have an enormous sillage, so take care to use it sparingly in small spaces.

products.name: Demeter Jasmine by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Jasmine by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: From the Demeter Fragrance Library comes Demeter Jasmine, a single-note women’s fragrance released in 2009. This composition features Spanish jasmine, a warm and intoxicating white flower that often plays a star role in many perfumes. Here, the jasmine is allowed to manifest its brilliance with its intensely warm, green and sweet aroma that also reveals mildly woody undertones.

products.name: Blue Jeans by Versace
products.type_raw: Eau De Toilette Spray (New Packaging) 2.5 oz
products.title_raw: Blue Jeans by Versace Eau De Toilette Spray (New Packaging) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by the design house of Gianni Versace in 1994, Blue Jeans is classified as a sharp, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of woodsy, citrus notes. It is recommended for daytime wear.

products.name: Blue Jeans by Versace
products.type_raw: Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester New Packaging) 2.5 oz
products.title_raw: Blue Jeans by Versace Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester New Packaging) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by the design house of Gianni Versace in 1994, Blue Jeans is classified as a sharp, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of woodsy, citrus notes. It is recommended for daytime wear.

products.name: Demeter Lava Rock by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lava Rock by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Lava Rock Perfume by Demeter

products.name: Demeter Lavender by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lavender by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Lavender is a floral herb prized for its calming properties. It’s also the star player in Demeter Lavender, released in 1995 as a floral green unisex fragrance with a powdery soft scent. Like other single-note offerings from Demeter, Lavender lets this sole olfactory note shine and reveal its aromatic, camphoraceous and licorice-like undertones.

products.name: Demeter Linen by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Linen by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Linen is a fresh, crisp, subtle scent inspired by the feel and aroma of sunlight-dried sheets on a freshly-made bed. As one of the oldest textiles in the world, Linen was used as a symbol of light and purity by the ancient Egyptians. Today, it’s prized for its soft texture and cooling properties.

products.name: Demeter Log Cabin by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Log Cabin by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Log Cabin evokes the experience of a snowy winter weekend at a cozy remote cabin with your loved ones. The unisex fragrance is characterized by rich, earthy wood notes, including oakmoss, Virginia cedar and Texas cedar. Smoky, sweet and green aromas combine to create this subtle yet sexy scent.

products.name: Demeter Lemon Meringue by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lemon Meringue by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Lemon Meringue is as light and fluffy as its namesake pie. This is the third lemon fragrance released by Demeter, a brand that specializes in evocative single-note scents. This version is bright and invigorating, pairing the classic tartness of lemon with creamy, sweet vanilla undertones that provide a feminine countenance to the pure citrus notes.

products.name: Demeter Orange Cream Pop by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Orange Cream Pop by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released as part of the Sweet Delights collection, Demeter Orange Cream Pop is summertime in a bottle. This fragrance will bring you back to childhoods spent chasing after the ice cream truck and the joy of an icy treat. This perfume from Demeter incorporates notes of vanilla and orange with sweet whipped cream and water notes to create the familiar scent.

products.name: Demeter Sambuca by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sambuca by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Sambuca is a men’s and women’s fragrance with a single fragrance note of Sambuca, an Italian liqueur flavored with anise and infused with elderflower and licorice. The liqueur is also sweetened with sugar and contains a proprietary combination of herbs and spices to give it its unique taste. The scent is best for fall night wear and has moderate longevity and sillage ranging between moderate and enormous.

products.name: Demeter Lilac by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lilac by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Lilac is a 2009 fragrance released as part of the brand’s Spring Is in the Air collection. This single-note scent is designed to evoke the intoxicating aroma of these gorgeous purple blooms that signify the full swing of spring. Fans of this scent say it smells exactly like a lilac bush, so you can have that new beginnings feeling all year long.

products.name: Demeter Pixie Dust by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pixie Dust by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A delicious gourmand perfume, Demeter Pixie Dust is a wonderful floral fruity addition to your fragrance collection. It was launched in 2013 by Demeter Fragrance, a company that creates scents inspired by everyday aromas. The two notes in this perfume are sugar and fruity notes, which combine to invoke a youthful ambience.

products.name: Demeter Mountain Air by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mountain Air by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the atmosphere of Alaskan mountains, Demeter Mountain Air attempts to bottle the awe-inspiring feeling of the expansive landscape by combining floral and earthy notes. It was released by Demeter in 2015 and is a great choice for both men and women. Green and woody notes transport you to a beautiful mountainside surrounded by trees and fresh air.

products.name: Demeter Kitten Fur by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Kitten Fur by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Kitten Fur Perfume by Demeter

products.name: Demeter Suntan Lotion by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Suntan Lotion by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2000, Demeter Suntan Lotion is the epitome of summer fun and joy. Crafted by the Pennsylvania-based fragrance brand Demeter, the women’s perfume is meant to brilliantly ignite memories of and feelings for luxuriating in the bright sun rays of summer. The fresh white floral scent bursts with the singular intoxicating fragrance note of orange blossom.

products.name: Demeter New Baby by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter New Baby by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter New Baby is a unique and unexpected delight of a scent. Released in 2015 by the popular fragrance house of Demeter, this unisex perfume is light and sheer, making it perfect for wearing on its own or layering with your own personal favorite scents. Spritz on the fragrance and enjoy the pure happiness and joy of taking in the aroma of a cuddly and soft new baby.

products.name: Demeter Neroli by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Neroli by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Neroli is a single-note perfume from Demeter that focuses on the oil produced by the bitter orange tree. This oil smells both floral and fruity, offering a lovely and unique scent. While it works well on its own for a soft and subtle every day fragrance, this perfume is also a great choice for layering.

products.name: Demeter New Zealand by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter New Zealand by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: This unisex fragrance is part of Demeter's Destination Collection and released in 2003.  It is a aromatic green perfume that both men and women can wear.  Inspired by the intriguing outdoors of New Zealand.

products.name: Demeter Oud by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Oud by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Created using only the scent note of agarwood, Demeter Oud is an intriguing fragrance for both women and men that was released by Demeter in 2013. Agarwood is a complex scent that is both woody and sweet. While you can wear this fragrance alone, as it provides a rich scent on its own, it is particularly suited to layering and will add depth to other perfumes.

products.name: Demeter Oud by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Oud by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Created using only the scent note of agarwood, Demeter Oud is an intriguing fragrance for both women and men that was released by Demeter in 2013. Agarwood is a complex scent that is both woody and sweet. While you can wear this fragrance alone, as it provides a rich scent on its own, it is particularly suited to layering and will add depth to other perfumes.

products.name: Demeter Orange Blossom by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Orange Blossom by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Orange Blossom is a lovely, light scent that can be worn by both men and women. Featuring only the single scent note of orange blossoms, this perfume from Demeter is great for layering to create your own personalized scent. It is also wonderful on its own, providing the subtle scent of the white flowers found on the orange tree.

products.name: Demeter Pizza by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pizza by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For an unusual scent that appeals to men and women, try Demeter Pizza. This aromatic fruity fragrance features a blend of tomato, oregano, and cheese notes for an amazingly accurate recreation of the popular food. It was created in 2013 by Demeter Fragrance, a company that uses simples note combinations to evoke everyday memories and experiences.

products.name: Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A sweet, nutty fragrance, Demeter Pistachio Ice Cream was released in 2014 for dessert lovers everywhere. It is bold and attention-getting, with a savory, enticing aroma. It is a well-balanced blend that can be enjoyed all year long—just like ice cream.

products.name: Demeter Pure Soap by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pure Soap by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Experience the calming and relaxing benefits of taking a long lounge in the bath any time of the day when you surround yourself with the fresh aroma of Demeter Pure Soap. Launched by the fragrance brand Demeter in 2009, the women’s perfume perfectly captures the comforting and refreshing scent of newly-cleaned and scrubbed skin. The fragrance leaves behind a faint aroma that smells of Ivory Soap.

products.name: Demeter Pruning Shears by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pruning Shears by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Transport yourself to a fresh spring garden or a classy outdoor tea with Demeter Pruning Shears cologne. This 1998 release features the scents of rose absolute and Bulgarian roses balanced by the essence of green grass. True to its name, this Demeter fragrance features a subtle a metallic tang reminiscent of pruning shears, but a recent reformulation places the roses in the spotlight.

products.name: Demeter Quince by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Quince by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released by the popular fragrance brand Demeter, the women’s perfume Demeter Quince needs but one intoxicating note to make a statement. The simple uplifting scent contains the single bright and zesty note from the quince fruit. The smell of the fruit is likened to a cross between a juicy pear and a ripe apple.

products.name: Demeter Riding Crop by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Riding Crop by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Riding Crop is a leather men’s and women’s fragrance from Demeter with animalic, smoky, and woody main accords. The single fragrance note is leather, particularly the aroma from worn leather, which adds sensuality, spiciness and warmth to this concoction. There is a faint floral undertone that gives this scent some subtlety.

products.name: Demeter Red Poppies by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Red Poppies by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Red Poppies is a women’s floral fragrance that was announced by Demeter in 2009. This single note scent has red poppy as its fragrance note. This sensual, brilliant perfume was inspired by soft, undying large groups of wildflowers, known for their velvety petals, growing in fields during a warm summer evening.

products.name: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced in 2003 by Demeter, Demeter Spring Break is a fresh and exciting scent for women that brings about visions of fun, excitement and spring break. The intoxicating blend of coconut, coumarin and its marine-like undertones deliver a sweet and yet subtle and fresh punch that invades the senses. The mellow yet refreshing fragrance leaves passersby with beachside lingering thoughts of relaxation, peace and tropical vacation happiness.

products.name: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Spring Break by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced in 2003 by Demeter, Demeter Spring Break is a fresh and exciting scent for women that brings about visions of fun, excitement and spring break. The intoxicating blend of coconut, coumarin and its marine-like undertones deliver a sweet and yet subtle and fresh punch that invades the senses. The mellow yet refreshing fragrance leaves passersby with beachside lingering thoughts of relaxation, peace and tropical vacation happiness.

products.name: Demeter Dragon Fruit by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Dragon Fruit by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Dragon Fruit perfume is a unique and incredibly natural-smelling fragrance featuring dragon fruit as its single note. This fruit is not quite like any other – native to the Americas, it’s very exotic-looking and lightly sweet – just like this perfume. The scent is bubbling with juiciness, with a mild sweetness; like a berry, but not sugary at all.

products.name: Demeter Sweet Pea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sweet Pea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The sight of a delicate sweet pea trailing up a trellis is one of the surefire signs of spring, and this old-fashioned bloom still graces many a garden. Demeter Sweet Pea from Demeter seeks to duplicate the smell of these small, dainty blossoms. It has a sweet floral scent with a fresh, green finish.

products.name: Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A crisp, clean and floral fragrance that develops over time, Demeter Silvery Tip Pekoe was first introduced in 2014 by Demeter and awakens the senses while leaving passersby guessing. The balanced, invigorating and earthy impression slowly gives way to a citrusy blend of lemon juice, guava, mango, orange liqueur, passion fruit and green and white tea that hints at the original floral scent and leaves a strong, lasting and unforgettable impression of its namesake, Silvery Tip white tea.

products.name: Demeter Saddle by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Saddle by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Saddle is a leather men’s and women’s fragrance from Demeter with animalic, woody, and smoky main accords. Ideal for fall season wear on its own or as a layer underneath other aromas, this scent has brief longevity and soft sillage. With its singular fragrance note of leather, this potion was created to evoke memories or fantasies of riding horses.

products.name: Demeter Tomato Seeds by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tomato Seeds by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 1996 by the fragrance house of Demeter, the crisp, fresh and invigorating Demeter Tomato Seeds scent is all women. The crisp and intoxicating top note of tomato gives the perfect blend of green, spicy tomato berry scent without overpowering the senses. Exudes sophistication and class while leaving behind a bit of mystery to all who smell the mesmerizing aroma of tomato, fruit, and earthiness and leave mouths and hearts watering and wanting for more.

products.name: Demeter Chai Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chai Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Relax for a while with the warm and spicy aromas of Demeter Chai Tea. This perfume captures the wholesome essence of this timeless drink with notes of clove, cardamom and cinnamon. Other notes of star anise, pepper and ginger continue this drink’s spicy spirit.

products.name: Demeter Violet by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Violet by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Violet by Demeter is a floral fragrance made up primarily of a dominant violet linear note that pervades throughout the top, middle and bottom of the perfume. Powdery, woody accords compliment the violet flower, offering a sweet aroma with soft sillage and short to moderate longevity. Wear it everywhere, apply often and use it any time of the year.

products.name: Demeter Caribbean Sea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Caribbean Sea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Take a dip into clear waters with the fresh aroma of the Demeter Caribbean Sea perfume. This item contains only one ingredient, sea water. By highlighting this note, you can experience the beauty of the sea in its purest form.

products.name: Demeter Gardenia by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Gardenia by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Smell as sweet and delicate as the tropical flower with Demeter Gardenia. Designed by Demeter, named after the goddess of the harvest, this perfume for women is simple yet powerful. Taking on only the scent of gardenia flowers, you will remain smelling floral throughout the day without changing scent notes.

products.name: Demeter Great Barrier Reef by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Great Barrier Reef by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2015 as part of this company’s Destination Collection, Demeter Great Barrier Reef was designed to evoke thoughts of the beautiful Pacific Ocean and the gorgeous coral that rests in its waters. This fragrance is sweet and powdery, with hints of a salty sea breeze. It is a perfect summer aroma that will have you longing to bury your toes in the sand.

products.name: Demeter Lavender Martini by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lavender Martini by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A timeless floral scent gets an unexpected twist in Demeter Lavender Martini. This women’s fragrance contains citrusy, aromatic, sweet, fresh spicy and floral accords. Lavender imparts its calming herbal aroma, but this perfume is anything but sedate with a distinctively punchy blend representing the classic martini.

products.name: Demeter Tangerine by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tangerine by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: In the midst of the bleak winter months, one bright spot is the arrival of tangerine season. These oblong fruits, so juicy and easier to peel than oranges, have an invigorating, fresh scent. Demeter Tangerine by Demeter delivers an energizing blast in fragrance form, with a fruity citrus scent that is similar to oranges, but with a sweet, honeyed finish.

products.name: Demeter Thailand by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Thailand by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: There is nothing quite like the experience of browsing through and purchasing spices in the open-air markets of Thailand. The chaotic action and hubbub highlight the warm and stimulating atmosphere. It is this scent that Demeter reproduces in Demeter Thailand.

products.name: Demeter Thailand by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Thailand by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: There is nothing quite like the experience of browsing through and purchasing spices in the open-air markets of Thailand. The chaotic action and hubbub highlight the warm and stimulating atmosphere. It is this scent that Demeter reproduces in Demeter Thailand.

products.name: Demeter Amber by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Amber by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Amber is a playful, seductive fragrance for women. The warm aroma of amber is inviting and sultry, as well as uplifting. This sweet and refined scent is suitable to wear during the day and for those special nights out.

products.name: Demeter Butterscotch by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Butterscotch by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Create a sweet and irresistible allure with Demeter Butterscotch. Crafted by Demeter, a unique perfumer that captures the essence of single scents, this perfume may make people’s mouths water. This scent is like unwrapping a buttery richness that oozes a smooth and sugary intoxicating aroma, which warms the senses on a cool or cold day.

products.name: Demeter Barbados Cherry by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Barbados Cherry by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A bright, tart-sweet fragrance, Demeter Barbados Cherry evokes the bounty of spring and summer in the tropics. Dab on a little and wait for the mouth-watering scent of its signature cherries to consume you and those in your company. You'll all enjoy a hint of tropical splendor and the accompanying feeling of well-being and optimism.

products.name: Demeter Black Ginger by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Black Ginger by Demeter Cologne Spray (formerly Kahala ) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2012, Demeter Black Ginger is packed full of ginger, ginger flower and spices. Distinct for its spicy nature, the fragrance is both energizing and warming. If you're looking for a long-lasting perfume that celebrates one of the most beloved roots in nature, turn to this full-bodied offering from Demeter.

products.name: Demeter Blue Spruce by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Blue Spruce by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2016, Demeter Blue Spruce perfume fulfills your belief that Christmas should come every day. From the aromatic group of fragrances, this perfume features signature spruce and ozonic notes that conjure feelings of pure health and festivity. Dash on a little of this enticing Demeter fragrance and let your olfactory senses take over.

products.name: Demeter Baby Shampoo by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Baby Shampoo by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Baby Shampoo, launched by the fragrance house of Demeter in 2016, is a light and gentle perfume that is suitable for both women and men. The fresh, powdery aroma of baby shampoo dries to a subtle, slightly sweet scent that is mild and calming. This clean, natural fragrance has a soft sillage and is not overpowering.

products.name: Demeter Beeswax by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Beeswax by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2008, Demeter Beeswax is an oriental floral fragrance for women. With its sweet animalic notes, you could be excused for shirking work and fleeing to the woods! Composed of beeswax, flower pollen and honey, this slightly powdery perfume from Demeter is at once soothing and enlivening.

products.name: Demeter Cuba by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cuba by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced as a member of the Destination Collection in 2015, Demeter Cuba by Demeter aims to take you away to the sunny shores of its namesake country. This fragrance is a tantalizing combination of the island’s most well-known exports with notes of sugar cane, sharp spices and earthy tobacco. A touch of rich vanilla and smoky whiskey provide depth.

products.name: Demeter Cuba by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cuba by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced as a member of the Destination Collection in 2015, Demeter Cuba by Demeter aims to take you away to the sunny shores of its namesake country. This fragrance is a tantalizing combination of the island’s most well-known exports with notes of sugar cane, sharp spices and earthy tobacco. A touch of rich vanilla and smoky whiskey provide depth.

products.name: Demeter Christmas in New York by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Christmas in New York by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Christmas in New York by Demeter is a festive scent evocative of a December night spent in Times Square. Released in 2009, this unisex perfume begins with top notes of warm spices like cinnamon mixed with crisp apple, crowned with the sugary delight of candied chestnuts. The delicious aroma then moves into base notes of rum and cream.

products.name: Demeter Dark Chocolate by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Dark Chocolate by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2013, Demeter Dark Chocolate is a rich, warm fragrance that is comforting and familiar. Sweet and slightly spicy, it is ideal for the woman seeking something different and can be worn during a night out or as an everyday perfume. It is a true chocolaty aroma and is creamy and familiar without turning bitter.

products.name: Demeter Fresh Hay by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fresh Hay by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Enjoy a pleasant springtime scent with a nostalgic feel with Demeter Fresh Hay, an aromatic green unisex fragrance. As part of Demeter’s collection of single note scents, it delights the senses a solitary note of hay. This cut and dried grass’s familiar aroma offers sweet, earthy, warm and dry tones that evoke a rustic feel and memories of summer.

products.name: Demeter Ireland by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Ireland by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2016, Demeter Ireland beautifully captures the Emerald Isle’s essence in a fresh, uplifting unisex fragrance. its composition features a blend of green and aquatic notes, similar to the Demeter brand’s other dual-note colognes. The wearer may think of Ireland’s verdant landscapes of rolling hills and expansive fields, along with the breathtaking views of its coastline and its majestic rivers.

products.name: Demeter Nutmeg Ice Cream by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Nutmeg Ice Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: We all scream for Demeter Nutmeg Ice Cream! What more could a woman – or man – want than this simmering scent that features the unstoppable blend of nutmeg, ice cream and sugar? Dab it on whenever you want to entrance the object of your affections.

products.name: Demeter Pineapple by Demeter
products.type_raw: Cologne Spray (Formerly Blue Hawaiian Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Pineapple by Demeter Cologne Spray (Formerly Blue Hawaiian Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Pineapple is a fresh, fruity fragrance with tropical flair. This tart, delicious scent is inspired by the spiny fruit, which is native to the western part of the world and represents one of the top industries of the Hawaiian islands. Fans of this single-note scent say it’s long-lasting and smells exactly like fresh pineapple.

products.name: Demeter Plantain by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Plantain by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Plantain, introduced in 2015, is a fruity scent with one note, banana. It has the aroma of a ripe, sweet banana for a fresh, youthful effect. Demeter Fragrance, founded in Pennsylvania, seeks to create fragrances that evoke memories through simple, natural note combinations featuring fruits, flowers, cakes, and drinks.

products.name: Demeter Raspberry by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Raspberry by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2016 by the U.S. fragrance brand of Demeter, Demeter Raspberry is pure summertime delight and fun in a bottle.

products.name: Demeter Rice Paddy by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Rice Paddy by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Rice Paddy is an aromatic green women’s perfume with fresh, aquatic, savory, nutty, and watery main accords. In 2013, Demeter, an American niche perfume house known for its single note fragrances, launched this energizing and fresh scent, which wears best on spring and summer days. The main fragrance notes are rice leaf and watery notes, which evoke emerging rice, the young and green shoots, and the water of the paddy.

products.name: Demeter String Bean by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter String Bean by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For anyone who has ever harvested or snapped green beans for dinner, Demeter String Bean is sure to bring back the memories. A fresh scent with a single note of string bean, this fragrance is ideal for days when you need a little personal sunshine. Suitable for both women and men, it is crisp, clean, and not overwhelming.

products.name: Demeter String Bean by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter String Bean by Demeter Pick-Me-Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For anyone who has ever harvested or snapped green beans for dinner, Demeter String Bean is sure to bring back the memories. A fresh scent with a single note of string bean, this fragrance is ideal for days when you need a little personal sunshine. Suitable for both women and men, it is crisp, clean, and not overwhelming.

products.name: Demeter Sweet Orange by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sweet Orange by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The smell of a freshly peeled orange, with the remnants of juicy mist still lingering in the air, is invigorating and refreshing. Demeter Sweet Orange, released by Demeter in 2000, captures the essence of a ripe, luscious orange. It has the brightness of citrus, tempered by a mellow sweetness.

products.name: Demeter Sushi by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sushi by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2012, Demeter Sushi is a surprising and unexpected scent sensation. With an aroma of freshly prepared sticky rice and undertones of seaweed, there’s nothing fishy here. The popular U.

products.name: Demeter Tiger Lily by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tiger Lily by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Created by the fragrance house of Demeter, Demeter Tiger Lily is for women. The spicy, yet romantic, dramatic hints with a bold and clear tiger lily tones creates a fresh, soft and long-lasting impression of being in a field by tiger lilies. Bold and simple, but not strong enough to overpower the senses, the soft fragrance invokes the heady, subtle animalistic call of the wild.

products.name: Demeter This is Not A Pipe by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter This is Not A Pipe by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter This is Not A Pipe may not actually be a pipe, but it certainly evokes the rich, oddly addictive aroma of pipe smoke. Introduced by Demeter in 1998, this fragrance contains notes of tobacco, which are warm with sweet undertones, and woods, which are earthy and dry. Together, they create the cozy, comforting feeling of a loved one smoking a pipe.

products.name: Demeter Thunderstorm by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Thunderstorm by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A memorable, yet invigorating fragrance for women, Demeter Thunderstorm was launched in 2002 by Demeter. This scent delivers a subtle and refreshing earthy scent, with hints of patchouli, ozone, dirt and wet undertones that bring to mind favorite memories of thunderstorms and rain. Leaves behind a soft, but masculine punch that leaves passerby curious, intrigued and entranced.

products.name: Demeter Vetiver by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Vetiver by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Based on the earthy note of Vetiver, Demeter Vetiver by Demeter is a feminine perfume designed for compliments. Expect the woody, natural accords to elicit positive comments from close friends, loved ones and complete strangers. This long-lasting scent performs all day or night and holds up during periods of intense activity.

products.name: Demeter Vanilla Ice Cream by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Vanilla Ice Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: An aromatic tribute to a classic dairy treat, Demeter Vanilla Ice Cream is a sumptuous blend of vanilla, milk, watery and sweet notes. Idea for year-round wear by women, the fragrance captures the smooth, creaminess of the ice cream and the luxurious note of vanilla that wafts from your skin upon application. With its moderate longevity and soft sillage, this perfume from Demeter makes a subtle impression and, as the ice cream itself, fully sates your senses.

products.name: Demeter Wildflowers by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Wildflowers by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Beautifully soft and sweet, Demeter Wildflowers is a summery fragrance that captures the fresh vibrancy of a springtime meadow in full bloom. This free-spirited, feminine scent opens with crisp green notes and develops into a breezy floral effusion, lush with nuances of lilac, hyacinth and jasmine and sweetened with undertones of warm honey and powder. This unisex green floral fragrance was released by Demeter Fragrance Library in 2016 and belongs to the extensive Classic collection.

products.name: Demeter Whiskey Tobacco by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Whiskey Tobacco by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Whiskey Tobacco Perfume provides a spicy, smoky experience designed to evoke memories of a fatherly or grandfatherly figure in your life. The combination of sweet and earthy notes makes this an appropriate unisex fragrance and an unexpected signature scent. Fans of this scent say it provides a realistic aroma with moderate lasting power.

products.name: Demeter Earl Grey Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Earl Grey Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: One whiff of Demeter Earl Grey Tea perfume will convince you that you’ve been invited for tea with the Duchess of Cambridge. This fragrance is very accurate to real life and quintessentially English; a blend of the finest black teas infused with just the right amount of cheerful, fruity-sweet bergamot oil. The nuances of fine teas are evident, as is the citrus aroma of bergamot orange.

products.name: Demeter Fig Leaf by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fig Leaf by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: There’s nothing quite like visiting a real fig tree plantation on the sun-drenched Mediterranean coast; fresh ocean breezes float between the bushy fig trees, creating a wonderfully refreshing and relaxing aroma. Demeter Fig Leaf perfume captures the intoxicating scent of ripe fig trees precisely – and at less than half the price of similar-smelling perfumes. This single-note fragrance has lush green fig leaves and sweet, plump figs as its focus.

products.name: Demeter Firefly by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Firefly by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For any kid who grows up east of the Rockies, one of the most treasured signs of spring is the first firefly of the season. In the North, fireflies are a sure sign of winter having broken its grip – and summer vacation is right around the corner! Demeter Firefly is a brilliant scent, capturing the smells and excitement of those spring evenings on the cusp of summer.

products.name: Demeter Flower Show by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Flower Show by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The smell of fresh-cut flowers; a street lined with roses, their fresh-cut stems giving a natural, green scent, and the soft petals dripping with mist. Demeter Flower Show perfume perfectly recreates this incredible scent by copying the world-famous Philadelphia Flower Show in all its glory. A delightful fragrance, it’s very floral with hints of tea rose, gardenia, jasmine and carnations, among many others.

products.name: Demeter Fraser Fir by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fraser Fir by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Classified as woody aromatic unisex fragrance, Demeter Fraser Fir captures the rustic beauty of this classic American evergreen. Named for the familiar tree species native to the Appalachian region, its scent effortless evokes the holiday season with a single fir note. Inspired by the forest and freshly cut Christmas trees, this fresh creation offers a crisp green balsamic aroma that’s a refreshing pick-me-up for day or night.

products.name: Demeter Funeral Home by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Funeral Home by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Funeral Home is a unisex perfume with floral, warm spicy, aromatic and herbal essences. This blend features a core containing lily, a fragrant bloom with a waxy scent, and gladiolus, a flower with a subtly floral aroma. Carnation offers a vivid and spicy effect, and chrysanthemums with stems and leaves included for a hint of fresh green aroma.

products.name: Demeter Geranium by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Geranium by Demeter Cologne Spray (unboxed) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For a slightly spicy, citrusy scent, try the simple smells of Demeter Geranium. The floral scent is achieved by using the unique and rare leaves of the Geranium Bourbon, collected by Demeter—a brand named after the goddess of the harvest. This perfume for women can give you the fragrance of the geranium flower without being overpowering or being snuffed out by other notes.

products.name: Demeter Geranium by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Geranium by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: For a slightly spicy, citrusy scent, try the simple smells of Demeter Geranium. The floral scent is achieved by using the unique and rare leaves of the Geranium Bourbon, collected by Demeter—a brand named after the goddess of the harvest. This perfume for women can give you the fragrance of the geranium flower without being overpowering or being snuffed out by other notes.

products.name: Demeter Gingerbread by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Gingerbread by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Perfect for the Christmas season or any time of the year where you want this sweet and spicy cookie, Demeter Gingerbread can give you the fragrance of the delicious cookie as if you had just been baking them. Designed by Demeter to be a simple scent that is not overpowering and does not fade away into other fragrances, this perfume for women smells of ginger, vanilla and sugar—all the best scents of a gingerbread cookie.

products.name: Demeter Golden Delicious by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Golden Delicious by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Juicy, crisp and sweet, Demeter Golden Delicious has the scent of the wonderful yellow apples it is named after. This perfume for women gives off the fresh scent of golden delicious apples with all their delightful qualities and smells—nothing more and nothing less. Created by Demeter, this fragrance is designed to only hold the smell of the golden delicious apple, remaining simple but not overpowering.

products.name: Demeter Grapefruit Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Grapefruit Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Grapefruit Tea is a bright, fruity fragrance that will wake you up and bring a smile to your face. Comforting hints of warm black tea balance out the citrusy, tart aroma, making this a beautiful and well-rounded scent. It has a sweet, fresh smell that is both clean and subtle.

products.name: Demeter Grape Leaf by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Grape Leaf by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Within a vineyard, you’ll smell the fragrance of the grape leaves as they warm beneath the sun. Demeter Grape Leaf takes that smell and puts it into a bottle. The grape gives it a subtly fruity and sweet scent, while the greenery gives a fresh and natural fragrance.

products.name: Demeter Green Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Green Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Just like the classic drink, Demeter Green Tea is fresh, balanced and slightly sweet. It was launched in 2001 and is a well-rounded fragrance, with hints of invigorating citrus and delicate greens. Wear this when you are hoping to reduce stress or relax at your favorite cafe.

products.name: Demeter Hibiscus Tea by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Hibiscus Tea by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Whether for health, celebration or simple pleasure, many throughout the world and its history drink hibiscus tea. The scent of hibiscus tea is just as enticing as the drink itself, and Demeter Fragrance has made it possible for you to enjoy it with Demeter Hibiscus Tea. This women’s fragrance recreates the green-floral and lightly spicy aroma of hibiscus tea, derived from the dried petals used to brew it.

products.name: Demeter Humidor by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Humidor by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Named for the room commonly used to store cigars, Demeter Humidor features a dominant scent note of rich tobacco that is complemented by a blend of warm spices and the smell of cold air. Inspired by the scent of unlit cigars inside a small, cooled room, this perfume is bold with a hint of sweetness. This unique perfume from Demeter can be worn alone or with others for a personalized scent.

products.name: Demeter Ivy by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Ivy by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Known for its masterful single-note compositions, the Demeter brand harnesses the ivy plant’s unique aroma in its Demeter Ivy fragrance. This climbing green vine plays the starring role with its cool herbal green note, but it also offers its fresh and spicy aspects to the wearer. The result is a unisex perfume with a surprising amount of depth for a single note, making it a great choice for people who love simple scents with some subtle variations.

products.name: Demeter Mahogany by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mahogany by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Mahogany is a full-bodied and woody fragrance that will last. Perfect for the woman seeking something a little different, it is rich and spicy, with a gentle warmth you can almost feel on your skin. This deep, smoky aroma is perfect for a quiet evening, or for making a statement as you go about your day.

products.name: Demeter Mulled Cider by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mulled Cider by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A perfume that will instantly pull your mind into the holiday season, Demeter Mulled Cider is a unisex fragrance from Demeter that was released in 2009. Notes of red apple are prominent in this composition, providing a bright sweetness that is enhanced by notes of sugar. Cinnamon mixes with a blend of spicy notes that are perfect for warming up the cold autumn or winter air.

products.name: Demeter Olive Flower by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Olive Flower by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: According to the fragrance company, Demeter Olive Flower perfume is composed of a single note of a white olive flower blossom with a licorice-type scent. A floral green fragrance for women, it has a distinctive, lingering quality with a heavy sillage. Demeter fondly describes the perfume as 'our lovely and accurate Olive Flower cologne.

products.name: Demeter Orchid by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Orchid is an intoxicating floral women’s perfume crafted by the fragrance house of Demeter. No matter if you’re currently enjoying the height of delightful spring weather, taking in the sunny heat of summer or trapped within the gray of a seemingly never-ending winter, the invitingly sweet scent of orchids is sure to uplift your spirits. The fragrance contains only the simple fragrance note of orchid, which imparts a clean and sweet essence of the flower with a light undercurrent of powder.

products.name: Demeter Parsley by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Parsley by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: When the flowers begin to bloom and warmer weather appears, it is natural to want a perfume that is full of the fresh promise of spring. Demeter Parsley from Demeter is a deep, green perfume that evokes images of new leaves, gardens brimming with plants, and shaded lawns. The note of parsley is sharp and aromatic with a metallic hint that brings a refreshing quality to the perfume.

products.name: Demeter Peony by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Peony by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Peonies often flower in the later part of spring, when the sunshine is brilliant and warm, but before the heat becomes oppressive. Demeter Peony by Demeter captures the sweet, delicate smell of peonies in full bloom, resulting in a quintessential floral fragrance. This classic perfume has a powdery, rose-like touch, giving the fragrance a true-to-life quality.

products.name: Demeter Pipe Tobacco by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pipe Tobacco by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Pipe Tobacco is a spicy, smoky fragrance that is ideal for the woman seeking to evoke an aura of mystery. A touch of sweetness perfectly balances the tobacco and makes this a familiar and comforting aroma. Warm, moist and rich, it is a lovely choice for your winter perfume.

products.name: Demeter Sawdust by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sawdust by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 1999, Demeter Sawdust is a men’s and women’s woody fragrance that works well for year-round day wear. Wood is the sole fragrance note and is meant to remind wearers of cut wood or lumber yards. This scent may resemble cedar chips and may be worn alone or blended or layered with other scents from Demeter, the American fragrance house known for its library of singular note scents, such as jasmine, lavender, or salt air.

products.name: Demeter Steam Room by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Steam Room by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Everyone enjoys the feeling of a steam room at a spa. Recreate that experience with Demeter Steam Room. The single note of eucalyptus is aromatic, green, and therapeutic.

products.name: Demeter Waffles by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Waffles by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Waffles by Demeter is the comfort food of perfumes. With notes of wheat and sugar this scent is sure to be savory and sweet. Nutty accords dominate, while subtle hints of syrup and maple are revealed as the fragrance dries.

products.name: The House of Oud Wonderly by The House of Oud
products.title_raw: The House of Oud Wonderly by The House of Oud Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: House of Oud Wonderly perfume for women is about opening yourself up to infinite possibilities in life. A floral, woody fragrance, it opens gently with fruity top notes of apricot and goji berries and then blossoms into sumptuous heart notes of neroli, jasmine sambac and almond blossom. Base notes of Virginia cedar, Italian iris, incense, sandalwood, myrrh, musk and Madagascar vanilla compose its aromatic foundation.

products.title_raw: Opera Sospiro by Sospiro Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Floral notes deepen to a heady crescendo at the heart, mingling lush, enveloping ylang ylang with warm undertones of leather, ambergris and nutmeg.

This heady scent opens with top notes of oud and leather, then gives way to a variety of animalic notes and a second layer of oud. Smoky notes of cedar and sandalwood mix with yet another oud note to create a deep accord of oud.

products.name: Dehn El Oud Shaheen by Swiss Arabian

products.name: Colors De Benetton Black by Benetton

products.name: Diavolo Only by Antonio Banderas

products.description_en: For a masculine fragrance that combines the light, fresh daytime aromas with the deeper, long-lasting exotic elements, you can't go wrong with Diavolo Only. This day-to-evening cologne was first launched in 1997. From Spanish actor turned designer Antonio Banderas, this men's scent opens with juicy mandarin orange, bergamot, and green leaves.

products.name: Afnan Mirsaal With Love by Afnan
products.title_raw: Afnan Mirsaal With Love by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women

A fragrant blend of sweet floralcy mixed with subtle earthy and gourmand accords, the oriental perfume was launched by the Arabian fragrance company Afnan in 2019. Musk and amber serve as earthy base notes that give the perfume a solid foundation, while heart notes of patchouli and saffron incorporate delicate floracy with an herbal undertone.

products.name: Afnan Rare Tiffany by Afnan
products.title_raw: Afnan Rare Tiffany by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A lush combination of floral, woody, spicy, and gourmand accords makes Afnan Rare Tiffany a delight for the senses. It opens with rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang, a classic trio creating an enticing floral and fragrant introduction. The heart brings together two more classics, sandalwood and vanilla, then enhances this pairing with musky notes.

products.name: Silhouette Midnight by Christian Siriano
products.title_raw: Silhouette Midnight by Christian Siriano Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women

Released in 2019, Silhouette Midnight is the result of his alchemy, bringing together fresh, floral, and sweet notes with depth and character. It opens with top notes of bitter orange, red salt, and pomelo for a tart citrus introduction.

products.name: Tiziana Terenzi Tabit by Tiziana Terenzi

The heart notes bring together floral notes and tropical coconut, while the base notes of vanilla, musk, cotton candy, and amber create a sweet yet complex finish.

products.name: Liquid Sun by Thalia Sodi

products.name: Al Haramain Opulent Saffron by Al Haramain

Rose and heliotrope notes carry the floral element into the heart of the fragrance where they are joined by amaretto and powdery notes.

products.name: Al Haramain Opulent Sapphire by Al Haramain

Bright lemon and bergamot notes form the opening, complemented by myrtle and basil. A floral combination of rose and jasmine becomes prominent as the heart of the fragrance moves forward.

products.name: Nishane Suede Et Saffron by Nishane

products.name: Al Haramain Amber Oud Rouge by Al Haramain

products.name: Champs De Provence by Eight & Bob

products.name: Memoires de Mustique  by Eight & Bob

products.name: Al Rayhan by Attar Collection
products.title_raw: Al Rayhan by Attar Collection Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

Top notes of agarwood, coffee and cypriol oil open this exotic scent with a spicy, slightly smoky warmth that radiates off the skin. products.name: Platinum Leather by Carolina Herrera
products.title_raw: Platinum Leather by Carolina Herrera Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women

products.title_raw: The Queen of Sheba by Attar Collection Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
