products.name: Shooting Stars Uden Overdose by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Shooting Stars Uden Overdose by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: With plenty of citrus and a touch of warm spice, Shooting Stars Uden Overdose stands up to any scrutiny. Since it's Xerjoff, you know it's made with the highest-quality ingredients including freshly-squeezed lemon and juicy bergamot in the opening notes. Crisp ginger and bright tobacco blossoms fill in the middle notes.

products.name: Shooting Stars Oesel by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Shooting Stars Oesel by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Shooting Stars Oesel is a serene and captivating floral oriental composition first released by niche label Xerjoff in 2010. The opening notes are a lush yet light, sparkling effusion of Amalfi lemon infused with fragrant African orange flower and woody nuances of petitgrain. At the heart blooms a heady white floral garden, rich and radiant with mingled tones of jasmine, rose and a sweet, hazy whisper of lovely mimosa.

products.name: Shooting Stars La Capitale by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Shooting Stars La Capitale by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by Xerjoff in 2019, Shooting Stars La Capitale is a warm oriental fragrance. It was designed by perfumer Chris Maurice and can be worn by both men and women. Fruity notes of peach and strawberry open the fragrance, sweetened by caramel and softened by labdanum.

products.name: Join the Club Shunkoin by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Join the Club Shunkoin by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: If you've ever wanted to join a meditation club, Join the Club Shunkoin is just the right fragrance to prepare for olfactory mindfulness. This 2012 fragrance opens with powdery notes and a touch of cherry blossom. Flickers of tea leaves and olibanum tiptoe through the heart before the peaceful warmth of vanilla mixes with the orris and sandalwood of the base for a nearly supernatural experience.

products.name: Oud Stars Ceylon by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Oud Stars Ceylon by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Designed for both women and men by perfumer Chris Maurice, Oud Stars Ceylon is a woody and floral fragrance. It was launched by Xerjoff in 2017. The top layer of the perfume is bright and sweet, as Calabrian bergamot, honey and jasmine sambac pull you into the fragrance.

products.name: Coffee Break Golden Dallah by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Coffee Break Golden Dallah by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2018, Coffee Break Golden Dallah is a unisex fragrance inspired by the aromatic and exotic world of international coffee trade. From Italian luxury perfume brand Xerjoff, this scent opens with top notes of fresh spices. The heart notes bring in elements of coffee, oud, rose, incense, and amber.

products.name: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille by Franck Olivier
products.title_raw: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille by Franck Olivier Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: French designer Franck Olivier released a men's fragrance with a modern feel that works for day or evening wear. Introduced in 2017, Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is strong and masculine. It opens with top notes of caramel, orange, and raspberry for a sweet beginning.

products.name: Mercedes Benz Man Intense by Mercedes Benz
products.title_raw: Mercedes Benz Man Intense by Mercedes Benz Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: The epitome of elegant luxury on the road, Mercedes Benz offers up that same brand of classy opulence in Mercedes Benz Man Intense. Released in 2020, the men's cologne invites you to spritz on the musky, green-nuanced fragrance and carry that same sense of easy luxury into all parts of your everyday life. The scent features top notes of juicy pear leaf and the sweet muskiness of ambrette.

products.name: Poggia by Tiziana Terenzi
products.title_raw: Poggia by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: A bright, fresh fragrance that can be worn by both women and men, Poggia was launched by Tiziana Terenzi in 2020. A gorgeous combination of fruits provides an energizing air in the top layer where peach, orange, lemon and bergamot blend together. Fruity notes make their way into the heart as well.

products.name: Cubia by Tiziana Terenzi
products.title_raw: Cubia by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced in 2020, Cubia is an enigmatic fragrance full of contrasts, light and dark, masculine and feminine. This unisex scent is from Italian luxury perfumier Tiziana Terenzi. It opens with fruity top notes of bergamot, lemon, and orange.

products.name: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide by Tiziana Terenzi
products.type_raw: Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.38 oz
products.title_raw: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2020, Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide invites you to embrace the unexpected and dreamy as you relish in the pleasure of delectable fruits and lush florals. One-of-a-kind opulence is on full display beginning with the dazzling packaging complete with a gold-plated sea star sitting on top. The unisex perfume is featured in the Tiziana Terenzi Sea Stars collection and features scent notes of green-tinged tuberose, heady narcissus, zesty Calabrian bergamot, exotic passionfruit and romantic rose.

products.name: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide by Tiziana Terenzi
products.title_raw: Tiziana Terenzi Atlantide by Tiziana Terenzi Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.38 oz for Women

products.name: Shooting Stars Kobe by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Shooting Stars Kobe by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: A masculine fragrance launched by Xerjoff in 2009, Shooting Stars Kobe beautifully blends bright fruits with warm, dark elements. Bergamot and orange give the fragrance an energizing opening softened by notes of labdanum. Floral orange blossom and neroli come together with petitgrain in the heart of the composition.

products.name: 17/17 Stone Label XXY by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: 17/17 Stone Label XXY by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by Xerjoff in 2008, 17/17 Stone Label Xxy is an oriental floral fragrance. It wears well from morning to evening and is suitable for both men and women. Sweet notes of fruity bergamot, peach and grapefruit open the fragrance.

products.name: Yardley Arthur by Yardley London
products.title_raw: Yardley Arthur by Yardley London Body Spray 5.1 oz for Men
products.description_en: Inspired by the golden age of English kings with round tables and holy grails, Yardley Arthur by Yardley London is a refreshing fougere that is designed for anyone who wants to give off the air of a sophisticated gentleman. It opens with lush green scents including basil, rosemary, bergamot and mandarin. Cozy heart notes bring in washes of cinnamon, black pepper, sweet geranium and orange blossom.

products.name: Elvis Presley Forever by Bellevue Brands
products.title_raw: Elvis Presley Forever by Bellevue Brands Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Bold and unique, Elvis Presley Forever is a masculine fragrance from Bellevue Brands inspired by the King of Rock 'n' Roll. This fragrance opens, bright and refreshing, with top notes of fresh ginger, Calabrian bergamot, juniperberry, rhubarb and lemon zest. This freshness persists into the heart with green apple joined by notes of geranium, lavender, violet leaves and black pepper.

products.name: Elvis Presley Forever by Bellevue Brands
products.title_raw: Elvis Presley Forever by Bellevue Brands Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Elvis Presley Forever is a feminine fragrance inspired by the King of Rock 'n' Roll. It was launched by Bellevue Brands. A garden of top notes opens the perfume with raspberry blush, apple blossom, magnolia blossom and freesia.

products.name: Sapil Rave by Sapil
products.title_raw: Sapil Rave by Sapil Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Sapil Rave is a spicy fragrance for men that was launched by Sapil. Calabrian bergamot and pepper top notes are the first to capture your attention. The spicy element is enhanced in the heart of the fragrance with Sichuan pepper and pink pepper.

products.name: Sapil Rave by Sapil
products.title_raw: Sapil Rave by Sapil Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A feminine perfume from Sapil, Sapil Rave is a combination of floral and earthy notes. The opening layer of the fragrance brings together delicate iris, aromatic saffron and bright plum, creating a sweet blend of top notes. A floral heart becomes more prominent as the fragrance transitions, allowing jasmine sambac, iris and Bulgarian rose to capture your senses.

products.name: Kilian Rolling In Love by Kilian
products.title_raw: Kilian Rolling In Love by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: A simply scrumptious, sensual floral oriental gourmand, Rolling in Love by Kilian was first released in 2019. Opening notes are a creamy and intimate, alluring blend of almond milk and soft, delicately musky ambrette seed absolute. Carnal, seductive tuberose blooms at the heart, mingled with powdery orris and shimmering freesia.

products.name: 1888 Casamorati by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: 1888 Casamorati by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: 1888 Casamorati is an oriental fragrance designed for both women and men. It was launched by Xerjoff in 2013. It's great for autumn and winter and transitions well from day to night.

products.name: Police To Be Bad Guy by Police Colognes
products.title_raw: Police To Be Bad Guy by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 4.2 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by Police Colognes in 2020, Police To Be Bad Guy is an oriental fragrance for men. The opening layer of the fragrance is a refreshing combination of bright blood orange, herbal red thyme and mint, spicy nutmeg and various green notes. Fruit is featured in the heart as well where green apple and sorbet notes are softened by geranium and white flowers.

products.name: Police Deep Blue by Police Colognes
products.title_raw: Police Deep Blue by Police Colognes Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 3.4 oz for Men

products.title_raw: Vince Camuto Illuminare by Vince Camuto Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women

Sweet, fruity top notes of pomelo and bergamot form the opening layer, enhanced by plum blossom. The heart is soft and floral with notes of osmanthus, magnolia and red rose.

products.name: Not A Perfume Superdose by Juliette Has A Gun
products.title_raw: Not A Perfume Superdose by Juliette Has A Gun Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Not A Perfume Superdose from Juliette Has A Gun is a single note fragrance featuring Cetalox, otherwise known as Ambroxan. This note was created years ago as a complement to other accords. Its main role is to enhance natural scents.

products.name: Yes I Am The King Legend by Geparlys
products.title_raw: Yes I Am The King Legend by Geparlys Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Yes I Am the King Legend by Geparlys is a confident citrus aromatic scent enhanced by herbal florals, warm amber and wood. The opening is a clean, uplifting expression of tart grapefruit and crushed cedar leaf infused with spicy-sweet hints of cardamom. Piquant geranium and fresh, floral-aromatic lavender emerge at the heart, harmonized with tart, juicy nuances of green apple.

products.name: Perry Ellis Bold Red by Perry Ellis
products.title_raw: Perry Ellis Bold Red by Perry Ellis Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Perry Ellis Bold Red delivers on its name. This masculine fragrance launched in 2020 and is from fashion designer Perry Ellis, who is based in the Us. It opens with fruity top notes of red apple and finger lime.

products.title_raw: Jaguar Gold In Black by Jaguar Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Men

The opening gives way to spicy and floral heart notes of nutmeg, geranium, Thai ginger, and violet leaf.

products.title_raw: Xerjoff Erba Pura by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Women

products.title_raw: Lamar by Kajal Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men

First released in 2020, this fragrance opens with notes of orange blossom, ginger and apple before dipping into a luxurious heart of leather, cardamom and grain alcohol. The fragrance is completed with a base of vanilla, vera wood and tonka beans.

products.title_raw: Rodin Olio Lusso 3 by Rodin Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men

Rodin Olio Lusso 3 seems simple, yet its blend of flowery aromas with earthier, woody accords makes it a nostalgic stroll through a garden in bloom. The top note features geranium before the heart notes of ylang-ylang, jasmine sambac, and orris bloom into play.

products.name: Rodin Olio Lusso 3 by Rodin
products.type_raw: Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.4 oz

products.name: Love In White For Summer by Creed
products.title_raw: Love In White For Summer by Creed Eau De Parfum Spray (Tester) 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Reminiscent of a breezy summer's day, Love in White for Summer is a fruity, floral scent for women. Released in 2018, this feminine fragrance is from Creed, a luxury perfume house based in Paris. The top notes of Bulgarian rose, sweet magnolia, and bergamot create a distinctive introduction, while heart notes tie iris to earthier notes of basmati rice and cedarwood.

products.name: Love In White For Summer by Creed
products.title_raw: Love In White For Summer by Creed Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Reminiscent of a breezy summer's day, Love in White for Summer is a fruity, floral scent for women. Released in 2018, this feminine fragrance is from Creed, a luxury perfume house based in Paris. The top notes of Bulgarian rose, sweet magnolia, and bergamot create a distinctive introduction, while heart notes tie iris to earthier notes of basmati rice and cedarwood.

products.name: Moresque Seta Secret Collection by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Seta Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released in 2018, Moresque Seta Secret Collection is a complex men's fragrance that transports you back in time from the trade markets of the Silk Road to the canals of Venice. From Italian perfumier Moresque, this masculine fragrance introduces itself with top notes of saffron, lemon, and bergamot. At the heart are notes of floral ylang-ylang and myrrh to continue the exotic journey.

products.name: Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Travel back in time to a lost Arabian city on the fragrant profile of Moresque Ubar 1992 Secret Collection. This unisex scent was launched in 2018 by Italian perfume house Moresque as part of a special collection. It opens with top notes of cypress and bergamot before the heart notes of clary sage, black pepper, and incense come into play.

products.name: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Moresque Alma Pure Secret Collection debuted in 2018, presenting its floral fruity scent profile in a beautiful golden bottle. This women’s fragrance from Moresque opens with top notes of cassis and blackberry, giving it an unmistakable tangy and tart introduction. Next come middle notes of May rose, champagne and linden tree blossoms, known by their distinctive grassy, sweet and bitter aroma.

products.name: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 2.5 oz for Men
products.description_en: Moresque Jasminisha Secret Collection is a 2018 amber floral unisex fragrance designed by Andrea Casotti. Part of Moresque’s Gold collection, this scent starts with refreshing top notes of spicy hot ginger and sweet, succulent mandarin. Next follows a heart of ginger flower paired with fragrant orange blossom and creamy jasmine, the star player in this scent blend.

products.name: Moresque Lady Tubereuse by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Lady Tubereuse by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Let the intoxicating scent of Moresque Lady Tubereuse carry you away to a lush and mysterious world. This inspiring 2020 release from Moresque opens with fruity notes accented by spicy ginger and sweet tuberose. Heady heart notes of angelica, lily and ylang-ylang melt into a lavish and sensuous base of vetiver, white musk, vanilla, cedar, resin, tonka bean and amber.

products.name: Moresque Royal Limited Edition by Moresque
products.title_raw: Moresque Royal Limited Edition by Moresque Eau De Parfum Spray 2.5 oz for Women
products.description_en: Moresque Royal Limited Edition is a 2019 floral fruity women’s fragrance inspired by the Onna-bugeisha, women warriors that fought alongside samurai in pre-modern Japan. This scent opens with top notes of bright and juicy white peach, bitter grapefruit, powdery pink pepper and the sharp-sweet tones of rhubarb. Japanese peony, jasmine grandiflorum and iris make up the heart with a balance of creamy and narcotic tones with lightweight starchy and green facets.

products.name: Mademoiselle Rochas In Black by Rochas
products.title_raw: Mademoiselle Rochas In Black by Rochas Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Introduced in 2020, Mademoiselle Rochas in Black looks at the dark side of femininity. This rock-n-roll scent is from French perfume house Rochas, and it explores the many facets of being a woman. The fragrance opens with top notes of bergamot, black tea, and blackberry for a fresh, slightly sweet beginning.

products.name: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711
products.type_raw: Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz
products.title_raw: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex Tester) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The 4711 brand describes this 2020 women’s floral fragrance as “seductive, feminine and elegant.” 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia features a balanced aromatic profile with several classic fragrance notes. Sweet mandarin, succulent orange and bright pink pepper create a refreshing opening.

products.name: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711
products.title_raw: 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia by 4711 Eau De Cologne Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The 4711 brand describes this 2020 women’s floral fragrance as “seductive, feminine and elegant.” 4711 Floral Collection Magnolia features a balanced aromatic profile with several classic fragrance notes. Sweet mandarin, succulent orange and bright pink pepper create a refreshing opening.

products.name: Panama Jack Salty Air by Panama Jack
products.title_raw: Panama Jack Salty Air by Panama Jack Body Mist (Unisex) 8.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Looking for a light body mist that turns the vibe of a day at the beach into a signature scent? With Panama Jack Salty Air, you can envelope yourself in a summery essence, even when you can't get away. It opens with tropical top notes of lime and tequila before the floral heart notes come into play.

products.name: Panama Jack Endless Summer by Panama Jack
products.title_raw: Panama Jack Endless Summer by Panama Jack Body Mist (Unisex) 8.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Don't you wish it could be summer every day? With Panama Jack Endless Summer, it can feel like it. This fragrant body mist is from suntan and sunscreen brand Panama Jack, and its clever combination of summery accords makes this scent perfect for daily wear.

products.name: Jo Malone Scarlet Poppy by Jo Malone
products.title_raw: Jo Malone Scarlet Poppy by Jo Malone Cologne Intense Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Uk perfume house Jo Malone introduced Jo Malone Scarlet Poppy, a vibrant unisex fragrance, in 2020. This modern scent blends distinctive notes in a modern way for an aromatic creation unlike any other. It opens with a top note of ambrette, which hits both sweet and musky accords.

products.name: Demeter Ambergris by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Ambergris by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Composed of few notes, Demeter Ambergris gives off a bounty of aromatic accords. Ambergris, musk, vanilla, and earthy and spicy notes mingle to produce amber, musky, animalic, balsamic, powdery and sweet accords. The moderately long-lasting fragrance has a moderate sillage and is suitable for daytime and evening wear year-round.

products.name: Demeter Beetroot by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Beetroot by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Beetroot is part of the Pennsylvania brand's Classic Collection. Focused on the sole note of beetroot, the unisex fragrance gives off accords of fresh earth and slightly spicy beet flesh. With its weak longevity and intimate sillage, the scent pairs perfectly with daytime wear in the spring and summer months.

products.name: Demeter Clove by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Clove by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Although it has a simple composition with just one scent note, Demeter Clove is an enchanting fragrance that is both herbal and earthy. Infused with the scent of fresh cloves, this aroma is both sweet and spicy, making it ideal for everyday wear in the fall and winter. This cologne is part of the simple fragrance line Demeter is known for.

products.name: Demeter Blood Lime by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Blood Lime by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: A bold citrus fragrance for women and men, Demeter Blood Lime is created from the juicy fruits blood orange and lime. This dynamic duo produces a quintessential citrus accord that is bright, tangy and energizing. The fragrance is moderately long-lasting with an enormous sillage, thanks to its citrusy scent superpower.

products.name: Demeter Caipirinha by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Caipirinha by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Inspired by the Brazilian liquor Cacaca, Demeter Caipirinha is a fun, refreshing fragrance for men. It blends the scent of the liquor with notes of juicy lime and warm sugar, resulting in a gourmand fragrance that is bright and inviting. This aroma is great for both casual and formal events and wears well at any time of the year.

products.name: Demeter Condensed Milk by Demeter
products.type_raw: Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz
products.title_raw: Demeter Condensed Milk by Demeter Pick Me Up Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: If you enjoy baking, you are probably familiar with the sweet, gourmand scent of condensed milk. If you want to carry that delightful fragrance with you, spritz on Demeter Condensed Milk. As part of the simple fragrance line Demeter is known for, this aroma features simple scent notes of rich milk and warm sugar for a delicious, gourmand fragrance that is great for everyday wear.

products.name: Demeter Clover by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Clover by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: From the Pennsylvania Demeter Fragrance Library, which specializes in fragrances featuring nature's diverse and distinctive aromas and scents, comes Demeter Clover. Built on its single note of clover, the fragrance features floral, green and sweet accords. A moderately long-lasting scent with a moderate sillage, it's ideal for daytime use in the spring and summer months.

products.name: Demeter Christmas Bouquet by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Christmas Bouquet by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Ideal for any holiday gathering, Demeter Christmas Bouquet is a fresh, floral perfume that is both enchanting and irresistible. It is made with a single scent note as part of the light fragrance collection Demeter is known for. However, the delicate scent of sweet carnations gives this aroma a subtle heady undertone that makes it both light and sophisticated so it wears well both during the day and at night.

products.name: Demeter Cherry Cream by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cherry Cream by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Deliciously sweet and gourmand, Demeter Cherry Cream is a delectable aroma that features scent notes of fresh cherries and creamy vanilla. It is a simple fragrance that is soft and light, so it is ideal for everyday wear in the spring. If you love the juicy scent of fresh cherries, you'll love this tantalizing aroma.

products.name: Demeter Coconut by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Coconut by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: While composed of a single note of coconut, Demeter Coconut for women gives off a collection of accords: lactonic, nutty, sweet, tropical and vanilla. Its wide-ranging aromatic experience produces a moderately long-lasting fragrance with a moderate sillage. The floral-fruity perfume is especially well-suited to daytime wear in the summer, the season popularly associated with coconut aromas and flavors and trips to the beach or tropical locations.

products.name: Demeter Churros by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Churros by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Churros are a beloved Mexican food, and the new aroma by Demeter allows you to carry the tantalizingly delicious scent of your favorite food everywhere you go. Demeter Churros is a gourmand fragrance that blends the irresistible scent of tender, flaky dough with warm cinnamon and sugar for a tantalizing scent that is great for casual wear. Wear it to enjoy the scent of your favorite treat, but beware because it may start a craving for churros!

products.name: Demeter Argan by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Argan by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: An aromatic fragrance for women and men, Demeter Argan features notes from the titular Moroccan tree and its fruits. Its aromatic, earthy and woody accords give it moderate longevity and sillage that lend it well to daytime and evening wear throughout the year. It's also appropriate for everyday, casual and formal occasions.

products.name: Demeter Basil by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Basil by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Basil fairly bursts with its enticing accords: aromatic, fresh spicy, green and herbal. This powerful unisex perfume unleashes the bounty of its signature herb on the world. Demeter produced the fragrance with weak longevity and a moderate sillage so that it's ideal for daytime and evening wear throughout the year.

products.name: Demeter Black Pepper by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Black Pepper by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Inherently spicy and masculine, Demeter Black Pepper is a mysterious fragrance that is infused with peppercorn. This rich, masculine scent is also infused with volatile oils that deepen the spicy accord and make this aroma ideal for a romantic night out on the town with your significant other. Although this fragrance has a simple composition, it is rich and sophisticated enough for formal wear.

products.name: Demeter Black Bamboo by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Black Bamboo by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: If you're looking for an earthy, unisex perfume to add to your fragrance collection, Demeter Black Bamboo fits the bill. This herbal aroma features scent notes of tender bamboo shoots, aromatic greens and hints of spicy ginger. Bright and refreshing, this fragrance is ideal for casual wear in the spring and summer.

products.name: Demeter Bird of Paradise by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Bird of Paradise by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Named for the striking tropical flower, Demeter Bird of Paradise is a floral fragrance for women of all ages. Its lone note of Bird of Paradise or Strelitzia has a slightly tropical and herbal aroma, also known as a 'fantasy note' in perfumery. As you might expect, the fragrance is a favorite among its fans for daytime wear in the spring and summer months.

products.name: Demeter Chrysanthemum by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Chrysanthemum by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Chrysanthemum is a beautiful, enticing floral green fragrance for contemporary women. Composed of chrysanthemum flowers, leaves and stems, the scent serves up aromatic, floral, fresh spicy and herbal accords, a full-bodied offering that is romantic and mysterious. Moderately long-lasting with an intimate sillage, the fragrance is a favorite among its fans for daytime wear in the spring and fall.

products.name: Demeter Creme Anglaise by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Creme Anglaise by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Creme Anglaise pick-me-up cologne spray for men may just become your go-to fragrance. Composed of the single note of custard, also known as English cream, the fragrance produces sweet and lactonic or milky accords that are comforting and creamy. Fans of the scent recommend it for wear in the fall, the time of year that the English often add custard to hearty puddings.

products.name: Chaz Sport by Jean Philippe
products.title_raw: Chaz Sport by Jean Philippe Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Chaz Sport is a stimulating fragrance for women that is perfectly suited for daytime use or casual evening wear. The refreshing citrus notes at the top give way to a soothing floral scent that is made up of lavender and jasmine. The base of this perfume consists mainly of smooth oriental notes like patchouli and sandalwood, but there is also a mellow overtone of vanilla and musk that completes the enticing effect of the overall fragrance.

products.name: 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier by 100 Bon
products.type_raw: Concentree De Parfum Spray (Unisex Refillable) 1.7 oz
products.title_raw: 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier by 100 Bon Concentree De Parfum Spray (Unisex Refillable) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Originally released in 2017, 100 Bon Carvi & Jardin De Figuier is a fruity-sweet and soft, alluring fragrance enhanced by powdery florals, bright citrus, clean wood and creamy suede. Opening notes are an uplifting expression of fig and raspberry mingled with tart-sweet hints of mandarin and blood orange. Soft floral tones bloom next, merging violet, jasmine and rose with herbal nuances of caraway.

products.name: Philipp Plein No Limits by Philipp Plein Parfums
products.title_raw: Philipp Plein No Limits by Philipp Plein Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Philipp Plein No Limits defines what a spicy, leathery men's fragrance should be. From Swiss perfume house Philipp Plein Parfums, this masculine scent opens with spicy top notes of black pepper, cinnamon, star anise, cardamom, cloves, and ginger, which mingle with marine and bergamot notes. The heart continues the exotic journey with notes of dark chocolate, bourbon vanilla, incense, and amber.

products.name: Philipp Plein No Limits by Philipp Plein Parfums
products.title_raw: Philipp Plein No Limits by Philipp Plein Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Philipp Plein No Limits defines what a spicy, leathery men's fragrance should be. products.name: Jo Malone Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone
products.title_raw: Jo Malone Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone Cologne Spray (Unisex) 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2019, Jo Malone Poppy & Barley by Jo Malone, is a vibrant floral scent that hones in on the essence of its three main notes. Lively, fresh and inviting, the top note of blackcurrant bursts from the first spritz like a welcoming juicy embrace. As the sweet crispness tames, the green yet flowery aroma of poppy invigorates the senses.

products.name: Bod Man Iconic by Parfums De Coeur
products.title_raw: Bod Man Iconic by Parfums De Coeur Body Spray 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Bold and refreshing, Bod Man Iconic by Parfums De Coeur is ideal for the modern man ready to make a mark. While it exudes sophisticated masculinity, it also has a fresh mysteriousness that is undeniably seductive. The first spritz unleashes a vibrant blend of sweet and juicy Italian bergamot and spicy black pepper.

products.name: Bod Man Reserve by Parfums De Coeur
products.title_raw: Bod Man Reserve by Parfums De Coeur Body Spray 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Let your inner gentleman shine in warm refinement with Bod Man Reserve by Parfums De Coeur. This rich and masculine cologne conjures up an air of nostalgia while exuding a fresh contemporary style. A crisp opening of Italian lemon and mint set the stage for an intoxicating heart of geranium and tonka bean.

products.name: Initio Rehab by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Rehab by Initio Parfums Prives Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Rev up the seduction factor with a smoky and tantalizing spritz of Initio Rehab by Initio Parfums Prives. Launched in 2018, this woody and sweet cologne exudes sophisticated refinement and masculinity. It opens with a tantalizing and vibrant mix of lavender and bergamot.

products.name: Initio Mystic Experience by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Mystic Experience by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: For men who desire to exude sophisticated refinement and a gentleman’s spirit, look no further than Initio Mystic Experience by Initio Parfums Prives. Launched in 2015, this bold and captivating cologne blends a simple array of notes that conjures up pleasant memories and a warmness that is hard to resist. Designed to take the senses on an uninhibited journey, it carefully balances bitter and aromatic coffee, animalic and magnetic musk, sweet vanilla, and seductive patchouli.

products.name: Initio Magnetic Blend 7 by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Magnetic Blend 7 by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Science and nature powerfully collide to create the ultimate in seduction with Initio Magnetic Blend 7. This innovative cologne, released by Initio Parfums Prives in 2015, takes the irresistible pheromone of musk to a staggeringly sexy new level. Mysterious and magnetic, it is composed of molecules that capture the invisible captivation and urge to get closer.

products.name: Initio Atomic Rose by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Atomic Rose by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Initio Parfums Prives debuted Initio Atomic Rose in 2019. This unisex amber floral fragrance is part of the brand’s Carnal Blends collection. Soft pink pepper and spicy bergamot start off this fragrance.

products.name: Initio Blessed Baraka by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Blessed Baraka by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Initio Blessed Baraka is a 2015 unisex amber fragrance created by Alberto Morillas. Initio Parfums Prives describes it as a “solar fragrance” featuring musk, amber and sandalwood as its chief scent molecules. These three classic notes bring together a variety of accords and textures: soft, milky, earthy, woody, leathery and balsamic tones.

products.name: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac is a 2015 unisex amber spicy fragrance by Initio Parfums Prives, designed by Alexandra Kosinski. Scent molecules of musk and castoreum create a potency center, combining animalistic, warm and leathery tones. Amber doubles down on the warmth in this fragrance while adding powdery and sweet facets.

products.name: Initio Addictive Vibration by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Addictive Vibration by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: From French perfume house Initio Parfums Prives is a wild ride of a scent to tap into your animalistic nature. Launched in 2016, Initio Addictive Vibration is complex and unforgettable. It opens innocently enough with notes of apple and orange blossom.

products.name: Initio Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2016, Initio Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives is a simple yet intoxicating and vibrant cologne. Infused with spice and warm notes that seduce the senses, it evokes a sense of magnetism that is undeniably strong. This smooth aroma fuses the enticing aroma of cinnamon with rum and vanilla that makes one yearn for more.

products.name: Initio Psychedelic Love by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Psychedelic Love by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Show off your groove and entice onlookers with a spritz of Initio Psychedelic Love. Launched by Initio Parfums Prives in 2017, this intoxicating fragrance delights the senses and envelopes the wearer in a mesmerizing and seductive aura. This unisex scent opens with a delectable and eye-opening burst of ylang-ylang and bergamot.

products.name: Initio High Frequency by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio High Frequency by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Initio High Frequency is a 2016 unisex floral fragrance from Initio Parfums Prives, a French niche perfume label. Its scent profile comes from an effortless balance of floral, nutty, fruity, fresh and green accords. Magnolia and almond bring in their nutty, bitter, honeyed and lemony tones.

products.name: Initio Oud For Greatness by Initio Parfums Prives
products.title_raw: Initio Oud For Greatness by Initio Parfums Prives Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.04 oz for Men
products.description_en: Ancient and mesmerizing notes are given a modern spin with Initio Oud For Greatness by Initio Parfums Prives. Oud is at the heart of this rich and vibrant cologne, which was released in 2018. Powerful, sensual and aromatic, this rare ingredient subtly lingers.

products.name: Montblanc Signature by Mont Blanc
products.title_raw: Montblanc Signature by Mont Blanc Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2020, Montblanc Signature is meant for the modern woman who wants to make a memorable statement. From German luxury goods brand Mont Blanc, this floral scent opens with bright, juicy top notes of clementine. The heart is all floral, with notes of magnolia, peony, and ylang-ylang blooming into play.

products.name: Montblanc Signature by Mont Blanc
products.title_raw: Montblanc Signature by Mont Blanc Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2020, Montblanc Signature is meant for the modern woman who wants to make a memorable statement. From German luxury goods brand Mont Blanc, this floral scent opens with bright, juicy top notes of clementine. The heart is all floral, with notes of magnolia, peony, and ylang-ylang blooming into play.

products.name: Rasasi Woody by Rasasi
products.title_raw: Rasasi Woody by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 2 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released in 2014, Rasasi Woody is truth in advertising, from its name to its distinctive, textured decanter. From Rasasi, a perfume house based in the United Arab Emirates, this masculine scent blends spicy and woody elements to create a memorable aroma. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, tart grapefruit, juicy tangerine, and exotic saffron.

products.name: Rasasi Woody by Rasasi
products.title_raw: Rasasi Woody by Rasasi Eau De Parfum Spray 1.8 oz for Women
products.description_en: Rasasi Woody Perfume by Rasasi

products.name: Born Lovely by Sarah Jessica Parker
products.title_raw: Born Lovely by Sarah Jessica Parker Fragrance Mist 8 oz for Women
products.description_en: Born Lovely, a modern floral fragrance for women, was released in 2018. From American actress and fashion icon Sarah Jessica Parker, this scent blends fruity and floral accords with deeper elements for a unique fragrance for flowery fans. The top notes feature cassis, mandarin orange, and peony for a bold introduction.

products.name: Woodysandal by Hermetica
products.title_raw: Woodysandal by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Woodysandal is a 2020 unisex woody fruity fragrance from the French perfume brand Hermetica. Designed by Hungarian perfumer Aliénor Massenet, it features a rich center with sandalwood essence, tonka bean oil and a blackcurrant molecule. These three notes weave milky and woody tones with sweet, tobacco-like and tangy accords.

products.name: Rosefire by Hermetica
products.title_raw: Rosefire by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Hermetica launched several fragrances in 2018, including the unisex amber floral Rosefire. Rose absolute, violet and davana create a delicious center with earthy, powdery, airy, sweet and bitter tones. Davana, a south Indian aromatic herb, may remind wearers of tea leaves and dried fruit.

products.name: Sandalsun by Hermetica
products.title_raw: Sandalsun by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Sandalsun is a unisex woody gourmand fragrance released in 2018 by the French niche perfume label Hermetica. Calling it “delicious” would be an understatement – a core of vanilla, hazelnut and sandalwood infuses it with a rich, creamy and nutty decadence. The brand’s Source1 fragrance also features in this scent as a base for its three core ingredients, lending its warmth and depth.

products.name: Eterniris by Hermetica
products.title_raw: Eterniris by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Eterniris by Hermetica is a unisex floral fragrance with three notes at its core: iris, lily of the valley and oud. They create a center with powdery, waxy green, balsamic and nutty wood tones. Supporting notes include a citrus-fruit combo of raspberry, mandarin orange, bergamot and pineapple.

products.name: Vaninight by Hermetica
products.title_raw: Vaninight by Hermetica Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Vaninight is an amber vanilla fragrance launched by Hermetica in 2018. This unisex scent was designed by Philippe Paparella-Paris, the perfumer who crafted most of the brand’s offerings. Vanilla absolute, almond oil and an amber molecule combine their balsamic, nutty, creamy and dark sugary accords.

products.name: Narciso Rodriguez Ambree by Narciso Rodriguez
products.title_raw: Narciso Rodriguez Ambree by Narciso Rodriguez Eau De Parfum Spray (unboxed) 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: First released in 2020, Narciso Rodriguez Ambree is a sweet and powdery floral fragrance that layers lush, tropical blooms and magnetic amber over a velvety base of precious wood. The scent opens with an enveloping floral effusion of Tahitian gardenia, sensual ylang ylang and shimmering white blossoms. As the scent settles, warm tones of amber and musk emerge, beautifully harmonizing with the floral accords of the opening.

Introduced in 2017, this scent blends light and deeper accords together for a modern, sporty fragrance. It opens with top notes of green apple, lemon, and yuzu for a tart beginning.

products.name: Sergio Tacchini La Volee by Sergio Tacchini
products.title_raw: Sergio Tacchini La Volee by Sergio Tacchini Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Sergio Tacchini La Volee is an alluring chypre floral musk enhanced by inviting accords of tropical fruit and intimate amber. Opening notes are bright and fresh, mingling succulent litchi fruit with tart-sweet red currant. Lush, citrusy floral tones of damask rose and magnolia bloom at the heart, followed by a warm and embracing finish of magnetic amber, musk and earthy-sweet patchouli.

products.name: Love Anne by Anne Klein
products.title_raw: Love Anne by Anne Klein Vial (sample) .05 oz for Women
products.description_en: From Anne Klein comes Love Anne, an oriental amber vanilla women’s fragrance with a rich and opulent aromatic profile. Debuting in 2021, this scent starts with an invigorating top note blend of sparkling bergamot, mandarin and passionfruit. These spicy, floral, tart, succulent and tropical accords lead to a delicious heart of hyacinth, tiare flower and peach skin.

products.name: Kanon Nordic Elements Water by Kanon
products.title_raw: Kanon Nordic Elements Water by Kanon Eau De Toilette Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Kanon Nordic Elements Water is a men's fragrance from Kanon featuring floral, fruity, balsamic, green and woody accords. Top notes of lavender, eucalyptus, aldehydes and apple create a lively opening with resinous, camphorous, waxy, herbal and delicate sweet tones. Middle notes of geranium and water lily lend aquatic, rosy and green accords.

products.name: Kanon Nordic Elements Air by Kanon
products.title_raw: Kanon Nordic Elements Air by Kanon Eau De Toilette Spray (unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Feel inspired every day with the bright and uplifting scent of Kanon Nordic Elements Air for men. The citrus-forward opening blends top notes of orange, grapefruit, mandarin orange, and bergamot. Warm, spicy notes of clove, saffron, ginger, cardamom, geranium and jasmine create a memorable heart.

products.title_raw: English Laundry Throne by English Laundry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men

English Laundry Throne opens with top notes of bergamot, tart green apple, grapefruit, and black peppercorn. At the heart are floral notes of geranium, violet, jasmine, and blue lavender for a calming sensation.

products.name: Arabian Soiree by Fanette
products.title_raw: Arabian Soiree by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Hot Arabian nights beg for a bold, masculine fragrance like this one from French perfume house Fanette. Introduced in 2016, Arabian Soiree has a rugged, sensual aroma that awakens your senses. The top notes of rose and Arabian spices capture your attention, while the heart notes of leather and patchouli lend a more relaxed, earthy feel.

products.name: Epic Oud by Fanette
products.title_raw: Epic Oud by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: The scent of oud is enigmatic, making it an intriguing focus for this masculine scent from French designer Fanette. Launched in 2016, Epic Oud has a light, fruity introduction, thanks to top notes of bergamot and juicy strawberry. At the heart are notes of delicate lily-of-the-valley and cedar.

products.name: The Fatale Rose by Fanette
products.title_raw: The Fatale Rose by Fanette Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Fresh yet soft, sensual, The Fatale Rose is an irresistible floral woody musk that suits any season. The scent opens with a crisp, uplifting effusion of crushed mandarin leaves, delicately green with a hint of citrus sweetness. Lush orange blossom and seductive jasmine in the heart provide a beautiful backdrop for inimitable French rose, velvety and alluring.

products.name: Burberry Her London Dream by Burberry
products.title_raw: Burberry Her London Dream by Burberry Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: With clean, classic lines that London luxury designer Burberry is known for comes a simple yet sophisticated scent for women. Released in 2020, Burberry Her London Dream brings together traditional accords that define femininity. The top notes of lemon and ginger are reminiscent of a proper afternoon tea, while the heart notes of rose and peony add fresh, floral elements.

Opening notes mingle bold aldehydes with crisp nuances of grapefruit, apple and fresh ginger. As the scent settles, aromatic herbs emerge, blending crushed sage and lavender with piquant nuances of geranium leaf.

products.name: Demeter Saffron by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Saffron by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Indulge the senses with the rich and sophisticated scent of Demeter Saffron by Demeter. Seductive, enticing and mysterious, its warmth envelopes the body in decadence. Crafted to replica the warm and spicy aroma of this highly sought-after spice, it has hints of leather and tobacco that give it an exotic and irresistible edge.

products.name: Demeter Tea Olive by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tea Olive by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Also known as osmanthus or false holly, tea olive is a sweet floral scent with naturally occuring touches of peach and apricot. Although the fragrance oil is commonly used as a perfume ingredient, Demeter Tea Olive takes a moment to appreciate the flower for what it is in its truest form, undiluted and only enhanced to bring out the natural notes. This Demeter scent was first released in 2018 as part of the brand's collection of natural flower scents.

products.name: Demeter White Bouquet by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter White Bouquet by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Delicate, youthful and mesmerizing, Demeter White Bouquet captures the beauty of white florals. One whiff makes one want to close their eyes and experience a dreamlike scene as the blooming blossoms seem to reach for the sun rays shining down. Released in 2009 by Demeter, this feminine and sultry perfume has a touch of animalic accords that tantalizes and arouses the sense.

products.name: Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Designed for both men and women, Demeter To Yo Ran Orchid is a fresh fragrance that works particularly well during the spring and summer seasons. Delicate notes of white orchid provide a floral base that is balanced by a variety of green notes. Citrusy lemon adds a light, refreshing element to complete the fragrance.

products.name: Demeter Saltwater Taffy by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Saltwater Taffy by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: A fragrance that brings to mind boardwalks and beaches, Demeter Saltwater Taffy is a sweet and nostalgic perfume for both men and women. It was launched by Demeter in 2013 and is the perfect fragrance for sunny summer days. Notes of caramel and sugar create the perfect sweetness, warmed and softened by notes of vanilla.

products.name: Demeter Spacewalk by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Spacewalk by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Once again taking something that no one knew could become a perfume and capturing it in a bottle, Demeter released Spacewalk in 2019. This unique scent is difficult to describe, but most refer to it as sweetly metallic. Demeter Spacewalk was inspired by the scent of the international space station and the interior of a rocket.

products.name: Demeter Puppy's Breath by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Puppy's Breath by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Animal lovers can experience the first time of seeing that adorable pup every day with Demeter Puppy's Breath by Demeter. This warm and sweet fragrance floods the mind with cherished memories of getting the first kiss from a fuzzy bundle of joy. Vibrant, youthful and revitalizing, it exudes a sense of happiness that will make others take note.

products.name: Demeter Privet by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Privet by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Take the senses on a journey through a shrub maze and welcome the delightful freshness and intrigue with a spritz of Demeter Privet by Demeter. This unisex fragrance has a green, floral and slightly spicy aroma that is mysterious yet inviting. One can envision exploring the unknown, delightfully navigating evergreens and bushes with delectable flowers.

products.name: Demeter Kelp by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Kelp by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2019, Demeter Kelp by Demeter craftily blends the clean, green and savory smell of kelp with salty sea air. It makes one envision trapesing along an oceanside path, feeling the gentle breeze and inhaling the delightful aromas that Mother Nature has to offer. It tickles the nose with hints of sweetness, which subtly mix with earthy accords.

products.name: Demeter Pomander by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pomander by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Enjoy the aroma of the holiday all year long with Demeter Pomander by Demeter. Launched in 2018, this delightfully fruity and spicy fragrance captures the warmth, excitement and comfortableness of sitting around with friends and family as the snow gently falls outside the window. As the aroma swirls, the senses are tantalized with an array of scents, including a hint of clove, amber, cinnamon and apple.

products.name: Demeter Pomander by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Pomander by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men

products.name: Demeter Mildew by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mildew by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: When you want a unique scent that captures a single essence of nature, Demeter has established itself as a go-to perfumer. Demeter Mildew is a surprisingly delightful unisex fragrance that is sure to bring back memories. Earthy and slightly sweet, it conjures up memories of turning on the air conditioner, playing with an old toy that has been socked away or dewy moss as you explore the garden.

products.name: Demeter Punch by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Punch by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: From high school dances to family gatherings, one whiff of Demeter Punch by Demeter will bring your memories alive. This delectable fragrance harnesses a blend of scents and accords to masterfully bring a favorite drink to life. Its sweet and fruity aroma will make you thirsty for more and surprise you with a few mysterious aromas.

products.name: Demeter Yuzu Marmalade by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Yuzu Marmalade by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by a gift of sweet South Korean preserves, Demeter Yuzu Marmalade is a deliciously refreshing fragrance that can be worn by both women and men. Bright, citrusy yuzu notes are the focus of this perfume, making it a perfect option for sunny summer days. It is lovely and light, great for daily wear.

products.name: Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Just like your favorite chip dip, Demeter Spicy Pineapple Salsa blends sweetness and spice for an unforgettable crispy snack sensation. The fragrance opens wth the toasty scents of jalapeno and paprika which are balanced by the juicy sweetness of pineapple and mango for a mouthwatering blend that brings back memories of family gatherings and warm summer sunsets. Mix it with a few of your favorite green or aromatic Demeter scents to create the right flavor smorgasbord for your next evening out.

products.name: Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: On days when you are feeling particularly sweet, Demeter Vanilla Cookie Dough from Demeter is the perfect fragrance. This perfume is great for both women and men, and its warmth makes it just right for cool autumn and winter days. With prominent notes of vanilla and sugar, it leaves you smelling just like a dessert.

products.name: Demeter Sugar Plum by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sugar Plum by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched by Demeter in 2012, Demeter Sugar Plum is the perfect autumn and winter fragrance. Suitable for both men and women, this perfume easily gets you into the holiday spirit. Notes of dried plum are enhanced by a blend of additional dried fruit and sweetened with warm honey notes.

products.name: Demeter Glue by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Glue by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Be prepared for a wave of memories to be unleashed when wearing Demeter Glue by Demeter. While you may not want to sniff the original, this balanced aromatic replica is something you will want to smell all day. Subtle yet distinct, it takes one back to childhood memories, from assembling models to letting your creative side out in art class.

products.name: Demeter Turpentine by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Turpentine by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Known for its innovative fragrance line, Demeter doesn’t hold back in creating unique, imaginative scents that capture what the real world has to offer. Demeter Turpentine does just that in a surprisingly delightful way. Crafted to evoke experiences, this scent easily whisks one away to art class or staining wood.

products.name: Demeter Turmeric by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Turmeric by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Since 600 Bc, aromatic turmeric has been sought after for medicinal purposes, flavoring and dyeing. Brilliantly yellow and slightly pungent, it continues to be cherished around the world. Demeter Turmeric by Demeter, released in 2019, captures the unique aroma that emits hints of ginger and orange.

products.name: Demeter Mushroom by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mushroom by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: When your inner soul loves all that nature has to offer, exude your true earthiness with Demeter Mushroom by Demeter. This unique aroma has a twang of pungency that is calmed with a mysterious sweetness. Like being whisked away to a magical forest, hints of fruity and woodiness envelope the senses as you hunt for the delectable treats that are hidden within.

products.name: Demeter White Sangria by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter White Sangria by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2013, Demeter White Sangria by Demeter will intoxicate the senses and make you yearn for warm-weather days having a refreshing drink in a tropical locale. Sophisticated and seductive, this boozy fragrance will delight those with a palate for wine. Along with a mix of red and white wine, a hint of sweet brandy.

products.name: Demeter Prune by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Prune by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Intense and seductive, Demeter Prune by Demeter is a sweet and fruity fragrance for men and women. Carefully crafted to mimic that natural, concentrated dried fruit, it conjures up ancient times while still exuding a modern, contemporary flair. Although not juicy, it still melts in your mouth, delivering a delectable taste that no other fruit can deliver.

products.name: Demeter Saguaro Cactus by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Saguaro Cactus by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: While the desert may conjure up images of sand and little habitat, hidden within is lush greenery that is undeniably attractive. Demeter Saguaro Cactus, released by Demeter in 2009, captures the essence that lively freshness. Warm, energizing and irresistible, it reawakens the spirit and boosts one’s appreciation of the complex beauty of Mother Nature.

products.name: Demeter Sweet Cilantro by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Sweet Cilantro by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2009, Demeter Sweet Cilantro by Demeter is a mesmerizing scent that instantly invigorates the senses. Clean, fresh and fragrant, captures the essence of charisma and being true to your inner self. It tingles the senses with its vivid burst of cilantro and coriander leaves, which gives it a soapy yet green aura that will be irresistible to those who love the complex herb.

products.name: Demeter Mountain Laurel by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mountain Laurel by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Take a deep breath and let the light, warm fragrance of Demeter Mountain Laurel perfume lift your spirits. This cheerful white floral scent draws its inspiration from a breathtaking mountain hike and features a single note of California bay laurel. A splash of this perfume lets you welcome the glorious days of spring and reminisce about your most uplifting outdoor excursions.

products.name: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter, launched in 2011, delicately captures the fragrant scent of mistletoe and the memories associated with it. The first spritz whisks one away to a wintery night filled with anticipation and longing. As a potential lover steps under the fresh, spicy and green decoration, the opportunity to steal a kiss is irresistible.

products.name: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex Unboxed) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Demeter Mistletoe by Demeter, launched in 2011, delicately captures the fragrant scent of mistletoe and the memories associated with it. The first spritz whisks one away to a wintery night filled with anticipation and longing. As a potential lover steps under the fresh, spicy and green decoration, the opportunity to steal a kiss is irresistible.

products.name: Demeter Tarnish by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Tarnish by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Relive cherished memories of shining up the silver with Demeter Tarnish by Demeter. This unique and innovative aroma evokes a sense of warmth and longing for simpler times. Carefully crafted with minimal, simple notes to capture the tangy essence of tarnish, it exudes a metallic and mineral vibe that is welcoming but also full of intrigue and mystery.

products.name: Demeter Macadamia Nut by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Macadamia Nut by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Take your senses on a warm, buttery journey with a spritz of Demeter Macadamia Nut by Demeter. This delectable fragrance exudes a tropical air without being saturated with fruity and floral scents. Earthy and natural, the aroma makes it easy to envision exploring Hawaii and taking in the breathtaking sights, from waves gently splashing to a lumbering volcano in the distance.

products.name: Demeter Scottish Shortbread by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Scottish Shortbread by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Tasty enough to eat, Demeter Scottish Shortbread is a sweet bakery scent perfect for winter evenings. It was first released in 2000 and features the reliable scents of sugar and wheat that combine to make a light biscuit scent. Like many Demeter fragrances, this one is startlingly realistic, bringing back memories of festive parties and afternoon tea.

products.name: Simone Cosac Ose by Simone Cosac Profumi
products.title_raw: Simone Cosac Ose by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Simone Cosac Ose is a deliciously fresh and subtly sweet floral woody fragrance that layers springtime blossoms over a subtly sensual musk base. The opening is an uplifting, enveloping effusion of freshest lilac mingled with orange blossom and almond. Heart notes are an ethereal white floral blend of heliotrope, lily and lovely mimosa.

products.name: Simone Cosac Sublime by Simone Cosac Profumi
products.title_raw: Simone Cosac Sublime by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray (Tester) 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2014, Simone Cosac Sublime is a sweet, embracing white floral fragrance. Opening notes are a bright and tantalizing expression of sparkling mandarin orange, juicy pear and pink pepper. Heady jasmine sambac absolute and ethereal heliotrope in the heart notes blend beautifully with lush, piquant gardenia and green nuances of violet leaf.

products.name: Simone Cosac Sublime by Simone Cosac Profumi
products.title_raw: Simone Cosac Sublime by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched in 2014, Simone Cosac Sublime is a sweet, embracing white floral fragrance. Opening notes are a bright and tantalizing expression of sparkling mandarin orange, juicy pear and pink pepper. Heady jasmine sambac absolute and ethereal heliotrope in the heart notes blend beautifully with lush, piquant gardenia and green nuances of violet leaf.

products.name: Trama Nera by Simone Cosac Profumi
products.title_raw: Trama Nera by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray 2 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released by niche Italian label Simone Cosac Profumi in 2012, Trama Nera is a rich and sensual floral oriental fragrance that mingles profuse florals with soft spice and precious wood. Opening notes are a subtly spicy citrus effusion of bergamot mingled with pink pepper and Indian saffron. Pure, powdery floral tones emerge at the heart, fusing damask rose and heady jasmine with hyacinth and earthy nuance of orris.

products.name: Peccato by Simone Cosac Profumi
products.title_raw: Peccato by Simone Cosac Profumi Perfume Spray 3.38 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Simone Cosac Profumi in 2014, Peccato is a soft and inviting feminine fragrance that layers sparkling citrus and sheer florals over a subtly sweet woody base. The opening uplifts with a citrus kiss of Italian bergamot and neroli spiced with warm hints of cardamom. Powdery, earthy florals come next, blending shimmering iris and fresh violet with sugar-spun nuances of mimosa.

products.name: Demeter Yellow Iris by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Yellow Iris by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Feel like every day is the first day of spring with Demeter Yellow Iris by Demeter. Released in 2017, this delightful fragrance takes your senses on an olfactory journey through blooming flowers as the gentle sun rays warm the skin, evoking a sense of youthfulness and excitement. This light perfume is infused with earthy and powdery accords that a hint of spiciness while still exuding a delicate innocence.

products.name: Demeter Cattleya Orchid by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Cattleya Orchid by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Unleash your inner queen with Demeter Cattleya Orchid. Launched by Demeter in 2015, this mesmerizing perfume is simple yet complex, making it a complementary fragrance for the bold modern woman. Creamy, sweet and citrusy, the orchid scent is masterfully blended with patchouli and citrus notes, which rev up its sophistication and seductiveness.

For this lover of fine fabrics, Burberry has devised a fragrance, which is comfortable, welcoming and yet rich in contrasts. The fragrance, created by Jean-Pierre Bethouard, Firmenich, displays an initial freshness of hard-to-define notes.

products.name: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom by Clean
products.title_raw: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom by Clean Travel Spray .34 oz for Women
products.description_en: Released in 2019, Clean Reserve Solar Bloom is a deliciously fresh floral fragrance enhanced by unexpected elements of coal, coconut milk and vetiver. The scent opens with an uplifting citrus expression of tart-sweet mandarin orange and fruity-aromatic bergamot. Creamy, enveloping white florals bloom next, mingling jasmine, freesia and lushly fragrant orange blossom with velvety coconut.

products.name: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom by Clean
products.title_raw: Clean Reserve Solar Bloom by Clean Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
