products.name: Demeter Molasses by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Molasses by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Ooze irresistible charm and sweetness with a spritz of Demeter Molasses. Launched in 2013 by Demeter, this mesmerizing perfume captures the delectableness of molasses. With all its sticky sweetness, it exudes a hint of the exotic and a touch of fruitiness.

products.name: Demeter Rye Bread by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Rye Bread by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Rye Bread by Demeter lets you take a journey to a classic New York City delicatessen without leaving home. This warm and welcoming fragrance makes your mouth water in anticipation of the first delectable bite. As you take a deep inhale, you can almost smell the bread being baked.

products.name: Demeter Mandarin Orange by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Mandarin Orange by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Mandarin Orange features only its titular scent note. Yet Demeter Fragrance Library lets its lively accords shine in this 2017 unisex citrus scent. Mandarin is a heritage citrus fruit whose cultivation began in China centuries ago.

products.name: Demeter Lobster by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lobster by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Your favorite sailor will be unable to leave your side when wearing a spritz of Demeter Lobster by Demeter. As the scent unfolds, it whisks one away to the seaside. The gentle breeze and warm sunshine make the skin pleasantly tingle while the vast ocean and all its life evoke a sense of vitality.

products.name: Demeter Raspberry Jam by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Raspberry Jam by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Imagine a slice of hearty bread, crisp and fresh from the toaster. Your favorite jam is the perfect topping to create true mealtime deliciousness. If your jelly of choice is packed with tart and juicy raspberries then Demeter has concocted an irresistible fragrance in the form of Demeter Raspberry Jam.

products.name: Demeter Petrichor by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Petrichor by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: If the smell of fresh rain captivates you, Demeter Petrichor is the ideal fragrance to add to your collection. In true Demeter fashion, this enchanting aroma uses a simple combination of dry soil and rainwater scent notes to create a long-lasting fragrance that is suitable for any occasion and can be worn throughout the year. Demeter is an American fragrance company that specializes in developing nostalgic scents.

products.name: Demeter Plum Blossom by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Plum Blossom by Demeter Cologne Spray 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: If you're looking for a versatile fragrance that transitions seamlessly from day to evening wear, Demeter Plum Blossom fits the bill. Made with a single scent note of plum blossom, this captivating aroma is both tangy and sweet. Its simple composition creates a rich scent that can be worn at any time of the year.

products.name: Demeter Musk #9 by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Musk #9 by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2014, Demeter Musk #9 by Demeter is a mesmerizing unisex fragrance that exudes an exotic seductiveness. Reminiscent of ancient times while still being modern and fresh, it captivates the senses with its powder, musky and citrusy aura. This scent starts with a burst of spirited lime and bergamot.

products.name: Demeter Lychee by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Lychee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Let others know that you are one of a kind wearing Demeter Lychee by Demeter. This tantalizingly sweet perfume has a tropical, exotic aura that captures the essence of this ancient delectable fruit that is synonymous with love and royalty. While the luscious sweetness mesmerizes, a touch of fresh fruitiness gives it a little edge that makes it even more captivating.

products.name: Demeter Gold by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Gold by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: The historical allure and fantasies that come with riches are brought to life by Demeter Gold. Launched in 2019 by Demeter, the perfumer went less literal with this mesmerizing scent, although it still has a seductive metallic spark that is sure to allure. Surprisingly warm and inviting, this form of gold takes one to a place where exotic spices fill the air as the gentle breeze brings in hints of the woods off in the distance.

products.name: Demeter Hyacinth by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Hyacinth by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Hyacinth is a 2018 unisex floral fragrance produced by the Demeter Fragrance Library. This fragrance note comes from the well-known spring perennial that blooms clusters of tiny pink, white, violet and blue flowers. Hyacinth takes its name from Greek mythology – a Spartan hero whom the Olympian god Apollo loved dearly.

products.name: Demeter Nitro Coffee by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Nitro Coffee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: There's no better way to start the morning than with a bold cup of coffee. With Demeter Nitro Coffee, you can keep that energizing scent with you all day long. This aromatic fragrance features a single note of coffee and is a great choice for both women and men.

products.name: Demeter Myrhh by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Myrhh by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Demeter Myrhh takes a timeless perfume note and displays the full spectrum of its beauty. This 2015 unisex fragrance from Demeter Fragrance Library features myrrh as its single note. This aromatic gum resin comes from the myrrh trees of Arabia and North Africa.

products.name: Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: When there is nary a steaming cup of Joe within sight but the perk of a java jolt is much needed, Demeter Fresh Brewed Coffee is just the thing to energize your spirit and senses any time of day. Launched in 2017, the unisex perfume from Demeter relies on the simple, singular note of coffee to uplift. As comforting and familiar as that first strong and steaming cup of coffee enjoyed first thing in the morning, the fragrance envelops you in the warm and spicy aroma of a favorite brew.

products.name: Demeter Earthworm by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Earthworm by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: While the name may make one take a step back, the aroma of Demeter Earthworm by Demeter is much deeper and enchanting than its namesake. This unique perfume instead is a figurative composition that captures the deep darkness of the rich soil below the ground. Earthy and aromatic, it conjures up exploring the woods while the dew is still moist with hints of decomposing leaves making the soil fertile while fresh leaves still shroud the path up above.

products.name: Demeter Frozen Pond by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Frozen Pond by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Breathe in the aroma of crisp, clean, cold air and be whisked away to unforgettable winter days exploring the icy elements with Demeter Frozen Pond by Demeter. This light and airy perfume brings to life the anticipation of strapping on ice skates to whirl around on frozen water knowing that warm, delectable hot cocoa will be your reward. Aquatic yet earthy, this fragrance has a unique charm that is even perfect for a hot summer day.

products.name: Demeter Magnolia by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Magnolia by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Take your senses on a springtime Southern journey with Demeter Magnolia by Demeter. This feminine perfume captures the unique and soothing charm of magnolia. Sophisticated and sensual, hints of exotic white flowers and deep woods add a welcoming mysteriousness that is enticing and irresistible.

products.name: Demeter Dust by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Dust by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: There is always a unique smell that makes a home your home. Demeter Dust by Demeter captures the essence of the minuscule particles that float around and create something that is only for you. Light and airy, this fragrance is a subtle mix of fabric lint, dirt and the scent of skin.

products.name: Demeter Licorice by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Licorice by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Soothing and unique, Demeter Licorice by Demeter is a familiar scent with a sophisticated and tantalizing twist. While it may evoke memories of being in a candy store and exploring all the possible delectable treats just an arm's reach away, its sweet spiciness has hints of botanicals and amber that are comforting and enticing. Bold yet not overbearing, a touch of vanilla tames the powerful scent of black licorice.

products.name: Demeter Egg Nog by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Egg Nog by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Easily get into the holiday spirit with Demeter Egg Nog from Demeter. This fragrance is great for Christmastime but is delicious enough to have you wearing it all winter and autumn long. Notes of rum and cognac provide warmth while mingling with notes of creamy milk.

products.name: Demeter Frangipani by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Frangipani by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Unleash your inner exotic seductress with Demeter Frangipani by Demeter. As you walk by, others will be instantly transfixed on the sweet, tropical aroma gently wafting by. Captivatingly mysterious, it captures the essence of the complex frangipani flower.

products.name: Demeter Iced Berries by Demeter
products.title_raw: Demeter Iced Berries by Demeter Cologne Spray (Unisex) 4 oz for Women
products.description_en: A sweet and spicy fragrance from Demeter, Demeter Iced Berries is the perfect perfume for the holiday season but can easily be worn throughout the year. It can be used on its own or combined with other scents. A trio of berry notes is the focus of the composition with blueberry, blackberry and raspberry blending together to create a bright, fresh fragrance.

products.name: Demeter New Car by Demeter

products.description_en: Designed by perfumer Benoist Lapouza and launched in 2020, Kilian Angels Share is an alluring sweet vanilla amber gourmand that’s perfect for autumn and winter occasions. Velvety, embracing cognac and magnetic hints of cinnamon open the scent. As the composition warms on the skin, wood and almond accords of oak and tonka bean emerge.

products.name: 4711 Colognette Refreshing Lemon by 4711
products.title_raw: 4711 Colognette Refreshing Lemon by 4711 Box Of 10 Refreshing Tissues -- for Men
products.description_en: Stay fresh no matter where you go with 4711 Colognette Refreshing Lemon by 4711. These handy wipes have a classic aroma that is comforting yet energetic and lively. Surprisingly complex yet subtle, each wipe bursts with the pleasant aroma of lemon upon opening the package.

products.name: Xerjoff Ivory Route by Xerjoff
products.title_raw: Xerjoff Ivory Route by Xerjoff Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Like setting off for an adventure, Xerjoff Ivory Route gets the energy pumping as the excitement for what comes next build. Released by Xerjoff in 2012, this classic cologne exudes mystery and energy. The fresh and herbal opening of basil settles in as an exotic mix of spicy notes and allspice tantalize the senses.

products.name: Exit The King by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: Exit The King by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released by Etat Libre D'orange in 2020, Exit The King is a fresh, aldehydic chypre floral fragrance that beautifully blends woody, earthy and clean musk elements. Top notes are a brisk, airy blend of Timur spice, pink pepper, aldehydes and soap supported by sheer musk. At the heart bloom fresh and intoxicating floral accords of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley.

products.name: Exit The King by Etat Libre D'orange
products.title_raw: Exit The King by Etat Libre D'orange Eau De Parfum Spray 1.6 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released by Etat Libre D'orange in 2020, Exit The King is a fresh, aldehydic chypre floral fragrance that beautifully blends woody, earthy and clean musk elements. Top notes are a brisk, airy blend of Timur spice, pink pepper, aldehydes and soap supported by sheer musk. At the heart bloom fresh and intoxicating floral accords of rose, jasmine and lily of the valley.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Like bottled artwork, Lengling Munich No 2 Skrik is a unique and inspiring aroma that makes others take note. Launched in 2015 by Lengling Munich, this cologne has a comforting yet seductive aroma. From the beginning, it tantalizes the senses with the green aroma of cedar and Iso E super.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Exude a distinct aura of sophistication and masculinity wearing Lengling Munich No 3 Acqua Tempesta by Lengling Munich. Released in 2015, this cologne is a bold and aromatic scent that delivers a long-lasting and mesmerizing finish. A zesty opening of peppermint is tamed with hints of cannabis, seawater and fruity yet spice olibanum paves the way for a seductive heart of floral hedione.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 4 In Between by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 4 In Between by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Let your inner complexity show wearing Lengling Munich No 4 In Between by Lengling Munich. Launched in 2015, this subtly seductive cologne has a touch of femininity that brings a light and airy twist to the masculine mix. Fresh and youthful, the opening is a fresh burst of peach and tangerine.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Take on the day with an energetic and harmonious spritz of Lengling Munich No 5 Eisbach by Lengling Munich. Launched in 2015, this subtle yet flavorful cologne keeps you feeling fresh and lively all day. It opens with a delectable and fruity mingling of bergamot, melon, lemon and grapefruit.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2015, Lengling Munich No 6 A La Carte by Lengling Munich is a delectable and irresistible cologne with sensual undertones. Sweet, spicy and animalic, it takes hold of the senses from the first spritz. Pink pepper and green, woody and fruity olibanum create a fresh opening that revs up the desire.

products.name: Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind by Lengling Munich Extrait De Parfum (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Take a stroll through the pine forest and feel the power of nature wearing Lengling Munich No 9 Wunderwind by Lengling Munich. Released in 2018, this invigorating cologne has a calming effect while also upping your intrigue level. The fresh and lively opening of lemon and watermelon has a touch of sea notes that give it a citrusy and salty aroma.

products.name: Lengling Munich Figolo by Lengling Munich
products.title_raw: Lengling Munich Figolo by Lengling Munich Parfum Spray (Unisex) 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: For modern men who appreciate simplicity yet want to ensure they smell like they have taken all morning to get ready, Lengling Munich Figolo by Lengling Munich is a must-have cologne. This masculine scent packs a woody and earthy yet sweet, spicy and fresh punch. The first spray unleashes the animalic and tantalizing aroma of patchouli.

products.name: Riiffs Wonder Of You by Riiffs
products.title_raw: Riiffs Wonder Of You by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Riiffs Wonder Of You is a sophisticated perfume that wears well at any time of year. Launched by the fragrance company Riiffs, this enchanting aroma opens with a sweet note of tart black cherry. Jasmine forms the heart of the fragrance and incorporates a delicate floral accord.

products.name: Arizona Rouge by Riiffs
products.title_raw: Arizona Rouge by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Fruity, floral and woody, Arizona Rouge by Riiffs is a mesmerizing blend of complementary notes that come together to create a unique and tantalizing scent made for the modern woman. It opens with the airy and fresh scents of bergamot and mandarin essence. The mesmerizing floral aromas of orange blossom and gardenia quickly take hold, taking the feminine allure to new levels.

products.name: Melissa Poudree by Riiffs
products.title_raw: Melissa Poudree by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Let your mysterious and sensual sideshow with Melissa Poudree by Riiffs. This mesmerizing perfume exudes a soft warmness with a dark and dangerous element that makes desire burn brighter and temptation harder to resist. Its surprisingly simple composition features sensual notes that masterfully blend together.

products.name: Riiffs Imperial Blue by Riiffs
products.title_raw: Riiffs Imperial Blue by Riiffs Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Take on the day or night with confidence wearing Riiffs Imperial Blue by Riiffs. This invigorating and energizing cologne is long-lasting that compliments the busy modern man. Subtle yet bold, it delicately balances woody and citrus notes to create an aroma that packs just enough punch.

products.name: Atelier Des Ors Riviera Drive by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Atelier Des Ors Riviera Drive by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Riviera Drive is a fragrance for both women and men designed by perfumer Marie Salamagne and launched by Atelier Des Ors in 2019. This aromatic perfume is a perfect choice for spring and summer days. The opening is fruity and herbal with notes of lemon, marjoram and rosemary.

products.name: Crepuscule Des Ames by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Crepuscule Des Ames by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: A warm, smoky and softly spicy aromatic fragrance enhanced by crisp herbal accords, Crepuscule Des Ames was created by perfumer Marie Salamagne and released by Atelier Des Ors in 2018. Opening notes are an effusive citrus-herbal blend of mandarin orange and crushed clary sage just softened by sweet hints of cardamom. Floral, mentholic hyssop and pimento in the heart notes merge with incense and earthy patchouli, followed by a subtly animalic finish of magnetic hyrax.

products.name: Bois Sikar by Atelier Des Ors
products.title_raw: Bois Sikar by Atelier Des Ors Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Designed for both men and women by perfumer Marie Salamagne, Bois Sikar is a woody fragrance that is particularly suited for cool autumn and winter evenings. Notes of nutmeg and precious woods form the top layer. The heart of the composition features cedar, cedar needles, styrax and guaiac wood notes.

products.name: Fabulous Tian Shian by Dali Haute Parfumerie
products.title_raw: Fabulous Tian Shian by Dali Haute Parfumerie Eau De Parfum Spray (Unisex) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Released in 2018, Fabulous Tian Shian takes you on a fantastic trip back in time to the exotic Tian Shian area of the Silk Road. From Spanish perfumier Dali Haute Parfumerie, this rich, exotic blend of elements makes a unique scent for men and women. It opens with top notes of woody juniper and bergamot.

products.name: White Diamonds En Rouge by Elizabeth Taylor
products.title_raw: White Diamonds En Rouge by Elizabeth Taylor Eau De Toilette Spray 3.3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Launched by Elizabeth Taylor in 2019, White Diamonds en Rouge is a floral feminine fragrance. It opens with a bit of sweetness and spice from raspberry and pink pepper top notes before transitioning to allow a floral heart to capture your attention. Light and delicate notes of jasmine, orange blossom and rose form the middle layer of the perfume.

products.name: Afnan Ornament Purple Allure by Afnan
products.title_raw: Afnan Ornament Purple Allure by Afnan Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Afnan Ornament Purple Allure is a women’s fragrance produced by the Dubai-based Afnan perfume house. Starting with top notes of grapefruit, mandarin orange and raspberry, this scent draws wearers in with its sharp and bracing yet honeyed and juicy introduction. Its center blends the creamy caramel-like tones of toffee with earthy cardamom, pungent anise and sweet white floral notes.

products.name: DC Comics Supergirl by DC Comics
products.title_raw: DC Comics Supergirl by DC Comics Eau De Toilette Spray 8 oz for Women
products.description_en: Unleash your inner superhero and smell as powerful as you feel wearing Dc Comics Supergirl by Dc Comics. This delectable perfume has an ideal balance of sweet, fruity and warm notes that lets everyone know you are bold and confident. The juicy opening of red apple, pear and plum starts the energetic journey and ushers in a heart of blackberry and sandalwood.

products.name: DC Comics Aquaman by Marmol & Son
products.title_raw: DC Comics Aquaman by Marmol & Son Body Spray 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: Dc Comics Aquaman from Marmol & Son is a fragrance for men inspired by the comic book superhero. A bright, fresh top layer opens the fragrance with notes of Sicilian lemon, grapefruit, watermint and citrus water. The fragrance is given some warmth and spice in the heart layer where Mediterranean jasmine is balanced by nutmeg, pink peppercorn and ginger.

products.name: Cyborg by DC Comics
products.title_raw: Cyborg by DC Comics Body Spray 8 oz for Men
products.description_en: A superhero-inspired fragrance for men, Dc Comics Cyborg is earthy and aromatic. This fragrance from Dc Comics opens with a combination of iced bergamot and crisp greens. As the top layer makes way for the heart of the fragrance, herbal notes begin to make an appearance.

products.name: DC DC Comics Poison Ivy by DC Comics
products.title_raw: DC DC Comics Poison Ivy by DC Comics Eau De Toilette Spray 8 oz for Women
products.description_en: Dc Comics Poison Ivy from Dc Comics is inspired by the popular Batman villain known for her powers over plants. As you would expect, this feminine fragrance features many floral and plant notes. It opens with mandarin blossom, brightened by fruity top notes of orange and melon.

products.name: DC Comics Catwoman by Marmol & Son
products.title_raw: DC Comics Catwoman by Marmol & Son Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Inspired by the comic book character who ranges from villain to love interest, Dc Comics Catwoman from Marmol & Son is a feminine perfume that blends sweet, floral and earthy notes into a beautiful fragrance. The perfume starts off with top notes of red berries, watery violet and bergamot. The heart is increasingly floral with middle notes of purple freesia and night blooming jasmine enhanced by fruity plum notes.

products.name: Old Havana by Marmol & Son
products.title_raw: Old Havana by Marmol & Son Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Let your different sides show while creating a seductive air of mystery with Old Havana by Marmol & Son. This complex perfume masterfully blends an array of notes to create an aroma that tantalizes and lingers. It has a fresh, energetic opening of bergamot, mandarin orange and lemon leaf.

products.name: Old Havana Pm by Marmol & Son
products.title_raw: Old Havana Pm by Marmol & Son Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Get whisked away to simpler times and bring your senses alive with Old Havana Pm by Marmol & Son perfume. This warm, sensual fragrance blends an array of delectable and tantalizing notes for an intoxicating aroma. The first spritz teases with the fresh and energetic scents of bergamot, raspberry, lemon zest and violet leaf.

products.name: Khaltat Al Arabia by Lattafa
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Spray (Royal Blends) 3.4 oz
products.title_raw: Khaltat Al Arabia by Lattafa Eau De Parfum Spray (Royal Blends) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Men and women alike will love this bright, warm scent by Khaltat Al Arabia by Lattafa. It delivers top notes of apples layered over a heavenly base of spices - nutmeg, and clove. The main accords for this fragrance are fruity, warm spicy, and amber, with fresh and sweet touches that enhance the powdery freshness.

products.name: Jil Sander Evergreen by Jil Sander
products.title_raw: Jil Sander Evergreen by Jil Sander Eau De Toilette Spray (Tester) 1.6 oz for Women
products.description_en: A deliciously fresh, uplifting fragrance, Jil Sander Evergreen is a casually elegant chypre floral scent. The opening is a bright expression of crisp pear, grapefruit blossom and a whisper of white pepper. Lush, shimmering florals emerge in the heart notes, fusing velvety-fresh rose with sparkling jasmine and lily of the valley.

products.name: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums
products.title_raw: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Albane Noble Rue De La Paix by Parisis Parfums begins right at the top with notes of brilliant red berries and the wild, sweet scent of bergamot, offering just a touch of lavender. The heart of the fragrance delights with notes of jasmine sambac and delicate Turkish rose. The base is deep and robust with its strong notes of patchouli, musk, sandalwood, cedarwood, amber, and oakmoss.

products.name: Double Diamond by Yzy Perfume
products.title_raw: Double Diamond by Yzy Perfume Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: No matter the occasion, dazzle and shine wearing Double Diamond by Yzy Perfume. Seductive and bold, this complex perfume captures the many layers of femininity. The sweet and citrusy opening of grapefruit, bergamot and blood orange exudes a playfulness that is complemented by a spicy and seductive heart of cinnamon, pepper, lavender and mint.

products.name: Black Point Sport by Yzy Perfume
products.title_raw: Black Point Sport by Yzy Perfume Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Black Point Sport by Yzy Perfume is a spirited yet sophisticated cologne that evokes a sense of old-world tradition with a modern twist. Warm and spicy yet fresh and invigorating, this fragrance opens with the clean and vibrant scents of lemon and bergamot. The citrusy start gently paves the way for a seductively mesmerizing heart of guaiac wood, olive blossoms and star anise.

products.name: Tunisian Neroli by Lisa Hoffman
products.title_raw: Tunisian Neroli by Lisa Hoffman Eau De Parfum Spray 2 oz for Men
products.description_en: Bright citrus, lush florals and magnetic amber are beautifully blended in Tunisian Neroli by U.S. cosmetics and fragrance label Lisa Hoffman.

products.name: Voce Viva Intensa by Valentino
products.title_raw: Voce Viva Intensa by Valentino Eau De Parfum Spray 1 oz for Women
products.description_en: Whether you drape yourself in high fashion or simply dream of it, the lush florals, bright citrus bursts and warm touches found in Voce Viva Intensa prove to be a perfect pairing. Released by the fashion house of Valentino in 2021, the women's perfume captures the essence of opulent style mixed with everyday life. A citrus freshness comes alive in the top of the scent with notes of juicy mandarin orange and zesty bergamot.

products.name: Montale Oud Tobacco by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Oud Tobacco by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray (Unboxed) 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Vibrant citrus, smoky-sweet tobacco and precious oud merge with lush white florals and warm spice in Montale Oud Tobacco. The scent opens with a fresh expression of blended citrus spiced with cumin and sumac. Fragrant orange blossom in the heart fuses with rich oud, amber and enveloping incense.

products.name: Montale Oud Tobacco by Montale
products.title_raw: Montale Oud Tobacco by Montale Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Men
products.description_en: Vibrant citrus, smoky-sweet tobacco and precious oud merge with lush white florals and warm spice in Montale Oud Tobacco. products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 1.7 oz
products.title_raw: Azzaro The Most Wanted by Azzaro Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: The seemingly simple composition of Azzaro The Most Wanted by Azzaro hides a warm, mysterious and playful side that is as complex as the modern man. products.title_raw: Missoni Wave by Missoni Eau De Toilette Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Launched in 2020, Missoni Wave by Missoni unleashes a wave of aromas that creates a mysterious and intoxicating allure. Masculine yet light and seductive, the fresh opening unfurls the aromas of sea notes, mandarin and other citruses. The refreshing start begins to take on an herbal and clean aura thanks to a heart of lavender, clary sage, rosemary and pelargonium.

products.name: La Rive by La Rive
products.title_raw: La Rive by La Rive Eau De Parfum Spray 3 oz for Women
products.description_en: Exude elegance and class no matter what day of the week wearing La Rive by La Rive. This feminine fragrance has sensual undertones mixed with a dreamy floral heart and a touch of the exotic. The delightful opening of freesia and pepper instantly refreshes and enlivens the senses.

products.name: Any Time by Elysee Fashion
products.title_raw: Any Time by Elysee Fashion Eau De Parfum Spray 3.3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Any Time Cologne by Elysee Fashion

products.name: Michael Kors Super Gorgeous by Michael Kors
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 3.4 oz
products.title_raw: Michael Kors Super Gorgeous by Michael Kors Eau De Parfum Intense Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: This 2021 perfume by Michael Kors is indeed Super Gorgeous! With captivating and elegant top notes of Mandarin orange, bergamot, and myrrh layered effortlessly over a middle of ylang-ylang, orange blossom, and jasmine sambac, this scent is striking and remarkable all the way through to its heart. The accords featured here are woody, citrusy, and sweet, offering a touch of inspiration and surprise.

products.name: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari
products.title_raw: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari delivers a strong, earthy scent that is a delight to savor. It begins with top notes of patchouli and orris layered in a straightforward way over the middle notes at the heart, which include patchouli once again, this time paired with orris. Accords are strongly representative of patchouli, iris, and woodsy scents that present a musky aroma.

products.name: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari
products.title_raw: Bvlgari Splendida Patchouli Tentation by Bvlgari Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Women

products.name: Baldessarini Nautic Spirit by Maurer & Wirtz
products.title_raw: Baldessarini Nautic Spirit by Maurer & Wirtz Eau De Toilette Spray 3 oz for Men
products.description_en: Baldessarini Nautic Spirit by Maurer & Wirtz has a distinctly adventurous essence, beginning with top notes of fresh, salty seawater, delicious passionfruit, and ripe mango. At its heart, this men's cologne features gorgeous notes of spiced ginger, curry tree, and ever-popular cardamom, while it finishes with deep base notes of sandalwood, musk, and patchouli. With warm spicy, tropical, and marine accords, this cologne is marked by a strong, sweet, and slightly fruity aromatic fragrance.

products.name: Angel Nova by Thierry Mugler
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 1.7 oz
products.title_raw: Angel Nova by Thierry Mugler Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 1.7 oz for Women
products.description_en: Designed by perfumers Louise Turner, Sonia Constant and Quentin Bisch, Angel Nova is a sweet and fresh, fruity tropical scent for women. Top notes are an irresistible blend of ripest raspberry mingled with sweet, succulent litchi fruit. Lovely damask rose and crisp nuances of violet embrace the heart, followed by a sensual, lingering base of richly woody Akigalawood, patchouli and benzoin.

products.name: Angel Nova by Thierry Mugler
products.type_raw: Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 3.4 oz
products.title_raw: Angel Nova by Thierry Mugler Eau De Parfum Refillable Spray 3.4 oz for Women

products.name: Victoria's Secret Tease Candy Noir by Victoria's Secret
products.title_raw: Victoria's Secret Tease Candy Noir by Victoria's Secret Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Known for its velvety iris and tangy sweetness, Victoria's Secret Tease Candy Noir is a fruity 2021 fragrance in the Tease line. The top note is a simple but refreshing raspberry. Dark iris follows along in the heart, adding an element of midnight mystery.

products.name: Kilian Gold Knight by Kilian
products.title_raw: Kilian Gold Knight by Kilian Eau De Parfum Spray 1.7 oz for Men
products.description_en: Kilian Gold Knight offers a truly unique scent as it opens with top notes of subtle anise and wild bergamot. Kilian expertly layers these top notes over the middle notes of sweet honey and fresh vanilla, only to come in with a surprise at the base with strong notes of patchouli. To say this fragrance is intriguing is to understate how alluring it is!

products.title_raw: Cheap & Chic by Moschino Eau De Toilette Spray 3.4 oz for Women
products.description_en: Moschino is best known as a design house with an avant-garde ede to their designs, and their fragrances are no exception to this rule.  The visuals for Cheap & Chic, a Moschino offering from 1995, bring to mind Olive Oyl from the old Popeye cartoons, and the floral, fruity scent pops with interesting notes like bergamot, petitgrain, white orchid, sandalwood, and vanilla.  That said, the fragrance isn't overpowering, and in fact is perfect to wear around the office.
